info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2x Long OSCR ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Oscar Health, Inc. - Class A (NYSE: OSCR). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") where the fund manager attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying Security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. It aims to achieve this daily percentage change for a single day, and not for any other period. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2x Long OSCR ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 Oscar Health, Inc. - A 類（NYSE：OSCR）股價每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），基金經理人試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。它的目標是在一天內實現每日百分比變化，而不是在任何其他時期內實現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long OSCR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of OSCR. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of OSCR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 OSCR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 OSCR 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 200% 的 OSCR 價格每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Proficient Auto Logistics, Inc. is a freight company, which engages in providing auto transportation and logistics services. Its transport services include open carrier, enclosed car shipping, cross country car shipping, and dealer relocation. It operates through the Company Drivers and Brokered segments. The Company Drivers segment offers automobile transport and contract services under an asset-based model. The Brokered segment refers to the transportation services utilizing an asset-light model focusing on outsourcing transportation of loads to third-party carriers. The Company was founded on June 13, 2023 and is headquartered in Jacksonville, FL.
info.description_zh: Proficient Auto Logistics, Inc.是一家貨運公司，從事提供汽車運輸和物流服務。其運輸服務包括開放式承運、封閉式汽車運輸、越野汽車運輸和經銷商搬遷。它透過公司司機和經紀部門運作。公司司機部門在基於資產的模式下提供汽車運輸和合約服務。經紀業務是指利用輕資產模式的運輸服務，重點在於將貨物運輸外包給第三方承運人。該公司成立於2023年6月13日，總部位於佛羅裡達州傑克遜維爾。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long DKNG ETF seeks stment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of DraftKings Inc. (Nasdaq: DKNG). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long DKNG ETF 尋求在費用和開支之前，DraftKings Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：DKNG）股價每日百分比變化兩倍（200%）的評估結果。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Anghami, Inc. engages in the provision of digital entertainment and online streaming platforms. It includes music, podcasts, music videos, and live events. Its products are available on all devices such as mobile and tablets, desktop and laptop, cars, speakers, Chromecast, PlayStation, wearables, and Apple TV. It operates through the following segments: Revenue from subscriptions, Revenue from advertisement and Revenue from live events. The company was founded by Edgard Jean Maroun and Elias Nabil Habib on February 14, 2012 and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.
info.description_zh: Anghami, Inc. 從事提供數位娛樂和線上串流平台。它包括音樂、播客、音樂錄影帶和現場活動。其產品適用於所有設備，例如手機和平板電腦、桌上型電腦和筆記型電腦、汽車、揚聲器、Chromecast、PlayStation、穿戴式裝置和 Apple TV。它透過以下部門運作：訂閱收入、廣告收入和現場活動收入。該公司由 Edgard Jean Maroun 和 Elias Nabil Habib 於 2012 年 2 月 14 日創立，總部位於阿拉伯聯合大公國阿布達比。

info.description: Sportradar Group AG engages in the provision of sports betting and entertainment products and services. Its products include Betting Technology & Solutions and Sports Content, Technology & Services. The company was founded by Carsten Marcus Koerl in 2001 and is headquartered in St. Gallen, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: Sportradar Group AG 從事提供體育博彩和娛樂產品及服務。其產品包括博彩技術和解決方案以及體育內容、技術和服務。該公司由 Carsten Marcus Koerl 於 2001 年創立，總部位於瑞士聖加侖。

info.description: TG Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the acquisition, development, and commercialization of novel treatments for B-cell malignancies and autoimmune diseases. Its product pipeline includes TG-1501, TG-1701, Ublituximab, and Umbralisib. The company was founded by Michael Sean Weiss and Laurence H. Shaw on May 18, 1993 and is headquartered in Morrisville, NC.
info.description_zh: TG Therapeutics, Inc. 從事 B 細胞惡性腫瘤和自體免疫疾病新型療法的收購、開發和商業化。其產品管線包括TG-1501、TG-1701、Ublituximab和Umbralisib。該公司由 Michael Sean Weiss 和 Laurence H. Shaw 於 1993 年 5 月 18 日創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州莫里斯維爾。

info.description: InnovAge Holding Corp. engages in managing the care of high-cost, frail, and predominantly dual-eligible seniors through the Program of All-inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE). The company program is dedicated to enabling older adults to age independently in their own homes for as long as safely possible. It offers interdisciplinary care teams and community-based care delivery models. The company was founded in May 2007 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: InnovAge Holding Corp. 透過老年人全包護理計劃 (PACE) 致力於管理高成本、體弱且主要具有雙重資格的老年人的護理。該公司的計劃致力於讓老年人能夠在自己的家中盡可能安全地獨立養老。它提供跨學科護理團隊和社區為基礎的護理服務模式。該公司成立於 2007 年 5 月，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: Newell Brands, Inc. is a global consumer goods company, which engages in the business of manufacturing, marketing, and selling consumer and commercial products. It operates through the following segments: Home and Commercial Solutions, Learning and Development, Outdoor and Recreation, and Corporate. The Home and Commercial Solutions segment includes designing, manufacturing, sourcing, marketing, and distributing a diverse line of household products including kitchen appliances, food and home storage, fresh preserving, vacuum sealing, gourmet cookware, bakeware, cutlery, and home fragrance products, as well as commercial cleaning and maintenance solutions products, closet and garage organization products, hygiene systems, and material handling solutions. The Learning and Development segment focuses on writing instruments including markers, highlighters, pens, and pencils, art products, activity-based products, labeling solutions, baby gear, and infant care products. The Outdoor and Recreation segment offers global consumer active lifestyle products for outdoor and outdoor-related activities including technical apparel and on-the-go beverageware. The Corporate segment provides general corporate services. The company was founded in 1903 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Newell Brands, Inc. 是一家全球消費品公司，從事製造、行銷和銷售消費品和商業產品的業務。它透過以下部門運作：家庭和商業解決方案部門、學習和發展部門、戶外和休閒部門以及企業部門。家庭和商業解決方案部門包括設計、製造、採購、行銷和分銷各種家用產品，包括廚房電器、食品和家庭儲存、保鮮、真空密封、美食炊具、烘焙用具、餐具和家用香薰產品，以及商業清潔和維護解決方案產品、壁櫥和車庫組織產品、衛生系統和材料處理解決方案。學習和發展部門專注於書寫工具，包括記號筆、螢光筆、鋼筆和鉛筆、藝術產品、基於活動的產品、標籤解決方案、嬰兒用品和嬰兒護理產品。戶外和休閒部門為全球消費者提供用於戶外和戶外相關活動的積極生活方式產品，包括技術服裝和隨身飲料。企業部門提供一般企業服務。該公司成立於 1903 年，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Optex Systems Holdings, Inc. engages in the business of manufacturing optical sighting systems and assemblies for the Department of Defense, foreign military applications, and commercial markets. It operates through the following segments: Optex Systems Richardson and Applied Optics Center Dallas. The Optex Systems Richardson segment handles optical sighting systems and assemblies' production. The Applied Optics Center Dallas segment serves as the key supplier of laser coated filters used in the production of periscope assemblies. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Richardson, TX.
info.description_zh: Optex Systems Holdings, Inc. 從事為國防部、外國軍事應用和商業市場製造光學瞄準系統和組件的業務。它透過以下部門運作：Optex Systems Richardson 和達拉斯應用光學中心。 Optex Systems Richardson 部門負責光學瞄準系統和組件的生產。達拉斯應用光學中心分部是用於生產潛望鏡組件的雷射鍍膜濾光片的主要供應商。該公司成立於 1987 年，總部位於德克薩斯州理查森。

info.description: Cardinal Health, Inc. is a healthcare services and products company, which engages in the provision of customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices. It also provides medical products and pharmaceuticals and cost-effective solutions that enhance supply chain efficiency. The firm operates through the Pharmaceutical and Medical segments. The Pharmaceutical segment distributes branded and generic pharmaceutical, specialty pharmaceutical and over-the-counter healthcare and consumer products. The Medical segment manufactures, sources and distributes Cardinal Health branded medical, surgical, and laboratory products. The company was founded by Robert D. Walter in 1979 and is headquartered in Dublin, OH.
info.description_zh: Cardinal Health, Inc. 是一家醫療保健服務和產品公司，致力於為醫院、醫療保健系統、藥房、門診手術中心、臨床實驗室和醫師辦公室提供客製化解決方案。它還提供醫療產品和藥品以及具有成本效益的解決方案，以提高供應鏈效率。該公司透過製藥和醫療部門運作。製藥部門分銷品牌藥品和仿製藥、特殊藥品以及非處方醫療保健和消費品。醫療部門生產、採購和分銷康德樂品牌的醫療、外科和實驗室產品。該公司由 Robert D. Walter 於 1979 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州都柏林。

info.description: BJ's Restaurants, Inc. engages in the ownership and operation of casual dining restaurants. The firm operates BJ's Restaurant and Brewery, BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse, and BJ's Pizza and Grill or BJ's Grill. It offers pizzas, appetizers, specialty salads, soups, pastas, sandwiches, entrees, desserts, and proprietary craft beers. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Huntington Beach, CA.
info.description_zh: BJ's Dinings, Inc. 從事休閒餐廳的所有權和經營業務。該公司經營 BJ's 餐廳和啤酒廠、BJ's 餐廳和釀酒廠以及 BJ's Pizza and Grill 或 BJ's Grill。它提供比薩、開胃菜、特色沙拉、湯、義大利麵、三明治、主菜、甜點和專有精釀啤酒。該公司成立於 1978 年，總部位於加州亨廷頓海灘。

info.description: Daily Journal Corp. engages in the business of publishing newspapers and websites reporting California and Arizona news and producing several specialized information publications. It operates through the following segments: Traditional Business, Journal Technologies, and Corporate. The Traditional Business segment includes newspapers of general circulation. The Journal Technologies segment provides case management software and related services to courts and other justice agencies. The company was founded on December 31, 1969 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Daily Journal Corp. 從事出版報道加州和亞利桑那州新聞的報紙和網站以及製作多種專業資訊出版物的業務。它透過以下部門運作：傳統業務部門、期刊技術部門和企業部門。傳統商業部門包括普遍發行的報紙。 Journal Technologies 部門向法院和其他司法機構提供案件管理軟體和相關服務。該公司成立於1969年12月31日，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Incyte Corp. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of proprietary therapeutics. It focuses on hematology and oncology, and inflammation and autoimmunity therapeutic areas. The company was founded on April 8, 1991 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Incyte Corp.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於專有療法的發現、開發和商業化。它專注於血液學和腫瘤學以及發炎和自體免疫治療領域。該公司成立於1991年4月8日，總部位於德拉瓦州威爾明頓。

info.description: Grande Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in corporate finance advisory services through its subsidiary, Grande Capital. It offers IPO sponsorship and related services, and corporate financial advisory services. The company was founded on August 6, 2020 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Grande Group Ltd. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司 Grande Capital 從事企業融資諮詢服務。它提供首次公開發行保薦及相關服務以及企業財務諮詢服務。該公司成立於2020年8月6日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Marex Group Plc provides brokerage services for commodities, financials, and foreign exchange. It operates through the following segments: Clearing, Agency and Execution, Market Making, Hedging and Investment Solutions, and Corporate. The Clearing segment allows the clients access to exchanges and clearing houses. The Agency and Execution segment match buyers and sellers on an agency basis by facilitating price discovery of commodities and financial markets. The Market Making segment offers direct market pricing to professional and wholesale counterparties in a variety of commodity and securities markets. The Corporate segment includes the group's control and support functions. The company was founded by Mark Slade in 2005 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Marex Group Plc 提供商品、金融和外匯經紀服務。它透過以下部門運作：清算部門、代理商和執行部門、做市部門、對沖和投資解決方案部門以及企業部門。清算部分允許客戶存取交易所和清算所。代理商和執行部門透過促進商品和金融市場的價格發現，在代理商基礎上匹配買家和賣家。做市部門為各種商品和證券市場的專業和批發交易對手提供直接市場定價。公司部門包括集團的控制和支援職能。該公司由 Mark Slade 於 2005 年創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: El Pollo Loco Holdings, Inc. engages in the development, franchising, licensing, and operation of quick-service restaurants under the name El Pollo Loco. It specializes in fire-grilling fresh citrus-marinated chicken with a variety of offerings including Chicken Avocado Burrito, Pollo Fit entrees, chicken tostada salads, and Pollo Bowls. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Costa Mesa, CA.
info.description_zh: El Pollo Loco Holdings, Inc. 從事 El Pollo Loco 名稱下快餐店的開發、特許經營、許可和營運業務。它專門提供火烤新鮮柑橘醃製雞肉，提供各種菜餚，包括雞肉酪梨捲餅、Pollo Fit 主菜、雞肉托斯塔達沙拉和 Pollo Bowls。該公司成立於 1980 年，總部位於加州科斯塔梅薩。

info.description: Henry Schein, Inc. engages in the provision of health care products and services to medical, dental, and veterinary office-based practitioners. It operates through the following segments: Global Distribution and Value-Added Services, Global Specialty Products, and Global Technology. The Global Distribution and Value-Added Services segment focuses on distribution to the global dental and medical markets of national brand and corporate brand merchandise, and equipment and related technical services. The Global Specialty Products segment includes manufacturing, marketing and sales of dental implant and biomaterial products, endodontic, orthodontic and orthopedic products. The Global Technology segment focuses on development and distribution of practice management software, e-services, and other products, which are distributed to health care providers. The company was founded by Henry Schein and Esther Schein in 1932 and is headquartered in Melville, NY.
info.description_zh: Henry Schein, Inc. 致力於為醫療、牙科和獸醫診所的從業人員提供醫療保健產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：全球分銷和增值服務部門、全球特色產品部門和全球技術部門。全球分銷和增值服務部門專注於向全球牙科和醫療市場分銷國家品牌和企業品牌商品、設備和相關技術服務。全球特種產品部門包括植牙和生物材料產品、牙髓、矯正和矯正產品的製造、行銷和銷售。全球技術部門專注於實踐管理軟體、電子服務和其他產品的開發和分銷，這些產品分發給醫療保健提供者。該公司由 Henry Schein 和 Esther Schein 於 1932 年創立，總部位於紐約州梅爾維爾。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Consumer Staples ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Consumer Staples Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC compiles, maintains and calculates the index, which is designed to measure the performance of securities of small-capitalization U.S. companies in the consumer staples sector, as defined by the Global Industry Classification Standard. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap Consumer Staples ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Consumer Staples Index 的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標普道瓊斯指數有限責任公司嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算該指數，該指數旨在衡量全球行業分類標準定義的消費品行業中美國小型公司的證券表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Hancock Whitney Corp. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It also offers trust and investment management services to retirement plans, corporations, individuals, brokerage services, annuity products, life insurance, general insurance and agency services, including life, title insurance and consumer financing service. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Gulfport, MS.
info.description_zh: Hancock Whitney Corp. 作為一家銀行控股公司運營，提供金融服務。它還為退休計劃、企業、個人提供信託和投資管理服務、經紀服務、年金產品、人壽保險、一般保險和代理服務，包括人壽、產權保險和消費者融資服務。該公司成立於 1984 年，總部位於密西西比州格爾夫波特。

info.description: The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It operates through the following segments: Retail Banking, Corporate and Institutional Banking, Asset Management Group, and Other. The Retail Banking segment offers deposit, lending, brokerage, investment management, and cash management products and services to consumer and small business customers. The Corporate and Institutional segment covers the lending, treasury management, and capital markets-related products and services to mid-sized and large corporations, government, and not-for-profit entities. The Asset Management Group segment includes personal wealth management for high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients and institutional asset management. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.
info.description_zh: PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. 是一家控股公司，提供金融服務。它透過以下部門運作：零售銀行部門、企業和機構銀行部門、資產管理部門和其他部門。零售銀行部門為消費者和小型企業客戶提供存款、貸款、經紀、投資管理和現金管理產品和服務。企業和機構部門涵蓋向大中型企業、政府和非營利實體提供貸款、資金管理以及資本市場相關產品和服務。資產管理集團業務包括針對高淨值和超高淨值客戶的個人財富管理以及機構資產管理。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州匹茲堡。

info.description: biote Corp. is a woman-led company, which engages in providing bio identical hormone pellet therapy. It delivers a comprehensive, end-to-end platform that provides practitioners with medical education, training and certification, practice management software, and digital and point-of-care marketing support. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.description_zh: Biote Corp. 是一家由女性領導的公司，致力於提供生物相同的荷爾蒙顆粒療法。它提供了一個全面的端到端平台，為從業人員提供醫學教育、培訓和認證、實踐管理軟體以及數位和護理點行銷支援。該公司成立於 2012 年，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: IRadimed Corp. engages in the development, manufacture, marketing, and distribution of Magnetic Resonance Imaging compatible medical devices. It also provides a non-magnetic Intravenous infusion pump system that is specifically designed for use during MRI procedures. The company was founded by Roger Susi in July 1992 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: IRadimed Corp. 從事磁振造影相容醫療設備的開發、製造、行銷和分銷。它還提供專為 MRI 手術期間使用而設計的非磁性靜脈輸液幫浦系統。該公司由 Roger Susi 於 1992 年 7 月創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: Virginia National Bankshares Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking and related financial services. It operates through the following segments: Bank, VNB Trust and Estate Services, and Masonry Capital. The Bank segment includes making loans, taking deposits, and offering related services to individuals, businesses, and charitable organizations. The VNB Trust and Estate Services segment consists of corporate trustee services, trust and estate administration, IRA administration and custody services, and in-house investment management services. The Masonry Capital segment refers to the investment management services for separately managed accounts and a private investment fund. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Charlottesville, VA.
info.description_zh: Virginia National Bankshares Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供銀行及相關金融服務。它透過以下部門運作：銀行部門、VNB 信託和房地產服務部門以及 Masonry Capital 部門。銀行部門包括向個人、企業和慈善組織提供貸款、吸收存款以及提供相關服務。 VNB 信託和遺產服務部門包括企業受託人服務、信託和遺產管理、IRA 管理和託管服務以及內部投資管理服務。 Masonry Capital部門指為獨立管理帳戶和私募投資基金提供投資管理服務。該公司成立於 1998 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州夏洛茨維爾。

info.description: First Trust Nasdaq Bank ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq US Smart Banks IndexTM. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depository receipts that comprise the underlying index. The index is designed to provide exposure to U.S. companies comprising the banking sector that have been selected based upon their liquidity and weighted based upon their cumulative score on three investing factors: volatility, value and growth. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust 納斯達克銀行 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為納斯達克美國智能銀行指數 (Nasdaq US Smart Banks IndexTM) 的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成基礎指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在提供對包括銀行業在內的美國公司的投資，這些公司是根據其流動性進行選擇的，並根據其在三個投資因素（波動性、價值和增長）的累積得分進行加權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The Campbell's Co. engages in the business of manufacturing and marketing food and beverage products. It operates under the Meals and Beverages, and Snacks segments. The Meals and Beverages segment includes soup, meals, and beverage products in retail and foodservice. The Snacks segment offers cookies, crackers, bakery, and frozen products. The company was founded by Joseph Campbell and Abraham Anderson in 1869 and is headquartered in Camden, NJ.
info.description_zh: The Campbell's Co. 從事食品和飲料產品的製造和行銷業務。它在膳食和飲料以及零食部門下運作。膳食和飲料部門包括零售和餐飲服務中的湯、膳食和飲料產品。零食部門提供餅乾、薄脆餅乾、麵包和冷凍產品。該公司由 Joseph Campbell 和 Abraham Anderson 於 1869 年創立，總部位於新澤西州卡姆登。

info.description: Sysco Corp. engages in the selling, marketing, and distribution of food products to restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, and lodging establishments. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Foodservice Operations, International Foodservice Operations, SYGMA, and Other. The U.S. Foodservice Operations segment consists of U.S. Broadline operations, custom-cut meat and seafood companies, FreshPoint, and European Imports. The International Foodservice Operations segment includes operations outside of the United States which distribute a full line of food products and a wide variety of non-food products. The SYGMA segment represents U.S. customized distribution operations serving quick-service chain restaurant customer locations. The Other segment covers hotel supply operations. The company was founded by John F. Baugh in 1969 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Sysco Corp. 從事向餐廳、醫療保健和教育機構以及住宿機構銷售、行銷和分銷食品的業務。該公司透過以下部門營運：美國餐飲服務部門、國際餐飲服務部門、SYGMA 部門和其他部門。美國餐飲服務營運部門由 U.S. Broadline 營運、客製化肉類和海鮮公司、FreshPoint 和 Europe Imports 組成。國際餐飲服務業務部門包括美國境外的業務，分銷全系列食品和各種非食品產品。 SYGMA 部門代表美國客製化分銷業務，為快速服務連鎖餐廳客戶提供服務。其他部門涵蓋酒店供應業務。該公司由 John F. Baugh 於 1969 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: CVS Health Corp. is a health solutions company, which engages in the provision of healthcare services. It operates through the following segments: Health Care Benefits, Health Services, Pharmacy and Consumer Wellness, and Corporate and Other. The Health Care Benefits segment operates as a health care benefits provider. The Health Services segment offers a full range of PBM solutions, delivers health care services in its medical clinics, virtually, and in the home. The Pharmacy & Consumer Wellness segment dispenses prescriptions in its retail pharmacies and through its infusion operations. The Corporate and Other Segment is involved in management and administrative expenses. The company was founded by Stanley P. Goldstein and Ralph Hoagland in 1963 and is headquartered in Woonsocket, RI.
info.description_zh: CVS Health Corp. 是一家健康解決方案公司，從事提供醫療保健服務。它透過以下部門運作：醫療保健福利部門、健康服務部門、藥房和消費者健康部門以及企業和其他部門。醫療保健福利部門作為醫療保健福利提供者運作。健康服務部門提供全方位的 PBM 解決方案，在其醫療診所、虛擬和家庭中提供醫療保健服務。藥房和消費者健康部門在其零售藥房和輸液業務中分發處方。公司及其他部門涉及管理和行政費用。該公司由 Stanley P. Goldstein 和 Ralph Hoagland 於 1963 年創立，總部位於羅德島州文索基特。

info.description: Bank of America Corp. is a bank and financial holding company, which engages in the provision of banking and nonbank financial services. It operates through the following segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth and Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking, Global Markets, and All Other. The Consumer Banking segment offers credit, banking, and investment products and services to consumers and small businesses. The GWIM segment focuses on solutions to meet clients' needs through a full set of investment management, brokerage, banking, and retirement products. The Global Banking segment deals with lending-related products and services, integrated working capital management and treasury solutions to clients, and underwriting and advisory services. The Global Markets segment includes sales and trading services, as well as research, to institutional clients across fixed-income, credit, currency, commodity, and equity businesses. The All Other segment consists of asset and liability management activities, equity investments, non-core mortgage loans and servicing activities, the net impact of periodic revisions to the mortgage servicing rights valuation model for both core and non-core MSRs, other liquidating businesses, residual expense allocations and other. The company was founded by Amadeo Peter Giannini in 1904 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: 美國銀行公司是一家銀行和金融控股公司，從事提供銀行和非銀行金融服務。它透過以下部門運作：消費者銀行部門、全球財富與投資管理部門 (GWIM)、全球銀行部門、全球市場部門和所有其他部門。消費者銀行業務部門為消費者及小型企業提供信貸、銀行及投資產品及服務。 GWIM 部門專注於透過全套投資管理、經紀、銀行和退休產品來滿足客戶需求的解決方案。全球銀行業務部門提供貸款相關產品和服務、綜合營運資金管理和客戶資金解決方案以及承銷和諮詢服務。全球市場部門包括向固定收益、信貸、貨幣、商品和股票業務的機構客戶提供銷售和交易服務以及研究。所有其他部門包括資產和負債管理活動、股權投資、非核心抵押貸款和服務活動、核心和非核心抵押貸款服務權估值模型定期修訂的淨影響、其他清算業務、剩餘費用分配等。該公司由 Amadeo Peter Giannini 於 1904 年創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Oruka Therapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which focuses on developing novel monoclonal antibody therapeutics for PsO and other I&I indications. Its pipeline includes ORKA-001 and ORKA-002. The company is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Oruka Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家生物技術公司，專注於開發針對 PsO 和其他 I&I 適應症的新型單株抗體療法。其管道包括ORKA-001和ORKA-002。該公司總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: D.R. Horton, Inc. engages in the construction and sale of single-family housing. It operates through the following geographical segments: Northwest, Southwest, South Central, Southeast, East, and North. The Northwest segment relates to Colorado, Oregon, Utah, and Washington. The Southwest segment covers Arizona, California, Hawaii, Nevada, and New Mexico. The South Central segment is involved in Arkansas, Oklahoma, and Texas. The Southeast segment refers to Alabama, Florida, Louisiana, and Mississippi. The East segment operates Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Tennessee. The North segment focuses on Delaware, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Minnesota, Nebraska, New Jersey, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Virginia, and West Virginia. The company was founded by Donald Ray Horton in 1978 and is headquartered in Arlington, TX.
info.description_zh: 博士Horton, Inc. 從事單戶住宅的建設和銷售。它透過以下地理區域運作：西北、西南、中南、東南、東部和北部。西北段涉及科羅拉多州、俄勒岡州、猶他州和華盛頓州。西南部包括亞利桑那州、加利福尼亞州、夏威夷州、內華達州和新墨西哥州。中南部部分涉及阿肯色州、俄克拉荷馬州和德克薩斯州。東南部分是指阿拉巴馬州、佛羅裡達州、路易斯安那州和密西西比州。東部部門經營喬治亞州、北卡羅來納州、南卡羅來納州和田納西州。北部部分主要集中在德拉瓦州、伊利諾州、印第安納州、愛荷華州、肯塔基州、馬裡蘭州、明尼蘇達州、內布拉斯加州、紐澤西州、俄亥俄州、賓州、維吉尼亞州和西維吉尼亞州。該公司由 Donald Ray Horton 於 1978 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州阿靈頓。

info.description: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. engages in the provision of insurance brokerage, reinsurance brokerage, consulting, and third-party claims settlement and administration services. It operates through the following segments: Brokerage, Risk Management, and Corporate. The Brokerage segment consists of retail and wholesale insurance brokerage operations. The Risk Management segment provides contract claim settlement and administration services. The Corporate segment manages clean energy and other investments. The company was founded by Arthur J. Gallagher in 1927 and is headquartered in Rolling Meadows, IL.
info.description_zh: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. 從事提供保險經紀、再保險經紀、諮詢以及第三方索賠結算和管理服務。它透過以下部門運作：經紀部門、風險管理部門和企業部門。經紀部門包括零售和批發保險經紀業務。風險管理部門提供合約索賠結算和管理服務。公司部門管理清潔能源和其他投資。該公司由 Arthur J. Gallagher 於 1927 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州羅靈梅多斯。

info.description: Bank of the James Financial Group, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of general retail and commercial banking services. It operates through the Community Banking, Mortgage Banking, and Investment Advisory segments. The Community Banking segment includes Bank of the James which provides loans, deposits, investments and insurance to retail and commercial customers throughout the bank's market areas. The Mortgage Banking segment offers a variety of mortgage loan products principally within the bank's market areas. The Investment Advisory segment provides investment advisory and financial planning services. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Lynchburg, VA.
info.description_zh: Bank of the James Financial Group, Inc.是一家銀行控股公司，提供一般零售和商業銀行服務。它透過社區銀行、抵押貸款銀行和投資諮詢部門開展業務。社區銀行業務部門包括詹姆斯銀行，該銀行向該銀行整個市場領域的零售和商業客戶提供貸款、存款、投資和保險。抵押貸款銀行部門主要在銀行的市場領域內提供各種抵押貸款產品。投資諮詢部門提供投資諮詢和財務規劃服務。該公司成立於 1998 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州林奇堡。

info.description: Central Garden & Pet Co. engages in the production and distribution of branded and private label products for the lawn, garden, and pet supplies markets. It operates through the Pet and Garden segments. The Pet segment focuses on dog and cat supplies such as dog treats and chews, toys, pet beds and containment, grooming products, waste management and training pads, supplies for aquatics, small animals, reptiles and pet birds including toys, cages and habitats, bedding, food and supplements, products for equine and livestock, animal and household health and insect control products, live fish, and small animals, as well as outdoor cushions. The Garden segment includes lawn and garden consumables such as grass, vegetable, flower and herb seed, wild bird feed, bird houses and other birding accessories, weed, grass, and other herbicides, insecticide and pesticide products, fertilizers, and live plants. The company was founded by William E. Brown in 1980 and is headquartered in Walnut Creek, CA.
info.description_zh: Central Garden & Pet Co. 從事草坪、花園和寵物用品市場的品牌和自有品牌產品的生產和分銷。它透過寵物和花園部門運作。寵物部門專注於狗和貓用品，如狗零食和咀嚼物、玩具、寵物床和圍護用品、美容產品、廢物管理和訓練墊、水生動物、小動物、爬行動物和寵物鳥類用品，包括玩具、籠子和棲息地、床上用品、食品和補充劑、馬和牲畜產品、動物和家庭健康和昆蟲控制產品、活魚和小動物以及戶外墊子。花園部門包括草坪和花園消耗品，如草、蔬菜、花卉和藥草種子、野鳥飼料、鳥舍和其他觀鳥配件、雜草、草和其他除草劑、殺蟲劑和殺蟲劑產品、肥料和活體植物。該公司由 William E. Brown 於 1980 年創立，總部位於加州核桃溪。

info.description: Liberty One Defensive Dividend Growth ETF seeks capital appreciation and to provide current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that, under normal market conditions, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in a non-diversified portfolio of equity securities of companies that have a strong track record of paying a rising long-term dividend. These securities will typically, but not always be, companies that the Adviser believes are "recession resistant", defensive in nature, and at the time of investment, have a strong track record of paying a rising long-term dividend income stream to investors.
info.description_zh: Liberty One 防禦性股息成長 ETF 尋求資本增值並提供當前收入。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常市場條件下，將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有支付不斷增長的長期股息的良好記錄的公司的非多元化股本證券投資組合。這些證券通常（但並非總是）是顧問認為具有「抗衰退性」、本質上具有防禦性的公司，並且在投資時具有向投資者支付不斷增長的長期股息收入流的良好記錄。

info.description: First Citizens BancShares, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of retail and commercial banking services through its subsidiaries. It operates through the following segments: General Banking, Commercial Banking, Rail, and Corporate. The General Banking delivers services to individuals through branch networks. The Commercial Banking provides lending, leasing and other financial and advisory services to small and middle market companies. The Rail segment deals with the provision of equipment leasing and secured financing for railroads and shippers. The Corporate segment is comprised of investment securities and interest bearing cash. The company was founded on August 7, 1986 and is headquartered in Raleigh, NC.
info.description_zh: First Citizens BancShares, Inc. 是一家銀行控股公司，透過其子公司提供零售和商業銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：一般銀行業務、商業銀行業務、鐵路業務和企業業務。一般銀行業務透過分行網絡向個人提供服務。商業銀行向中小型企業提供貸款、租賃及其他金融和諮詢服務。鐵路部門為鐵路和托運人提供設備租賃和擔保融資。公司部門由投資證券和計息現金組成。該公司成立於1986年8月7日，總部位於北卡羅來納州羅利。

info.description: Woodward, Inc. engages in the design and manufacture of control solutions for the aerospace and industrial markets. It operates through the Aerospace and Industrial segments. The Aerospace segment involves the design, manufacture, services systems, and products for the management of fuel, air, combustion, and motion control. The Industrial segment includes the management of fuel, air, fluids, gases, electricity, motion, and combustion. The company was founded by Amos W. Woodward in 1870 and is headquartered in Fort Collins, CO.
info.description_zh: Woodward, Inc. 致力於為航空航太和工業市場設計和製造控制解決方案。它透過航空航天和工業部門運作。航空航天部門涉及燃料、空氣、燃燒和運動控制管理的設計、製造、服務系統和產品。工業部分包括燃料、空氣、液體、氣體、電力、運動和燃燒的管理。該公司由 Amos W. Woodward 於 1870 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州柯林斯堡。

info.description: Masco Corp. designs, manufactures, and distributes branded home improvement and building products. It operates through the Plumbing Products and Decorative Architectural Products segments. The Plumbing Products segment includes faucets, showerheads, handheld showers, valves, bath hardware and accessories, bathing units, shower bases and enclosures, shower drains, steam shower systems, sinks, kitchen accessories, and toilets. The Decorative Architectural Products segment focuses on architectural coatings, including paints, primers, specialty coatings, stains and waterproofing products, and paint applicators and accessories. The company was founded by Alex Manoogian in 1929 and is headquartered in Livonia, MI.
info.description_zh: Masco Corp. 設計、製造和分銷品牌家居裝修和建築產品。它透過管道產品和裝飾建築產品部門運作。水暖產品部門包括水龍頭、淋浴頭、手持花灑、閥門、浴室五金和配件、沐浴裝置、淋浴底座和外殼、淋浴排水管、蒸汽淋浴系統、水槽、廚房配件和馬桶。裝飾建築產品部門專注於建築塗料，包括油漆、底漆、特殊塗料、著色劑和防水產品以及塗漆器和配件。該公司由 Alex Manoogian 於 1929 年創立，總部位於密西根州利沃尼亞。

info.description: Orrstown Financial Services, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of consumer and business financial services. It also offers commercial banking and trust business services which involves accepting demand, time and savings deposits, and granting loans. The company was founded on November 17, 1987 and is headquartered in Harrisburg, PA.
info.description_zh: Orrstown Financial Services, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供消費者和商業金融服務。它還提供商業銀行和信託業務服務，包括接受活期存款、定期存款和儲蓄存款以及發放貸款。該公司成立於1987年11月17日，總部位於賓州哈里斯堡。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLRE ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLRE Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the real estate sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLRE ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLRE 指數表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場房地產行業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Regions Financial Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in providing consumer and commercial banking, wealth management, and mortgage products and services. It operates through the following segments: Corporate Bank, Consumer Bank, Wealth Management, and Other. The Corporate Bank segment represents the commercial banking functions including commercial and industrial, commercial real estate, and investor real estate lending. The Consumer Bank segment holds the branch network, including consumer banking products and services related to residential first mortgages, home equity lines and loans, small business loans, indirect loans, consumer credit cards, and other consumer loans. The Wealth Management segment offers individuals, businesses, governmental institutions and non-profit entities a range of solutions to help protect, grow and transfer wealth. The Other segment includes its treasury function, the securities portfolio, wholesale funding activities, interest rate risk management activities, and other corporate functions that are not related to a strategic business unit. The company was founded on June 26, 1970 and is headquartered in Birmingham, AL.
info.description_zh: Regions Financial Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供消費者和商業銀行業務、財富管理以及抵押貸款產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：企業銀行、消費者銀行、財富管理和其他部門。企業銀行部門代表商業銀行職能，包括商業和工業、商業房地產和投資者房地產貸款。消費者銀行部門擁有分行網絡，包括與住宅第一抵押貸款、房屋淨值額度和貸款、小型企業貸款、間接貸款、消費信用卡和其他消費貸款相關的消費銀行產品和服務。財富管理部門為個人、企業、政府機構和非營利實體提供一系列解決方案，協助保護、成長和轉移財富。其他部門包括其財務職能、證券投資組合、批發融資活動、利率風險管理活動以及與策略業務部門無關的其他公司職能。該公司成立於 1970 年 6 月 26 日，總部位於阿拉巴馬州伯明罕。

info.description: Northeast Community Bancorp, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of a comprehensive line of banking products and services, including mobile banking, commercial real estate loans, commercial construction financing, lines of credit, and term loans. Its business banking services include remote deposit, online banking and bill payment, online financial management tools, ACH services, business checking, sweep accounts, overdraft protection, and wealth management services. The company was founded on July 5, 2006 and is headquartered in White Plains, NY.
info.description_zh: Northeast Community Bancorp, Inc. 是一家銀行控股公司，提供全面的銀行產品和服務，包括行動銀行、商業房地產貸款、商業建築融資、信貸額度和定期貸款。其商業銀行服務包括遠端存款、網路銀行和帳單支付、線上財務管理工具、ACH服務、業務支票、掃帳、透支保護和財富管理服務。該公司成立於2006年7月5日，總部位於紐約州懷特普萊恩斯。

info.description: The Home Depot, Inc. engages in the sale of building materials and home improvement products. Its products include building materials, home improvement products, lawn and garden products and decor products. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: U.S., Canada and Mexico. It offers home improvement installation services, and tool and rental equipment. The company was founded by Bernard Marcus, Arthur M. Blank, Kenneth Gerald Langone and Pat Farrah on June 29, 1978 and is headquartered at Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: The Home Depot, Inc. 從事建築材料和家居裝修產品的銷售。其產品包括建築材料、家居裝修產品、草坪和花園產品以及裝飾產品。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、加拿大和墨西哥。它提供家居裝修安裝服務以及工具和租賃設備。該公司由 Bernard Marcus、Arthur M. Blank、Kenneth Gerald Langone 和 Pat Farrah 於 1978 年 6 月 29 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: SMI 3Fourteen Full-Cycle Trend ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is actively managed and typically owns 20 domestic stocks that are normally included in the S&P 500 Index ("S&P 500"). The FCT strategy is based on a proprietary model developed by 3Fourteen that selects stocks based on quality stock screens and trend factors such as return on capital and cash flow stability, earnings growth, return on investment, momentum, linear regression and trend analysis. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SMI 341全週期趨勢ETF尋求長期資本增值。該基金採用主動式管理方式，通常持有 20 隻通常納入標準普爾 500 指數（「標準普爾 500」）的國內股票。 FCT策略是基於3Fourteen開發的專有模型，該模型根據優質股票篩選和趨勢因素（例如資本回報率和現金流穩定性、獲利成長、投資回報率、動量、線性回歸和趨勢分析）選擇股票。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: U.S. Bancorp operates as a bank holding company, which offers financial services including lending and depository services, cash management, foreign exchange and trust and investment management. The firm also offers mortgage, refinance, auto, boat and RV loans, credit lines, credit card services, merchant, bank, checking and savings accounts, debit cards, online and mobile banking, ATM processing, mortgage banking, insurance, brokerage and leasing services. The company was founded on April 2, 1929, and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: U.S. Bancorp 作為一家銀行控股公司運營，提供金融服務，包括貸款和存款服務、現金管理、外匯和信託以及投資管理。該公司還提供抵押貸款、再融資、汽車、船舶和房車貸款、信貸額度、信用卡服務、商業、銀行、支票和儲蓄帳戶、借記卡、線上和行動銀行、ATM 處理、抵押銀行、保險、經紀和租賃服務。該公司成立於 1929 年 4 月 2 日，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: Regency Centers Corp. operates as a real estate investment trust, which engages in the ownership, operation, and development of retail shopping centers. Its portfolio includes thriving properties merchandised with highly productive grocers, restaurants, service providers, and best-in-class retailers that connect to its neighborhoods, communities, and customers. The company was founded by Martin Edward Stein, Sr. and Joan Wellhouse Newton in 1963 and is headquartered in Jacksonville, FL.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 零售
info.description_zh: Regency Centers Corp. 以房地產投資信託公司經營，從事零售購物中心的所有權、營運和開發。其投資組合包括與高生產力的雜貨店、餐廳、服務提供者和一流零售商銷售的蓬勃發展的房產，這些零售商與鄰裡、社區和客戶建立了聯繫。該公司由 Martin Edward Stein, Sr. 和 Joan Wellhouse Newton 於 1963 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州傑克遜維爾。

info.description: Amalgamated Financial Corp. operates as a holding company for Amalgamated Bank. It offers commercial and retail banking, investment management, and trust custody segments. The company was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Amalgamated Financial Corp. 以 Amalgamated Bank 的控股公司營運。它提供商業和零售銀行、投資管理和信託託管業務。該公司成立於 1923 年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: WisdomTree U.S. SmallCap Quality Dividend Growth Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the WisdomTree U.S. SmallCap Quality Dividend Growth Index. The index is a fundamentally weighted index that consists of the small-capitalization segment of dividend-paying U.S. common stocks with growth characteristics. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets (exclusive of collateral held from securities lending) will be invested in component securities of the index and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of such component securities. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 美國小型股優質股息成長基金旨在追蹤 WisdomTree 美國小型股優質股利成長指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。該指數是一個基本面加權指數，由具有成長特徵的派息美國普通股的小型股組成。一般情況下，基金總資產（不包括證券借貸抵押品）的至少80%將投資於該指數的組成證券以及與該組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Amgen, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery, development, manufacture, and marketing of human therapeutics. The company was founded by William K. Bowes, Jr., Franklin Pitcher Johnson, Jr., George B. Rathmann, and Joseph Rubinfeld on April 8, 1980 and is headquartered in Thousand Oaks, CA.
info.description_zh: 安進公司是一家生技公司，從事人類治療藥物的發現、開發、製造和行銷。該公司由 William K. Bowes, Jr.、Franklin Pitcher Johnson, Jr.、George B. Rathmann 和 Joseph Rubinfeld 於 1980 年 4 月 8 日創立，總部位於加州千橡市。

info.description: Citizens Financial Group, Inc. engages in the provision of commercial banking services. It operates through the Consumer Banking and Commercial Banking segments. The Consumer Banking segment includes deposit products, mortgage and home equity lending, student loans, auto financing, credit cards, business loans, and wealth management and investment services. The Commercial Banking segment offers lending and leasing, trade financing, deposit and treasury management, foreign exchange and interest rate risk management, corporate finance, and debt, and equity capital markets. The company was founded in 1828 and is headquartered in Providence, RI.
info.description_zh: Citizens Financial Group, Inc. 從事提供商業銀行服務。它透過消費者銀行和商業銀行部門運作。消費者銀行業務部門包括存款產品、抵押貸款和房屋淨值貸款、學生貸款、汽車融資、信用卡、商業貸款以及財富管理和投資服務。商業銀行部門提供貸款和租賃、貿易融資、存款和財務管理、外匯和利率風險管理、企業融資以及債務和股權資本市場。該公司成立於 1828 年，總部位於羅德島州普羅維登斯。

info.description: Jpmorgan Healthcare Leaders ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund will invest primarily in equity securities issued by pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare services, healthcare technology, medical technology and life sciences companies which the adviser believes are leaders and where the magnitude and/or duration of future growth for these companies is underappreciated by the market. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in the equity securities of healthcare companies.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通醫療保健領袖 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金將主要投資於製藥、生物技術、醫療保健服務、醫療保健技術、醫療技術和生命科學公司發行的股票證券，顧問認為這些公司處於領先地位，並且這些公司未來成長的規模和/或持續時間被市場低估。一般情況下，該基金至少80%的資產投資於醫療保健公司的股權證券。

info.description: East West Bancorp, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It operates through the following business segments: Consumer and Business Banking, Commercial Banking, and Other. The Consumer and Business Banking segment provides financial service products and services to consumer and commercial customers through the company's branch network in the U.S. The Commercial Banking segment primarily focuses on commercial loans and deposits. The Other segment includes treasury activities of the company and elimination of inter-segment amounts. The company was founded on August 26, 1998 and is headquartered in Pasadena, CA.
info.description_zh: East West Bancorp, Inc.是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供金融服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：消費者和商業銀行業務、商業銀行業務和其他業務。消費者和商業銀行部門透過該公司在美國的分行網路向消費者和商業客戶提供金融服務產品和服務。商業銀行部門主要專注於商業貸款和存款。其他部門包括公司的財務活動和部門間金額的抵銷。該公司成立於1998年8月26日，總部位於加州帕薩迪納。

info.description: Cincinnati Financial Corp. engages in providing property casualty and life insurance services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Lines Insurance, Personal Lines Insurance, Excess and Surplus Lines Insurance, Life Insurance, and Investments. The Commercial Lines Insurance segment includes commercial casualty, commercial property, commercial auto, worker's compensation, and other commercial lines insurance. The Personal Lines Insurance segment manages personal auto, homeowner, and other personal lines insurance. The Excess and Surplus Lines Insurance segment covers business risks such as the nature of the business or its claim history, that are difficult to profitably insure in the standard commercial lines market. The Life Insurance segment offers term life insurance, universal life insurance, worksite products, and whole life insurance services. The Investment segment generates revenue from the fixed-maturity investment and equity investment. The company was founded by John Jack Schiff Sr., Robert Cleveland Schiff, and Harry M. Turner in 1968 and is headquartered in Fairfield, OH.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: 辛辛那提金融公司从事提供财产伤亡和人寿保险服务。它通过以下部门运营：商业保险、个人保险、超额和盈余保险、人寿保险和投资。商业保险部门包括商业伤亡保险、商业财产保险、商业汽车保险、工人赔偿保险和其他商业保险。个人保险部门管理个人汽车保险、房主保险和其他个人保险。超額和盈餘險種保險部門承保業務性質或其索賠歷史等商業風險，這些風險在標準商業險種市場上很難獲得盈利。人寿保险部门提供定期人寿保险、万能人寿保险、工地产品和终身人寿保险服务。投资部门通过固定期限投资和股权投资产生收入。该公司由 John Jack Schiff Sr.、Robert Cleveland Schiff 和 Harry M. Turner 于 1968 年创立，总部位于俄亥俄州费尔菲尔德。

info.description: CB Financial Services, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial solutions. The company operates through the Community Banking and Insurance Brokerage Services segments. It offers residential and commercial real estate loans, commercial and industrial loans, and consumer loans as well as a variety of deposit products for individuals and businesses. The company was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Carmichaels, PA.
info.description_zh: CB Financial Services, Inc.是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供金融解決方案。該公司透過社區銀行和保險經紀服務部門運作。它為個人和企業提供住宅和商業房地產貸款、商業和工業貸款、消費貸款以及各種存款產品。該公司成立於 1901 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州卡邁克爾斯。

info.description: Cintas Corp. engages in the provision of corporate identity uniforms through rental and sales programs. It operates through the following segments: Uniform Rental and Facility Services, First Aid and Safety Services, and All Other. The Uniform Rental and Facility Services segment consists of the rental and servicing of uniforms and other garments including flame resistant clothing, mats, mops and shop towels, and other ancillary items. The First Aid and Safety Services segment includes first aid and safety products and services. The All Other segment contains fire protection services and its direct sale business. The company was founded by Richard T. Farmer in 1968 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Cintas Corp. 透過租賃和銷售計劃提供企業形象制服。它透過以下部門運作：制服租賃和設施服務部門、急救和安全服務部門以及所有其他部門。制服租賃和設施服務部門包括制服和其他服裝的租賃和服務，包括阻燃服裝、墊子、拖把和抹布以及其他輔助物品。急救和安全服務部門包括急救和安全產品和服務。所有其他部門包括消防服務及其直銷業務。該公司由 Richard T. Farmer 於 1968 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: Portfolio Building Block World Pharma And Biotech Index ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the BITA Global Pharma and Biotech Select Index. The fund uses a "passive management" approach to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index is constructed using a rules-based methodology that identifies companies in the pharmaceutical and/or biotechnology industries with publicly traded ordinary shares listed on major stock exchanges in developed markets, as classified by BITA GmbH. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of the fund's net assets in component securities that make up the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 投資組合建構模組世界製藥和生技指數 ETF 旨在追蹤 BITA 全球製藥和生技精選指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該基金採用「被動管理」方法來追蹤該指數未計費用和開支之前的表現。該指數採用基於規則的方法構建，該方法識別在已開發市場主要證券交易所上市的公開交易普通股的製藥和/或生物技術行業的公司（按 BITA GmbH 的分類）。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的基金淨資產投資於構成指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Financials ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Financials & Real Estate Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC (the "index provider") compiles, maintains and calculates the underlying index, which is designed to measure the performance of securities of small-capitalization U.S. companies in the financials and real estate sectors, as defined by the Global Industry Classification Standard ("GICS  ").
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap Financials ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Financials & Real Estate Index 的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常會將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。 S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC（「指數提供者」）嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算基礎指數，該指數旨在衡量全球行業分類標準（「GICS」）定義的金融和房地產領域美國小型公司證券的表現。

info.description: CECO Environmental Corp. engages in the provision of engineering technology and solutions. It offers services in the field of environment, energy, fluid handling, and filtration. The firm operates through the following segments: Engineered Systems and Industrial Process Solutions segment. The Engineered Systems segment serves the power generation, hydrocarbon processing, water/wastewater treatment, oily water separation and treatment, marine and naval vessels, and midstream oil and gas sectors. The Industrial Process Solutions segment serves the broad industrial sector with solutions for air pollution and contamination control, fluid handling, and process filtration in applications such as aluminum beverage can production, automobile production, food and beverage processing, semiconductor fabrication, electronics production, steel and aluminum mill processing, wood manufacturing, desalination, and aquaculture markets. The company was founded by Phillip DeZwirek in 1966 and is headquartered in Addison, TX.
info.description_zh: 希柯環保股份有限公司從事提供工程技術和解決方案。它提供環境、能源、流體處理和過濾領域的服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：工程系統和工業過程解決方案部門。工程系統部門服務於發電、碳氫化合物加工、水/廢水處理、含油水分離和處理、船舶和中游石油和天然氣領域。工業製程解決方案部門為廣泛的工業領域提供空氣污染和污染控制、流體處理和製程過濾解決方案，應用於鋁製飲料罐生產、汽車生產、食品和飲料加工、半導體製造、電子產品生產、鋼鐵和鋁廠加工、木材製造、海水淡化和水產養殖市場。該公司由 Phillip DeZwirek 於 1966 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州艾迪生。

info.description: Camden National Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services to individuals and companies through its subsidiary, Camden National Bank. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Camden, ME.
info.description_zh: 卡姆登國家銀行 (Camden National Corp.) 是一家銀行控股公司，透過其子公司卡姆登國家銀行 (Camden National Bank) 向個人和公司提供金融服務。該公司成立於 1984 年，總部位於緬因州卡姆登。

info.description: First Northwest Bancorp is a bank holding company which engages in the provision of commercial, mortgage, and lending activities and investment. Its offerings include saving accounts, certificate of deposits, money market, credit cards, fixed rate loans, mortgages, mutual funds, insurances and education savings accounts. The company was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Port Angeles, WA.
info.description_zh: First Northwest Bancorp 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供商業、抵押貸款、貸款活動和投資。其產品包括儲蓄帳戶、存款單、貨幣市場、信用卡、固定利率貸款、抵押貸款、共同基金、保險和教育儲蓄帳戶。該公司成立於 1923 年，總部位於華盛頓州安吉利斯港。

info.description: Direxion Daily PLTR Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of PLTR. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X daily inverse (opposite) or short exposure to PLTR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily PLTR Bear 1X Shares 尋求與 PLTR 每日表現相反（或相反）的 100% 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和選擇權，這些金融工具結合起來提供 1 倍的每日反向（相反）或空頭 PLTR 敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WD-40 Co. is a global marketing organization, which engages in the development and sale of products for workshops, factories, and homes. Its brands include WD-40 Multi-Use Product, WD-40 Specialist, 3-IN-ONE, GT85, X-14, 2000 Flushes, Carpet Fresh, no vac, Spot Shot, 1001, Lava and Solvol. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), and Asia-Pacific. The company was founded by Norman Bernard Larsen, Sam Crivello, Gordon Dawson, and John B. Gregory on September 23, 1953 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: WD-40 Co.是一家全球行銷組織，從事車間、工廠和家庭產品的開發和銷售。其品牌包括 WD-40 Multi-Use Product、WD-40 Specialist、3-IN-ONE、GT85、X-14、2000 Flushes、Carpet Fresh、no vac、Spot Shot、1001、Lava 和 Solvol。該公司在以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲 (EMEA) 以及亞太地區。該公司由 Norman Bernard Larsen、Sam Crivello、Gordon Dawson 和 John B. Gregory 於 1953 年 9 月 23 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: VictoryShares Dividend Accelerator ETF seeks to provide investment results that track the performance of the Nasdaq Victory Dividend Accelerator Index before fees and expenses. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its assets in securities included in the Nasdaq Victory Dividend Accelerator Index (the "index"). The index utilizes a rules-based approach designed to identify dividend paying stocks with a higher likelihood of future dividend growth.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares Dividend Accelerator ETF 尋求提供追蹤納斯達克勝利股息加速器指數（未計費用和開支）表現的投資結果。該基金尋求透過在正常市場條件下將其至少 80% 的資產投資於那斯達克勝利股息加速器指數（「指數」）所包含的證券來實現其投資目標。該指數採用基於規則的方法，旨在識別未來股息成長可能性較高的派息股票。

info.description: Horizon Kinetics Medical ETF seeks to provide long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that pursues its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in common stocks, convertible securities, warrants and other equity securities having the characteristics of common stocks of U.S. and foreign companies engaged in medical research, pharmaceutical and medical technology industries and related technology industries. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n Kinetics Medical ETF 致力於提供長期的資本成長。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，透過將至少80%的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款投資於從事醫學研究、製藥和醫療技術行業及相關技術行業的美國和外國公司的普通股、可轉換證券、認股權證和其他具有普通股特徵的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: thredUP, Inc. operates as an online clothing resale platform for apparel, shoes, and accessories. Its brands include J.Crew, Ann Taylor, Banana Republic, Lululemon Athletica, Talbots, and Madewell. It operates through the United States and Others geographical segments. The company was founded by James Reinhart, Chris Homer, and Oliver Lubin in January 2009 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: thredUP, Inc. 是一家線上服裝轉售平台，銷售服裝、鞋子和配件。其品牌包括 J.Crew、Ann Taylor、Banana Republic、Lululemon Athletica、Talbots 和 Madewell。它透過美國和其他地區的地理部門開展業務。該公司由 James Reinhart、Chris Homer 和 Oliver Lubin 於 2009 年 1 月創立，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: Invesco KBW Property & Casualty Insurance ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the KBW Nasdaq Property & Casualty IndexTM (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is a modified-market capitalization-weighted index designed to track the performance of companies primarily engaged in U.S. property and casualty insurance activities, as determined by the index provider. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco KBW Property & Casualty Insurance ETF 旨在追蹤 KBW Nasdaq Property & Casualty Index™（「基本指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數是修正市值加權指數，旨在追蹤主要從事美國財產和傷亡保險活動的公司的業績，由指數提供者決定。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Dividend Strength ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Dividend Strength Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the common stocks and real estate investment trusts ("REITs") that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to well-capitalized companies with a history of increasing their dividends. The term "well-capitalized" reflects companies that have strong balance sheets with durable cash flow and a record of profitability.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dividend Strength ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為「股息強度指數」的指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和房地產投資信託基金（「REIT」）。該指數旨在為資本充足且有增加股息歷史的公司提供投資機會。 「資本充足」一詞反映了公司擁有強大的資產負債表、持久的現金流量和獲利記錄。

info.description: Chenghe Acquisition III Co. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 4, 2024 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Chenghe Acquisition III Co.是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年6月4日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: GCM Grosvenor, Inc. provides global alternative asset management solutions. The firm invests on behalf of clients who seek allocations to alternative investments, such as private equity, infrastructure, real estate, credit, and absolute return strategies. It specializes in developing customized portfolios for clients who want an active role in the development of their alternatives programs and also offers multi-client portfolios for investors who desire a turn-key solution for accessing alternative investments. The company's offerings include multi-manager portfolios as well as portfolios of direct investments and co-investments. GCM Grosvenor has offices in New York, Los Angeles, London, Tokyo, Hong Kong, and Seoul. GCM Grosvenor was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: GCM Grosvenor, Inc. 提供全球另類資產管理解決方案。該公司代表尋求另類投資配置的客戶進行投資，例如私募股權、基礎設施、房地產、信貸和絕對回報策略。它專門為希望在另類投資項目開發中發揮積極作用的客戶開發客製化投資組合，並為希望獲得另類投資交鑰匙解決方案的投資者提供多客戶投資組合。該公司的產品包括多管理人投資組合以及直接投資和共同投資組合。 GCM Grosvenor 在紐約、洛杉磯、倫敦、東京、香港和首爾設有辦事處。 GCM Grosvenor 成立於 1971 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Ingles Markets, Inc. engages in the operation of a supermarket chain in Georgia, North Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia, and Alabama. It offers its products through the following categories: grocery, non-foods, perishables and other. The grocery products consist of groceries, dairy, and frozen foods. The non-foods products include alcoholic beverages, tobacco, pharmacy, health, beauty, and cosmetic products. The perishable products include meat, produce, deli, and bakery. The other category consists of fluid dairy operations and shopping center rentals. The company was founded by Robert P. Ingle in 1963 and is headquartered in Black Mountain, NC.
info.description_zh: Ingles Markets, Inc. 在喬治亞州、北卡羅來納州、田納西州、維吉尼亞州和阿拉巴馬州從事連鎖超市的經營。它提供以下類別的產品：雜貨、非食品、易腐爛食品等。雜貨產品包括雜貨、乳製品和冷凍食品。非食品產品包括酒精飲料、菸草、藥品、保健、美容和化妝品。易腐爛的產品包括肉類、農產品、熟食店和麵包店。另一類包括流體乳製品業務和購物中心租賃。該公司由 Robert P. Ingle 於 1963 年創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州黑山。

info.description: United Bankshares, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and retail banking services and products. It operates through the following segments: Community Banking, Mortgage Banking, and Other. The Community Banking segment consists of both commercial and consumer lending and provides customers with such products as commercial loans, real estate loans, business financing, and consumer loans. The Mortgage Banking segment focuses on the origination and acquisition of residential mortgages for sale into the secondary market through United's mortgage banking subsidiaries, George Mason and Crescent. The Other segment includes financial information not directly attributable to a specific segment, including interest income from investments and net securities gains or losses of parent companies and their non-banking subsidiaries. The company was founded in 1839 and is headquartered in Charleston, WV.
info.description_zh: United Bankshares, Inc.是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供商業和零售銀行服務和產品。它透過以下部門運作：社區銀行、抵押貸款銀行和其他部門。社區銀行業務包括商業貸款和消費貸款，為客戶提供商業貸款、房地產貸款、企業融資和消費貸款等產品。抵押貸款銀行業務部門專注於發起和收購住宅抵押貸款，並透過 United 的抵押貸款銀行子公司 George Mason 和 Crescent 出售到二級市場。其他部門包括不直接歸屬於特定部門的財務信息，包括投資利息收入以及母公司及其非銀行子公司的淨證券損益。該公司成立於 1839 年，總部位於西維吉尼亞州查爾斯頓。

info.description: Dorman Products, Inc. engages in the supply of automotive replacement and upgrade parts for the motor vehicle aftermarket industry. Its products include automotive body, steering and suspension, undercar, underhood, hardware and accessories, and heavy-duty components. The company was founded by Steven L. Berman and Richard N. Berman on October 16, 1978 and is headquartered in Colmar, PA.
info.description_zh: Dorman Products, Inc. 致力於為機動車輛售後市場產業供應汽車更換和升級零件。其產品包括汽車車身、轉向和懸吊、車底、引擎蓋、硬體和配件以及重型零件。該公司由 Steven L. Berman 和 Richard N. Berman 於 1978 年 10 月 16 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州科爾馬。

info.description: Invesco BuyBack Achievers ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the NASDAQ US BuyBack AchieversTM Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The NASDAQ includes common stocks in the underlying index pursuant to a proprietary selection methodology that identifies a universe of "BuyBack Achievers TM".
info.description_zh: Invesco BuyBack Achievers ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克美國 BuyBack AchieversTM 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。納斯達克根據專有的選擇方法將普通股納入基礎指數中，該方法確定了「BuyBack Achievers TM」的範圍。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Health Care ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of health care companies. The manager defines health care companies as companies engaged in health care innovations, such as developing new and effective therapies; pharmaceuticals; biotechnology; life sciences tools and services; managed health care; and/or health care equipment, supplies, providers, services, distributors, and facilities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price 醫療保健 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於醫療保健公司的證券。這位經理將醫療保健公司定義為從事醫療保健創新的公司，例如開發新的有效療法；藥品；生物技術；生命科學工具和服務；管理醫療保健；和/或醫療保健設備、用品、提供者、服務、分銷商和設施。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Darden Restaurants, Inc. is a full-service restaurant company, which engages in the provision of restaurant services. It operates through the following segments: Olive Garden, LongHorn Steakhouse, Fine Dining, and Other Business. The Olive Garden segment is the largest full-service dining Italian restaurant operator. The LongHorn Steakhouse segment includes the results of the company-owned LongHorn Steakhouse restaurants. The Fine Dining segment consists of the premium brands that operate within the fine-dining sub-segment of full-service dining and includes the results of its company-owned The Capital Grille and Eddie V's restaurants. The Other Business segment aggregates the remaining brands and includes the results of its company-owned Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen, Yard House, Seasons 52 and Bahama Breeze restaurants, and from franchises and consumer-packaged goods sales. The company was founded by William B. Darden in 1938 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: Darden Dinings, Inc. 是一家提供全方位服務的餐廳公司，提供餐廳服務。它透過以下部門運作：Olive Garden、LongHorn Steakhouse、Fine Dining 和其他業務。 Olive Garden 部門是最大的全方位服務義大利餐廳營運商。 LongHorn Steakhouse 部門包括公司擁有的 LongHorn Steakhouse 餐廳的表現。高級餐飲部門由在全方位服務餐飲的高級餐飲子部門運營的優質品牌組成，包括其公司擁有的 The Capital Grille 和 Eddie V's 餐廳的業績。其他業務部門匯總了其餘品牌，包括公司擁有的 Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen、Yard House、Seasons 52 和 Bahama Breeze 餐廳以及特許經營和消費品銷售的表現。該公司由 William B. Darden 於 1938 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: Genuine Parts Co. engages in the distribution of automotive and industrial replacement parts. It operates through the following segments: Automotive Parts Group, Industrial Parts Group, and Corporate. The Automotive Parts Group segment distributes replacement parts, other than body parts for substantially all makes and models of automobiles, trucks, and other vehicles. The Industrial Parts Group segment offers a range of industrial bearings, mechanical and fluid power transmission equipment, including hydraulic and pneumatic products, material handling components, and related parts and supplies. The company was founded by Carlyle Fraser on May 7, 1928, and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Genuine Parts Co. 從事汽車和工業替換零件的分銷。它透過以下部門運作：汽車零件部門、工業零件部門和企業部門。汽車零件集團部門為幾乎所有品牌和型號的汽車、卡車和其他車輛分銷車身零件以外的替換零件。工業零件集團部門提供一系列工業軸承、機械和流體動力傳輸設備，包括液壓和氣動產品、物料搬運組件以及相關零件和用品。該公司由凱雷·弗雷澤 (Carlyle Fraser) 於 1928 年 5 月 7 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Lockheed Martin Corp. is a global security and aerospace company, which engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, integration, and sustainment of technology systems, products, and services. It operates through the following business segments: Aeronautics, Missiles and Fire Control (MFC), Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS), and Space. The Aeronautics segment researches, designs, develops, manufactures, integrates, sustains, supports, and upgrades advanced military aircraft, including combat and air mobility aircraft, unmanned air vehicles, and related technologies. The MFC segment is involved in air and missile defense systems, tactical missiles and air-to-ground precision strike weapon systems, logistics, fire control systems, mission operations support, readiness, engineering support and integration services, manned and unmanned ground vehicles, and energy management solutions. The RMS segment designs, manufactures, services, and supports various military and commercial helicopters, surface ships, sea and land-based missile defense systems, radar systems, sea and air-based mission and combat systems, command and control mission solutions, cyber solutions, and simulation and training solutions. The Space segment includes the production of satellites, space transportation systems, and strategic, advanced strike, and defensive systems. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: 洛克希德馬丁公司是一家全球安全和航空航太公司，從事技術系統、產品和服務的研究、設計、開發、製造、整合和維護。該公司透過以下業務部門運作：航空、飛彈和火控（MFC）、旋轉和任務系統（RMS）以及航太。航空部門研究、設計、開發、製造、整合、維護、支援和升級先進軍用飛機，包括戰鬥和空中機動飛機、無人機和相關技術。 MFC部門涉及防空和飛彈防禦系統、戰術飛彈和空對地精確打擊武器系統、後勤、火控系統、任務行動支援、戰備、工程支援和整合服務、有人和無人地面車輛以及能源管理解決方案。 RMS部門設計、製造、服務和支援各種軍用和商用直升機、水面艦艇、海基和陸基飛彈防禦系統、雷達系統、海基和空基任務和作戰系統、指揮和控制任務解決方案、網路解決方案以及模擬和訓練解決方案。太空部門包括衛星、太空運輸系統以及戰略、先進打擊和防禦系統的生產。該公司成立於 1995 年，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: The Sherwin-Williams Co. engages in the development, manufacture, distribution, and sale of paint and coatings. It operates through the following segments: Paint Stores Group, Consumer Brands Group, Performance Coatings Group, and Administrative. The Paint Stores Group segment caters to the needs of architectural and industrial paint contractors and do-it-yourself homeowners. The Consumer Brands Group segment manufactures and distributes a broad portfolio of branded and private-label architectural paint, stains, varnishes and other industrial products. The Performance Coatings Group segment develops and sells industrial coatings for wood finishing and general industrial applications. The Administrative segment refers to the administrative expenses and assets of the company's new global headquarters and research and development center, both currently under construction. The company was founded by Henry Sherwin and Edward Williams in 1866 and is headquartered in Cleveland, OH.
info.description_zh: 宣偉公司從事油漆和塗料的開發、製造、分銷和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：油漆店集團、消費品牌集團、高性能塗料集團和行政部門。油漆店集團部門滿足建築和工業油漆承包商以及DIY房主的需求。消費品牌集團部門生產和分銷各種品牌和自有品牌建築塗料、著色劑、清漆和其他工業產品。高性能塗料集團部門開發和銷售用於木材塗飾和一般工業應用的工業塗料。行政部門是指公司目前正在興建的新全球總部和研發中心的行政費用和資產。該公司由 Henry Sherwin 和 Edward Williams 於 1866 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州克利夫蘭。

info.description: Truist Financial Corp. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services to individuals, businesses, and municipalities. It operates through the following segments: Consumer Banking and Wealth, Corporate and Commercial Banking, and Other, Treasury and Corporate. The Consumer Banking and Wealth segment consists of Retail Community Banking, National Consumer Finance, Services, Payments, Wealth Management and Banking Products and Professional Services and Mortgage Banking. The Corporate and Commercial Banking segment consists of Corporate and Investment Banking, Commercial Community Banking and Commercial Real Estate. The Other, Treasury and Corporate segment includes management of the company's investment securities portfolio. The company was founded on December 6, 2019, and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Truist Financial Corp. 是一家金融控股公司，致力於為個人、企業和市政當局提供銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：消費者銀行和財富部門、企業和商業銀行部門以及其他、財務和企業部門。消費者銀行和財富部門包括零售社區銀行、全國消費者金融、服務、支付、財富管理和銀行產品以及專業服務和抵押銀行業務。企業和商業銀行業務部門包括企業和投資銀行業務、商業社區銀行業務和商業房地產業務。其他、財務和企業部門包括公司投資證券投資組合的管理。該公司成立於2019年12月6日，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Target Corp. engages in the operation and ownership of general merchandise stores. It offers food and general merchandise, clothing and household goods, electronics, and toys. Its brands include A New Day, All in Motion, Art Class, Auden, AVA & VIV, Boots and Barkley, Brightroom, Bullseye's Playground, Casaluna, Cat & Jack, Cloud Island, Colsie, dealworthy, Embark, Everspring, Favorite Day, Figmint, Future Collective, Gigglescape, Good & Gather, Goodfellow & Co, Hearth & Hand with Magnolia, Heyday, Hyde & EEK! Boutique, JoyLab, Kindfull, Kona Sol, Made By Design, Market Pantry, Mondo Llama, More Than Magic, Opalhouse, Open Story, Original Use, Pillowfort, Project 62, Room Essentials, Shade & Shore, Smartly, Smith & Hawken, Sonia Kashuk, Spritz, Sun Squad, Threshold, Universal Thread, up&up, Wild Fable, Wondershop, Xhilaration, California Roots, Casa Cantina, The Collection, Headliner, Jingle & Mingle, Rose Bae, Photograph, SunPop, and Wine Cube. The company was founded by George Draper Dayton in 1902 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: Target Corp. 從事百貨公司的經營和所有權。它提供食品和日用商品、服裝和家居用品、電子產品和玩具。旗下品牌包括 A New Day、All in Motion、Art Class、Auden、AVA & VIV、Boots and Barkley、Brightroom、Bullseye's Playground、Casaluna、Cat & Jack、Cloud Island、Colsie、dealworthy、Embark、Everspring、Favorite Day,Hegmint、Fuigga、Figm Magnolia、Heyday、Hyde & EEK! Boutique、JoyLab、Kindfull、Kona Sol、Made By Design、Market Pantry、Mondo Llama、More Than Magic、Opalhouse、Open Story、Original Use、Pillowfort、Project 62、Room Essentials、Shade & Shore. Squad、Threshold、Universal Thread、up&up、Wild Fable、Wondershop、Xhilaration、California Roots、Casa Cantina、 The Collection、Headliner、Jingle & Mingle、Rose Bae、Photograph、SunPop 和 Wine Cube。該公司由 George Draper Dayton 於 1902 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in developing, manufacturing, marketing, and selling technically challenging generic and proprietary injectable, inhalation, and intranasal products, and insulin active pharmaceutical ingredient. It operates through Finished Pharmaceutical Products and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Products segments. The Finished Pharmaceutical Products segment manufactures, markets, and distributes Primatene Mist, enoxaparin, naloxone, phytonadione, lidocaine, and other critical and non-critical care drugs. The Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Products segment offers RHI API and porcine insulin API for external customers and internal product development. The company was founded by Zi-Ping Luo and Yong Feng Zhang on February 29, 1996 and is headquartered in Rancho Cucamonga, CA.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 從事開發、製造、行銷和銷售技術上具有挑戰性的仿製藥和專利注射劑、吸入劑和鼻內產品以及胰島素活性藥物成分。它透過成品藥品和活性藥物成分產品部門運作。藥品成品部門生產、行銷和分銷 Primatene Mist、依諾肝素、納洛酮、植物萘二酮、利多卡因以及其他重症和非重症護理藥物。活性藥物成分產品部門為外部客戶和內部產品開發提供 RHI API 和豬胰島素 API。該公司由羅子平和張永峰於1996年2月29日創立，總部位於加州庫卡蒙加牧場。

info.description: Arcutis Biotherapeutics, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of treatments for dermatological diseases. Its pipeline consists of topical treatments for plaque psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, hand eczema, vitiligo, scalp psoriasis, alopecia areata, and seborrheic dermatitis. The company was founded by Bhaskar Chaudhuri and David W. Osborne in June 2016 and is headquartered in Westlake Village, CA.
info.description_zh: Arcutis Biotherapeutics, Inc. 從事皮膚病治療的開發和商業化。其產品線包括斑塊型乾癬、異位性皮膚炎、手部濕疹、白斑症、頭皮乾癬、斑禿和脂漏性皮膚炎的局部治療。該公司由 Bhaskar Chaudhuri 和 David W. Osborne 於 2016 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州西湖村。

info.description: BGC Group, Inc. engages in the provision of brokerage and financial technology services. It offers trade execution and broker-dealer services specializing in Fixed Income (Rates and Credit), Foreign Exchange, Equities, Energy and Commodities, Shipping, and Futures. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: BGC Group, Inc. 從事提供經紀和金融技術服務。它提供專門從事固定收益（利率和信貸）、外匯、股票、能源和大宗商品、航運和期貨領域的交易執行和經紀自營商服務。該公司成立於2004年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Brighthouse Financial, Inc. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of life insurance and annuities through independent distribution channels and marketing arrangements with a diverse network of distribution partners. It operates through the following segments: Annuities, Life, Run-Off, and Corporate & Others. The Annuities segment product offerings include fixed, structured, income and variable annuities. The Life segment manufactures products to serve its target segments through a broad independent distribution network. The Run-Off segment includes structured settlements, pension risk transfer contracts, certain company-owned life insurance policies, funding agreements and universal life with secondary guarantees. The Corporate & Other segment refers to the general account investments and the separate account assets of the company. The company was founded in June 1863 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Brighthouse Financial, Inc. 作為一家控股公司運營，透過獨立的分銷管道以及與多元化分銷合作夥伴網絡的營銷安排提供人壽保險和年金。它透過以下部門運作：年金部門、人壽部門、徑流部門以及企業及其他部門。年金部門提供的產品包括固定年金、結構性年金、收入年金及可變年金。生活部門生產產品，透過廣泛的獨立分銷網絡服務於其目標部門。 Run-Off 部分包括結構性結算、退休金風險轉移合約、某些公司擁有的人壽保險保單、融資協議和帶有二級擔保的萬能人壽保險。公司及其他部門是指公司的一般帳戶投資和獨立帳戶資產。該公司成立於 1863 年 6 月，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares (R) 2028 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2028 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2028 (collectively, "2028 Bonds").
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares (R) 2028 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2028 指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2028 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2028 年債券」）。

info.description: EA Bridgeway Omni Small-Cap Value ETF seeks to provide long-term total return on capital, primarily through capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in a broad and diverse group of small-cap stocks that the Sub-Adviser determines are value stocks. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in equity or equity-related securities ("common stocks") of small-cap companies at the time of purchase.
info.description_zh: EA Bridgeway Omni Small-Cap Value ETF 致力於主要透過資本增值來提供長期總資本回報。該基金尋求透過主要投資於副顧問確定為價值股票的廣泛且多樣化的小型股來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，基金在購買時將其淨資產（加上投資目的借款）的80%投資於小型公司的股票或股票相關證券（「普通股」）。

info.description: Champions Oncology, Inc. engages in the development and sale of technology solutions and products to personalize the development and use of oncology drugs. Its technology platform, TumorGraft, is a novel approach to personalizing cancer care based upon the implantation of human tumors in immune-deficient mice. The company was founded by James M. Martell and David Sidransky on June 4, 1985 and is headquartered in Hackensack, NJ.
info.description_zh: Champions Oncology, Inc. 從事技術解決方案和產品的開發和銷售，以個性化腫瘤藥物的開發和使用。其技術平台 TumorGraft 是一種基於在免疫缺陷小鼠體內植入人類腫瘤的個人化癌症護理的新方法。該公司由 James M. Martell 和 David Sidransky 於 1985 年 6 月 4 日創立，總部位於新澤西州哈肯薩克。

info.description: Ishares Environmentally Aware Real Estate ETF seeks to track the FTSE EPRA Nareit Developed Green Target Index composed of developed market real estate equities while targeting increased exposure to green certification and energy efficiency relative to the parent index. It invests at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 10% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents, as well as in securities not included in the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Ishares 環境意識房地產 ETF 旨在追蹤由已開發市場房地產股票組成的 FTSE EPRA Nareit 開發綠色目標指數，同時目標是相對於母指數增加綠色認證和能源效率的曝險。其將至少 90% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可將最多 10% 的資產投資於某些期貨、期權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物以及未納入指數的證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust International Developed Cap Strength ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield of an index called The International Developed Capital Strength Index SM. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 90% of its net assets in the common stocks and REITs that comprise the index. The index seeks to provide exposure to well-capitalized companies in the developed markets outside of the U.S. with strong market positions that have the potential to provide their stockholders with a greater degree of stability and performance over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust International Developed Cap Strength ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為「國際開發資本強度指數 SM」的指數的價格和收益率相對應。該基金尋求透過在正常市場條件下將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的普通股和房地產投資信託基金來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在為美國以外已開發市場中資本充足、市場地位穩固的公司提供投資機會，這些公司有可能隨著時間的推移為其股東提供更大程度的穩定性和績效。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: FitLife Brands, Inc. engages in the provision of nutritional supplements for health conscious consumers. Its brands include NDS Nutrition, PMD Sports, SirenLabs, Core Active, Nutrology, Metis Nutrition, iSatori, BioGenetic Laboratories, Energize, Maritime Naturals and MusclePharm. The company was founded by Scott D. Landow on July 26, 2005 and is headquartered in Omaha, NE.
