info.description_zh: FitLife Brands, Inc. 致力於為注重健康的消費者提供營養補充品。其品牌包括 NDS Nutrition、PMD Sports、SirenLabs、Core Active、Nutrology、Metis Nutrition、iSatori、BioGenetic Laboratories、Energize、Maritime Naturals 和 MusclePharm。該公司由 Scott D. Landow 於 2005 年 7 月 26 日創立，總部位於內布拉斯加州奧馬哈。

info.description: Galaxy Digital, Inc. engages in digital assets and data center infrastructure, delivering solutions that accelerate progress in finance and artificial intelligence. It operates through the following segments: Digital Assets, Data Centers, and Treasury and Corporate. The digital assets segment offers institutional access to trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization technology. The Data Centers segment competes with a range of infrastructure providers that are building or repurposing facilities to support the rapidly growing demand for AI and compute-intensive workloads. The Treasury and Corporate segment includes the company's proprietary trading and mining activities, as well as the company's principal investments and related gains and losses. The company was founded by Michael Novogratz in 2018 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Galaxy Digital, Inc. 從事數位資產和資料中心基礎設施業務，提供可加速金融和人工智慧進步的解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：數位資產、資料中心、財務和企業部門。數位資產領域為機構提供交易、諮詢、資產管理、質押、自我託管和代幣化技術的存取權。資料中心部門與一系列基礎設施供應商競爭，這些供應商正在建造或重新利用設施，以支援對人工智慧和運算密集型工作負載快速成長的需求。財務和公司部門包括公司的自營交易和採礦活動，以及公司的主要投資和相關損益。該公司由 Michael Novogratz 於 2018 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: U.S. Global Investors, Inc. engages in the provision of investment advisory services. It operates through the Investment Management Services and Corporate Investments segments. The Investment Management Services segment offers a range of investment management products and services. The Corporate Investments segment invests in its own accounts to add growth and value to its cash position. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in San Antonio, TX.
info.description_zh: U.S. Global Investors, Inc. 從事提供投資諮詢服務。它透過投資管理服務和企業投資部門運作。投資管理服務部門提供一系列投資管理產品和服務。企業投資部門投資自己的帳戶，以增加其現金狀況的成長和價值。該公司成立於 1968 年，總部位於德克薩斯州聖安東尼奧。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2028 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2028 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. treasury bonds maturing in 2028. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2028 and December 15, 2028, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2028 Term Treasury ETF旨在追蹤由2028年到期的美國國債組成的ICE 2028 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index的投資結果。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並將至少90%的資產投資於BFA認為將有助於基金追蹤基礎指數的美國國債。標的指數由計劃於 2028 年 1 月 1 日至 2028 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。

info.description: First Trust International Rising Dividend Achievers ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the Nasdaq International Rising Dividend Achievers Index. Launched in February 2026, the fund targets high-quality, dividend-paying companies in developed markets outside the United States. To qualify for inclusion, companies must demonstrate consistent growth in both dividends and earnings-per-share, while maintaining strong balance sheet health characterized by high cash-to-debt ratios and conservative payout ratios. The fund uses an indexing approach to provide exposure to international "dividend achievers" with the potential for both income and capital appreciation.
info.description_zh: First Trust International Rising Dividend Achievers ETF 是一支被動管理的交易所交易基金，追蹤納斯達克國際 Rising Dividend Achievers 指數。該基金於 2026 年 2 月推出，目標對象為美國以外已開發市場的優質、派息公司。為了獲得入選資格，公司必須表現出股息和每股收益的持續增長，同時保持強勁的資產負債表健康狀況，其特點是高現金債務比率和保守的派息率。該基金採用指數化方法，向具有收入和資本增值潛力的國際「股息實現者」提供投資機會。

info.description: Integrated Media Technology Ltd. is a technology investment, product development and distribution company. It engages in the manufacturing and distribution of 3-dimension display equipment and wholesales audio products. The company was founded on August 8, 2008 and is headquartered in Adelaide, Australia.
info.description_zh: Integrated Media Technology Ltd. 是一家技術投資、產品開發和分銷公司。它從事3D顯示設備的製造和分銷以及音頻產品的批發。公司成立於2008年8月8日，總部位於澳洲阿德雷德。

info.description: Indigo Acquisition Corp. is blank check company for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase and reorganization. Its objective is to identify and acquire an established, profitable company with strong fundamentals and significant upside potential. The company was founded on June 07, 2024 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Indigo Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，旨在進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買和重組。其目標是識別並收購一家基礎雄厚且具有巨大上升潛力的成熟、盈利的公司。該公司成立於 2024 年 6 月 7 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Applied Finance IVS International Large ETF seeks long term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities of large-capitalization companies located in developed markets outside of North America, which generally include markets such as Australia, Austria, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Hong Kong, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Applied Finance IVS International Large ETF 尋求長期資本增值。一般情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於北美以外已開發市場的大市值公司的股權證券，一般包括澳洲、奧地利、比利時、丹麥、芬蘭、法國、德國、香港、愛爾蘭、義大利、日本、盧森堡、荷蘭、紐西蘭、挪威、新加坡、西班牙、瑞典、瑞士和英國等市場。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Kymera Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of human diseases through the development of innovative, highly differentiated medicines. It focuses on discovering and developing novel small-molecule therapeutics that selectively degrade disease-causing proteins by harnessing the body's natural protein degradation system. The company leverages targeted protein degradation (TPD) to develop medicines that address critical health challenges and have the potential to significantly improve patients lives. Its pipeline emphasizes oral small-molecule degraders, offering a new generation of convenient and highly effective therapies. The company was founded by Bruce Lee Booth and Nello Mainolfi on September 29, 2015 and is headquartered in Watertown, MA.
info.description_zh: Kymera Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於透過開發創新、高度差異化的藥物來改變人類疾病的治療方法。它專注於發現和開發新型小分子療法，透過利用人體的天然蛋白質降解系統選擇性地降解致病蛋白質。該公司利用標靶蛋白質降解（TPD）來開發藥物，以解決關鍵的健康挑戰，並有可能顯著改善患者的生活。其產品線強調口服小分子降解劑，提供新一代方便且高效的療法。該公司由李小龍·布斯 (Bruce Lee Booth) 和內洛·邁諾爾菲 (Nello Mainolfi) 於 2015 年 9 月 29 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃特敦。

info.description: Lifestance Health Group, Inc. provides outpatient mental health services. It offers patients a suite of mental health services, including psychiatric evaluations and treatment, psychological, and neuropsychological testing, as well as individual, family, and group therapy. The firm operates outpatient mental health platform as well as offers patients care virtually through its online delivery platform or in-person at its centers in 32 states. The company was founded by Michael K. Lester, Gwen H. Booth and Danish J. Qureshi in 2017 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.description_zh: Lifestance Health Group, Inc. 提供門診心理健康服務。它為患者提供一套心理健康服務，包括精神病學評估和治療、心理和神經心理學測試以及個人、家庭和團體治療。該公司經營門診心理健康平台，並透過其線上交付平台或在 32 個州的中心親自為患者提供虛擬護理。該公司由 Michael K. Lester、Gwen H. Booth 和Danish J. Qureshi 於 2017 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: Lakefront Biotherapeutics is a biotechnology company, which engages in the identification and development of small molecule and antibody therapies. Its clinical pipeline includes filgotinib, GLP3667, Toledo program, and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The company was founded by Onno van de Stolpe, Rudi Pauwels, and Helmuth van Es on June 30, 1999 and is headquartered in Mechelen, Belgium.
info.description_zh: Lakefront Biotherapeutics 是一家生物技術公司，從事小分子和抗體療法的鑑定和開發。其臨床管線包括filgotinib、GLP3667、Toledo計畫、特發性肺纖維化等。該公司由 Onno van de Stolpe、Rudi Pauwels 和 Helmuth van Es 於 1999 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於比利時梅赫倫。

info.description: Lumexa Imaging Holdings, Inc. engages in providing diagnostic imaging services. It focuses on its teleradiology platform, Connexia. It operates through the Outpatient Imaging Centers (Outpatient) and Professional Services (Professional) segments. The Outpatient segment performs imaging studies and provides radiologists' interpretations of those studies. The Professional segment relates to the interpretation of imaging studies. The company was founded on November 14, 2025 and is headquartered in NC, Raleigh.
info.description_zh: Lumexa Imaging Holdings, Inc. 從事提供診斷影像服務。它專注於其遠端放射學平台 Connexia。它透過門診影像中心（門診）和專業服務（專業）部門運作。門診部分進行影像學研究並提供放射科醫師對這些研究的解釋。專業部分涉及影像研究的解釋。該公司成立於2025年11月14日，總部位於北卡羅來納州羅利。

info.description: MBX Biosciences, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of peptide therapies for the treatment of endocrine and metabolic disorders. Its product candidates and programs include MBX 2109, MBX 1416, and obesity portfolio. The company was founded by Peter Kent Hawryluk and Richard D. DiMarchi in August 2018 and is headquartered in Carmel, IN.
info.description_zh: MBX Biosciences, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發用於治療內分泌和代謝紊亂的勝肽療法。其候選產品和項目包括 MBX 2109、MBX 1416 和肥胖產品組合。該公司由 Peter Kent Hawryluk 和 Richard D. DiMarchi 於 2018 年 8 月創立，總部位於印第安納州卡梅爾。

info.description: Mechanics Bancorp is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and consumer banking and real estate lending services. The company was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Walnut Creek, CA.
info.description_zh: Mechanics Bancorp 是一家金融控股公司，從事提供商業和消費銀行以及房地產貸款服務。該公司成立於 1921 年，總部位於加州核桃溪。

info.description: Matthews Emerging Markets Discovery Active ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy enhanced by the use of artificial intelligence. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Matthews Emerging Markets Discovery Active ETF 尋求資本增值。该基金是一只主动管理的交易所交易基金（“ETF”），旨在通过利用人工智能增强的投资策略来实现其投资目标。在正常情况下，该基金将至少80%的净资产（加上任何用于投资目的的借款金额）投资于美国上市大型资本公司的证券。

info.description: MainStreet Bancshares, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of banking solutions through MainStreet Bank. It offers products and services such as checking, deposits, loans, credit cards, mortgages, and savings. It operates through the following segments: Residential, Real Estate Commercial, Construction, Commercial, and Consumer. The company was founded on March 28, 2003 and is headquartered in Fairfax, VA.
info.description_zh: MainStreet Bancshares, Inc. 是一家控股公司，透過 MainStreet Bank 提供銀行解決方案。它提供支票、存款、貸款、信用卡、抵押貸款和儲蓄等產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：住宅部門、房地產商業部門、建築部門、商業部門和消費者部門。該公司成立於2003年3月28日，總部位於維吉尼亞州費爾法克斯。

info.description: Noodles & Co. engages in the business of development and operation of fast-casual restaurants that serve noodle and pasta dishes, soups, salads, and appetizers. It also offers pleasant dining, pick-up, and delivery experiences by quickly preparing fresh food with friendly service. The company was founded by Aaron Kennedy in 1995 and is headquartered in Broomfield, CO.
info.description_zh: Noodles & Co. 從事開發和經營休閒快餐餐廳的業務，供應麵條和麵食、湯、沙拉和開胃菜。它還透過快速準備新鮮食物和友善的服務，提供愉快的用餐、取貨和送貨體驗。該公司由 Aaron Kennedy 於 1995 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州布魯姆菲爾德。

info.description: Northrim Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company. The firm provides personal, business and commercial banking products and services. It operates through the following segments: Community Banking and Home Mortgage Lending. The Community Banking segment offers loan and deposit products to business and consumer customers in the company's market areas. The Home Mortgage Lending segment focuses on the origination and sale of mortgage loans for 1-4 family residential properties. The company was founded on December 4, 1990 and is headquartered in Anchorage, AK.
info.description_zh: Northrim Bancorp, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營。該公司提供個人、企業和商業銀行產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：社區銀行和房屋抵押貸款。社區銀行部門向公司市場領域的企業和消費者客戶提供貸款和存款產品。房屋抵押貸款部門專注於為 1-4 戶住宅物業發放和銷售抵押貸款。該公司成立於1990年12月4日，總部位於阿拉斯加州安克拉治。

info.description: Nutex Health, Inc. engages in the management and operation of healthcare facilities. It operates through the following segments: Hospital Division, Population Health Management Division, and Real State Division. The Hospital Division is involved in developing and operating a network of micro-hospitals, specialty hospitals, and hospital outpatient departments (HOPDs). The Population Health Division establishes and operates provider networks such as independent physician associations (IPAs). The Real State Division owns land and hospital buildings which are leased to hospital entities. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Nutex Health, Inc. 從事醫療保健設施的管理和營運。它透過以下部門運作：醫院部門、人口健康管理部門和房地產部門。醫院部門參與開發和營運微型醫院、專科醫院和醫院門診部 (HOPD) 網路。人口健康部門建立並運作獨立醫師協會 (IPA) 等提供者網路。房地產部門擁有出租給醫院實體的土地和醫院建築。該公司成立於 2011 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Nova Ltd. provides metrology solutions for the semiconductor manufacturing industry. Its product portfolio includes dimensional metrology, modeling & software, materials metrology, and chemical metrology. The company was founded by Giora Dishon and Moshe Finarov in May 1993 and is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel.
info.description_zh: Nova Ltd. 為半導體製造業提供計量解決方案。其產品組合包括尺寸計量、建模和軟體、材料計量和化學計量。該公司由 Giora Dishon 和 Moshe Finarov 於 1993 年 5 月創立，總部位於以色列雷霍沃特。

info.description: OTG Latin America ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation through investments in the equity securities of companies located in Latin America. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (including any borrowings for investment purposes) in Latin American equity securities. These equity securities include the securities of Latin American companies and investment companies that primarily invest in the securities of issuers in, or seek to track the performance of indices based on, Latin American markets. It may invest up to 20% of its assets in countries other than Latin American countries.
info.description_zh: OTG拉丁美洲ETF透過投資位於拉丁美洲的公司的股本證券尋求長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（包括任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於拉丁美洲股票證券。這些股本證券包括拉丁美洲公司和投資公司的證券，這些公司和投資公司主要投資於拉丁美洲市場發行人的證券，或尋求追蹤基於拉丁美洲市場的指數的表現。它可以將最多20%的資產投資於拉丁美洲國家以外的國家。

info.description: Pantages Capital Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on May 31, 2024 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Pantages Capital Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年5月31日，總部位於德拉瓦州威爾明頓。

info.description: CPI Card Group, Inc. is a payments technology company, which engages in the provision of a comprehensive range of payment cards and related digital solutions. It operates through the following segments: Debit and Credit, Prepaid Debit, and Other. The Debit and Credit segment produces secure debit, and credit cards and provides card services for U.S. card-issuing financial institutions. The Prepaid Debit segment offers secure packaging solutions, prepaid debit cards, and other integrated prepaid card services to prepaid program managers in the U.S. The Other segment refers to corporate expenses. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Littleton, CO.
info.description_zh: CPI Card Group, Inc.是一家支付技術公司，提供全面的支付卡及相關數位解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：借記和貸記、預付借記和其他部門。金融卡和信用卡部門生產安全金融卡和信用卡，並為美國發卡金融機構提供卡片服務。預付費簽帳部門為美國的預付費專案經理提供安全包裝解決方案、預付費簽帳卡和其他整合預付費卡服務。其他部門涉及企業支出。該公司成立於 1982 年，總部位於科羅拉多州利特爾頓。

info.description: VanEck Pharmaceutical ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS US Listed Pharmaceutical 25 Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The index includes common stocks and depositary receipts of U.S. exchange-listed companies in the pharmaceutical industry. Such companies may include medium-capitalization companies and foreign companies that are listed on a U.S. exchange. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Pharmaceutical ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製 MVIS 美國上市製藥 25 指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。該指數包括美國交易所上市的製藥業公司的普通股和存託憑證。此類公司可能包括中等資本公司和在美國交易所上市的外國公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: RockCreek Global Equality ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest in equity securities of companies that have demonstrated a commitment to managing their organizations with a gender-balance approach (e.g., seeking gender balance across its management or employees). The fund will typically invest in common and preferred stocks, ADRs, and GDRs of companies located in a number of countries throughout the world, including issuers located in emerging markets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: RockCreek Global Equality ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將投資於那些承諾以性別平衡方式管理其組織的公司的股本證券（例如，尋求管理層或員工之間的性別平衡）。本基金通常投資於全球多個國家（包括新興市場的發行人）公司的普通股和優先股、美國存託憑證（ADR）和全球存託憑證（GDR）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SkyWest, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of scheduled passenger services in the United States of America, Canada, Mexico and the Caribbean. It operates through SkyWest Airlines and SWC and SkyWest Leasing segments. The SkyWest Airlines and SWC segment provides all other revenue and operating expenses. The SkyWest Leasing segment includes revenue attributed to ownership cost earned under the applicable cost and fixed fee flying contracts. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in St. George, UT.
info.description_zh: SkyWest, Inc. 是一家控股公司，在美國、加拿大、墨西哥和加勒比地區提供定期客運服務。該公司透過 SkyWest Airlines、SWC 和 SkyWest Leasing 部門營運。 SkyWest Airlines 和 SWC 部門提供所有其他收入和營運費用。 SkyWest 租賃部門包括根據適用成本和固定費用飛行合約賺取的擁有成本所產生的收入。該公司成立於 1972 年，總部位於猶他州聖喬治。

info.description: Spark I Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on July 12, 2021 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Spark I Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2021 年 7 月 12 日，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Latham Group, Inc. operates as a designer, manufacturer, and marketer of in-ground residential swimming pools in North America, Australia, and New Zealand. It offers a portfolio of pools and related products, including in-ground swimming pools, pool liners, and pool covers. The company was founded on December 6, 2018 and is headquartered in Latham, NY.
info.description_zh: Latham Group, Inc. 在北美、澳洲和紐西蘭從事地下住宅游泳池的設計、製造和行銷。它提供一系列泳池及相關產品，包括地下游泳池、泳池襯墊和泳池蓋。該公司成立於2018年12月6日，總部位於紐約州萊瑟姆。

info.description: Cambria Tax Aware ETF seeks to provide a tax-efficient investment return consisting of capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchanged-traded fund ("ETF") that invests in U.S.-listed equity securities that have a market capitalization of greater than $5 billion. Utilizing its own quantitative model, the fund's investment sub-adviser, Cambria Investment Management, L.P. ("Cambria" or the "Sub-Adviser") selects value stocks with lower dividend distributions, which are generally taxed as ordinary income.
info.description_zh: Cambria Tax Aware ETF 旨在提供包括資本增值在內的節稅投資回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），投資於市值超過 50 億美元的美國上市股票證券。該基金的投資副顧問 Cambria Investment Management, L.P.（「Cambria」或「副顧問」）利用自己的量化模型，選擇股息分配較低的價值股票，這些股票通常作為普通收入徵稅。

info.description: Token Cat Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in the operation of an omni-channel automotive marketplace. It offers auto shows, group-purchase facilitation, and virtual dealership services. The company was founded by Wei Wen and Jian Chen Sun in 2010 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Token Cat Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，從事全通路汽車市場的運營。它提供車展、團購便利性和虛擬經銷商服務。該公司由Wei Wen和Jian Chen Sun於2010年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Uniti Group, Inc. is a real estate investment trust company, which engages in the acquisition, construction, and leasing of properties. It operates through the following business segments: Uniti Leasing, Uniti Fiber, and Corporate. The Uniti Leasing segment involves mission-critical communications assets on exclusive or shared-tenant basis, and dark fiber network. The Uniti Fiber segment includes the operation of infrastructure solutions, cell site backhauls, and dark fiber. The Corporate segment consists of office and shared service functions. The company was founded in February 2014 and is headquartered in Little Rock, AR.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Uniti Group, Inc.是一家房地產投資信託公司，從事房地產的收購、建造和租賃業務。它透過以下業務部門運作：Uniti Leasing、Uniti Fiber 和 Corporate。 Uniti 租賃部門涉及獨佔或共享租戶基礎上的關鍵任務通訊資產以及暗光纖網路。 Uniti Fiber 部門包括基礎設施解決方案、蜂窩基地台回程和暗光纖的營運。企業部門包括辦公室和共享服務功能。該公司成立於 2014 年 2 月，總部位於阿肯色州小石城。

info.description: Urban Outfitters, Inc. engages in the operation of a general consumer product retail and wholesale business selling to customers through various channels including retail locations, websites, catalogs, and mobile applications. It operates through the following segments: Retail, Subscription, and Wholesale. The Retail segment includes store and digital channels including Anthropologie, Free People, FP Movement and Urban Outfitters brands. The Subscription segment consists of the Nuuly brand, which is a monthly women's apparel subscription rental service. The Wholesale segment focuses on sale through department and specialty stores worldwide. The company was founded by Richard A. Hayne and Scott A. Belair in 1970 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: Urban Outfitters, Inc. 從事一般消費品零售和批發業務，透過零售地點、網站、目錄和行動應用程式等多種管道向客戶銷售產品。它透過以下部門運作：零售、訂閱和批發。零售部門包括商店和數位管道，包括 Anthropologie、Free People、FP Movement 和 Urban Outfitters 品牌。訂閱部門由 Nuuly 品牌組成，該品牌提供每月女裝訂閱租賃服務。批發部門專注於透過全球百貨公司和專賣店進行銷售。該公司由 Richard A. Hayne 和 Scott A. Belair 於 1970 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州費城。

info.description: US Treasury 3 Year Note ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 3-Year US Treasury Index (GA03). Under normal market conditions, The adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The ICE BofA Current 3-Year US Treasury Index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 3-year U.S. treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國國債 3 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE 美國銀行當前 3 年期美國國債指數 (GA03) 的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的指數的成分證券來實現基金的投資目標。 ICE 美银美林当前 3 年期美国国债指数是一种单一证券指数，由最近发行的 3 年期美国国债组成。

info.description: US Treasury 2 Year Note ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 2-Year US Treasury Index. Under normal market conditions, the Adviser seeks to achieve the investment objective by investing at least 80% of net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the index. The index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 2-year US Treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國國債 2 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE BofA 當前 2 年期美國國債指數的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於指數的組成證券來實現投資目標。該指數是一種單一證券指數，由最近發行的 2 年期美國國債組成。

info.description: Vericel Corp. engages in the research, product development, manufacture, and distribution of patient-specific, expanded cellular therapies for use in the treatment of patients with diseases. Its product portfolio includes MACI and Epicel. The MACI portfolio is FDA-approved product that applies the process of tissue engineering to grow cells on scaffolds using healthy cartilage tissue from the patient's own knee. The Epicel portfolio provide skin replacement for patients who have deep dermal or full thickness burns. The company was founded on March 24, 1989 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Vericel Corp. 從事患者特異性擴展細胞療法的研究、產品開發、製造和分銷，用於治療疾病患者。其產品組合包括 MACI 和 Epicel。 MACI 產品組合是 FDA 批准的產品，它應用組織工程流程，利用患者自己膝蓋的健康軟骨組織在支架上培養細胞。 Epicel 產品組合為深度真皮或全層燒傷的患者提供皮膚替代品。該公司成立於1989年3月24日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: WisdomTree International Adaptive Moving Average Fund seeks to track a rules-based index that provides exposure to developed international large-cap equities while dynamically adjusting to U.S. Treasury bills based on market trend signals. The strategy utilizes a systematic framework incorporating a 200-day simple moving average (SMA) signal and a breadth-based overlay-measuring the percentage of constituents above their own moving averages-to manage equity exposure and mitigate downside risk during prolonged market downturns.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 國際自適應移動平均基金尋求追蹤一個基於規則的指數，該指數提供對已開發國際大盤股的投資，同時根據市場趨勢訊號動態調整美國國債。該策略利用一個系統框架，其中包含 200 天簡單移動平均線 (SMA) 訊號和基於廣度的疊加（衡量成分股高於其移動平均線的百分比），以管理股票風險並減輕長期市場低迷期間的下行風險。

info.description: Franklin U.S. Low Volatility High Dividend Index ETF seeks to track the investment results of the QS Low Volatility High Dividend Index composed of equity securities of U.S. companies with relatively high yield and low price and earnings volatility. The index is composed of stocks of U.S. companies across a wide range of market capitalizations, including the largest 3,000 U.S. stocks as determined by the Solactive US Broad Market Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, if any, in securities that compose the index.
info.description_zh: 富蘭克林美國低波動高股息指數ETF旨在追蹤QS低波動高股息指數的投資結果，該指數由收益率相對較高、價格和利潤波動性較低的美國公司股本證券組成。該指數由各種市值的美國公司股票組成，其中包括由 Solactive 美國大盤指數確定的最大的 3,000 隻美國股票。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於構成該指數的證券。

info.description: Direxion Daily NVDA Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of NVDA. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X inverse (opposite) or short leveraged exposure to NVDA equal to at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily NVDA Bear 1X Shares 尋求與 NVDA 每日表現相反（或相反）的 100% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和選擇權，這些金融工具組合起來為 NVDA 提供 1 倍反向（相反）或空頭槓桿敞口，相當於基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）的至少 80%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The Cigna Group is a global health company, which engages in the provision of global health services. It operates through the following segments: Evernorth Health Services and Cigna Healthcare. The Evernorth Health Services segment partners with health plans, employers, governmental organizations, and health care providers to solve challenges in the areas of pharmacy benefits, home delivery pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, specialty distribution, and care delivery and management solutions. The Cigna Healthcare segment includes the U.S. Healthcare and International Health operating segments, which provide comprehensive medical and coordinated solutions to clients and customers. The company was founded in 1792 and is headquartered in Bloomfield, CT.
info.description_zh: Cigna Group 是一家全球健康公司，致力於提供全球健康服務。它透過以下部門運作：Evernorth Health Services 和 Cigna Healthcare。 Evernorth Health Services 部門與健康計劃、雇主、政府組織和醫療保健提供者合作，解決藥房福利、送貨上門藥房、專科藥房、專科分銷以及護理服務和管理解決方案等領域的挑戰。 Cigna Healthcare 部門包括美國醫療保健和國際健康營運部門，為客戶和客戶提供全面的醫療和協調解決方案。該公司成立於 1792 年，總部位於康乃狄克州布魯姆菲爾德。

info.description: Blue Water Acquisition Corp. III operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, and reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on November 1, 2024 and is headquartered Mountainside, NJ.
info.description_zh: Blue Water Acquisition Corp. III 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立是為了實現合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2024 年 11 月 1 日，總部位於新澤西州芒廷賽德。

info.description: The Clorox Co. engages in the manufacture and marketing of consumer and professional products. It operates through the following business segments: Health and Wellness, Household, Lifestyle, and International. The Health and Wellness segment consists of cleaning products, professional products and vitamins, minerals and supplements mainly marketed and sold in the United States. The Household segments consists of bags and wraps, grilling products and cat litter marketed and sold in the United States. The Lifestyle segment refers to food, natural personal care products and water-filtration products marketed and sold in the United States. The International segment covers products sold outside the United States, excluding natural personal care products. The company was founded by Edward Hughes, Charles Husband, William Hussey, Rufus Myers, and Archibald Taft on May 3, 1913 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Clorox Co. 從事消費品和專業產品的製造和行銷。它透過以下業務部門運作：健康與保健、家庭、生活方式和國際。健康與保健部門包括主要在美國行銷和銷售的清潔產品、專業產品以及維生素、礦物質和補充劑。家用部門包括在美國行銷和銷售的袋子和包裝、燒烤產品和貓砂。生活風格部門是指在美國行銷和銷售的食品、天然個人護理產品和水過濾產品。國際部門涵蓋在美國境外銷售的產品，不包括天然個人護理產品。該公司由 Edward Hughes、Charles Husband、William Hussey、Rufus Myers 和 Archibald Taft 於 1913 年 5 月 3 日創立，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: ProLogis provides distribution facilities and real investment trust services. It leases its industrial facilities to manufacturers, retailers and transportation companies. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 工業
info.description_zh: 普洛斯提供分銷設施和真實投資信託服務。它將工業設施出租給製造商、零售商和運輸公司。該公司成立於 1991 年，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: Wisdomtree Core Laddered Municipal Fund seeks to generate current income that is exempt from federal income taxes. The manager seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily through investments in municipal debt securities whose interest payments generally are exempt from U.S. federal income taxes. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in municipal debt securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree Core Laddered 市政基金尋求產生免徵聯邦所得稅的當前收入。該管理人主要透過投資市政債務證券來實現其投資目標，這些證券的利息支付通常免徵美國聯邦所得稅。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於市政債務證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Infinite Eagle Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or other similar business combination, involving one or more businesses or assets. The company was founded on August 8, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Infinite Eagle Acquisition Corp.是一家空白支票公司，其目的是實現涉及一項或多項業務或資產的合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或其他類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月8日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Ecolab, Inc. engages in providing products and services in the field of water, hygiene, and energy. It operates through the following segments: Global Industrial, Global Institutional and Specialty, Global Healthcare and Life Sciences, Global Pest Elimination, and Corporate. The Global Industrial segment relates to water, food and beverage, paper, and downstream operating segments. The Global Institutional and Specialty segment refers to the institutional, specialty, and healthcare operating segments. The Global Healthcare and Life Sciences segment includes the healthcare and life sciences operations. The Global Pest Elimination segment provides services designed to detect, prevent and eliminate pests, such as rodents and insects, in full-service and quick-service restaurants, food and beverage processors, hotels, grocery operations, and other. The company was founded by Merritt J. Osborn in 1923 and is headquartered in St. Paul, MN.
info.description_zh: Ecolab, Inc. 致力於提供水、衛生和能源領域的產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：全球工業部門、全球機構和專業部門、全球醫療保健和生命科學部門、全球害蟲消除部門和企業部門。全球工業部門涉及水、食品和飲料、造紙和下游營運部門。全球機構和專業部門是指機構、專業和醫療保健營運部門。全球醫療保健和生命科學部門包括醫療保健和生命科學業務。全球害蟲消除部門提供旨在檢測、預防和消除害蟲（例如囓齒動物和昆蟲）的服務，適用於全方位服務和快速服務的餐廳、食品和飲料加工商、酒店、雜貨店等。該公司由 Merritt J. Osborn 於 1923 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州聖保羅。

info.description: Quest Diagnostics, Inc. engages in the provision of diagnostic testing, information, and services. It operates through the Diagnostic Information Services (DIS) and All Other segments. The DIS segment offers diagnostic information services to physicians, hospitals, patients, and consumers. The All Other segment consists of risk assessment services and healthcare information technology. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Secaucus, NJ.
info.description_zh: Quest Diagnostics, Inc. 從事提供診斷測試、資訊和服務。它透過診斷資訊服務（DIS）和所有其他部門運作。 DIS 部門為醫生、醫院、病患和消費者提供診斷資訊服務。所有其他部門包括風險評估服務和醫療保健資訊科技。該公司成立於 1967 年，總部位於新澤西州錫考克斯。

info.description: Parker-Hannifin Corp. engages in the manufacture of motion and control technologies and systems. It operates through the Diversified Industrial and Aerospace Systems segments. The Diversified Industrial segment sells products to both original equipment manufacturers and distributors who serve the replacement markets in manufacturing, packaging, processing, transportation, mobile construction, refrigeration and air conditioning, agricultural and military machinery, and equipment industries. The Aerospace Systems segment offers products primarily in the commercial and military aerospace markets to both OEMs and to end users for spares, maintenance, repair, and overhaul. The company was founded by Arthur L. Parker in 1918 and is headquartered in Cleveland, OH.
info.description_zh: Parker-Hannifin Corp. 從事運動和控制技術及系統的製造。它透過多元化工業和航空航天系統部門運作。多元化工業部門向原始設備製造商和分銷商銷售產品，這些製造商和分銷商服務於製造、包裝、加工、運輸、移動建築、製冷和空調、農業和軍用機械以及設備行業的替代市場。航空航太系統部門主要在商業和軍用航空航太市場向原始設備製造商和最終用戶提供備件、維護、修理和大修產品。該公司由 Arthur L. Parker 於 1918 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州克利夫蘭。

info.description: Oak Valley Bancorp is a bank holding company, which engages in the business of operating its subsidiary, Oak Valley Community Bank. It offers a variety of loan and deposit products to individuals and small businesses. The company was founded on May 31, 1990 and is headquartered in Oakdale, CA.
info.description_zh: Oak Valley Bancorp 是一家銀行控股公司，從事經營其子公司 Oak Valley Community Bank 的業務。它為個人和小型企業提供各種貸款和存款產品。該公司成立於 1990 年 5 月 31 日，總部位於加州奧克代爾。

info.description: Direxion Daily AVGO Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of AVGO. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X daily inverse (opposite) or short exposure to AVGO, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily AVGO Bear 1X Shares 寻求与 AVGO 每日表现相反（或相反）的 100% 的每日投资结果（扣除费用和开支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和選擇權，這些金融工具結合起來提供 1 倍的每日反向（相反）或空頭敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Abony Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 13, 2025 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Abony Acquisition Corp. I 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年11月13日，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: McKesson Corp. engages in providing healthcare services. It operates through the following segments: North American Pharmaceutical, Oncology and Multispecialty, Prescription Technology Solutions (RxTS), and Medical-Surgical Solutions. The North American Pharmaceutical segment focuses on distribution of branded, generic, specialty, biosimilar and over-the-counter pharmaceutical drugs to customers in U.S. and Canada. The Oncology and Multispecialty segment includes provision of solutions that includes specialty drug distribution, group purchasing organizations, infusion services, direct to patient pharmacy capabilities, InspiroGene cell and gene therapy services, technology solutions, practice consulting services, and vaccine distribution. The RxTS segment focuses on solving medication access, affordability, and adherence challenges for patients by working across healthcare to connect patients, pharmacies, providers, pharmacy benefit managers, health plans, and biopharma companies. The Medical-Surgical Solutions segment provides medical-surgical supply distribution, logistics, and other services to healthcare providers. The company was founded by John McKesson and Charles Olcott in 1833 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.description_zh: McKesson Corp. 從事提供醫療保健服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：北美製藥部門、腫瘤學和多專科部門、處方技術解決方案（RxTS）部門和醫療外科解決方案部門。北美製藥部門專注於向美國和加拿大的客戶分銷品牌藥品、仿製藥、特殊藥品、生物相似藥和非處方藥品。腫瘤學和多專科部門提供的解決方案包括特殊藥物分銷、團體採購組織、輸液服務、直接面向患者的藥房能力、InspiroGene 細胞和基因治療服務、技術解決方案、實踐諮詢服務和疫苗分銷。 RxTS 部門專注於透過跨醫療保健領域連接患者、藥房、提供者、藥品福利管理者、健康計劃和生物製藥公司，解決患者的藥物取得、負擔能力和依從性挑戰。醫療外科解決方案部門為醫療保健提供者提供醫療外科用品分銷、物流和其他服務。該公司由 John McKesson 和 Charles Olcott 於 1833 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: PACCAR, Inc. is a global technology company, which engages in the design and manufacture of light, medium, and heavy-duty trucks. It operates through the following segments: Truck, Parts, and Financial Services. The Truck segment designs and manufactures heavy, medium, and light duty diesel trucks which are marketed under the Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF brands. The Parts segment distributes aftermarket parts for trucks and related commercial vehicles. The Financial Services segment provides finance and leasing products and services provided to truck customers and dealers. The company was founded by William Pigott Sr. in 1905 and is headquartered in Bellevue, WA.
info.description_zh: PACCAR, Inc.是一家全球科技公司，從事輕型、中型和重型卡車的設計和製造。它透過以下部門運作：卡車部門、零件部門和金融服務部門。卡車部門設計和製造重型、中型和輕型柴油卡車，並以 Kenworth、Peterbilt 和 DAF 品牌銷售。零件部門分銷卡車和相關商用車的售後零件。金融服務部門為卡車客戶和經銷商提供融資和租賃產品及服務。該公司由 William Pigott Sr. 於 1905 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州貝爾維尤。

info.description: Erie Indemnity Co. engages in the insurance business and operates as an attorney-in-fact. It manages affairs at the Erie Insurance Exchange for the benefit of the policyholders. It covers policies in auto and leisure, home and property, life, and business insurance. The company was founded by Henry Orth Hirt and Ollie Grover Crawford on April 4, 1925, and is headquartered in Erie, PA.
info.description_zh: 伊利賠償公司 (Erie Indemnity Co.) 從事保險業務，並作為事實上的律師開展業務。它為保單持有人的利益管理伊利保險交易所的事務。它涵蓋汽車和休閒、家庭和財產、人壽和商業保險的保單。該公司由 Henry Orth Hirt 和 Ollie Grover Crawford 於 1925 年 4 月 4 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州伊利。

info.description: The Allstate Corp. engages in the property and casualty insurance business and the provision of protection solutions. It operates through the following segments: Allstate Protection, Protection Services, Allstate Health and Benefits, Run-off Property-Liability, and Corporate and Other. The Allstate Protection segment offers private passenger auto, homeowners, other personal lines, and commercial insurance marketed under the Allstate, National General, and Answer Financial brand names. The Protection Services segment provides a range of solutions and services that expand and enhance customer value propositions including Allstate Protection Plans, Allstate Dealer Services, Allstate Roadside, Arity, and Allstate Identity Protection. The Allstate Health and Benefits segment focuses on voluntary benefits and individual life and health products, including life, accident, critical illness, short term disability, and other health insurance products sold through independent agents, benefit brokers, and Allstate exclusive agencies. The Run-off Property-Liability segment relates to property and casualty insurance policies with exposure to asbestos, environmental, and other claims in run-off. The Corporate and Other segment is involved in debt service, holding company activities, and certain non-insurance operations. The company was founded on April 17, 1931 and is headquartered in Northbrook, IL.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: Allstate Corp. 從事財產和意外保險業務以及提供保障解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：Allstate Protection、Protection Services、Allstate Health and Benefits、Run-off Property-Liability、以及Corporate and Other。 Allstate Protection 部門提供以 Allstate、National General 和 Answer Financial 品牌銷售的私人乘用車、房屋所有者、其他個人保險和商業保險。保護服務部門提供一系列解決方案和服務，可擴展和增強客戶價值主張，包括 Allstate 保護計畫、Allstate 經銷商服務、Allstate Roadside、Arity 和 Allstate 身分保護。 Allstate 健康和福利部門專注於自願福利以及個人人壽和健康產品，包括人壽、意外、重大疾病、短期殘疾以及透過獨立代理人、福利經紀人和 Allstate 獨家代理機構銷售的其他健康保險產品。徑流財產責任部分涉及財產和傷亡保險單，涉及石棉、環境和其他徑流索賠。公司及其他部門涉及償債、控股公司活動和某些非保險業務。該公司成立於 1931 年 4 月 17 日，總部位於伊利諾伊州諾斯布魯克。

info.description: Snap-On, Inc. engages in the manufacture and marketing of tools, equipment, diagnostics, repair information, and systems solutions for professional users performing critical tasks. Its products and services include hand and power tools, tool storage, diagnostics software, handheld and PC-based diagnostic products, information and management systems, shop equipment and other solutions for vehicle dealerships and repair centers, as well as for customers in industries such as aviation and aerospace, agriculture, construction, government and military, mining, natural resources, power generation, and technical education. It operates through the following segments: Commercial and Industrial Group, Snap-On Tools Group, Repair Systems and Information Group, and Financial Services. The Commercial and Industrial Group segment consists of business operations that serve the aerospace, natural resources, government, power generation, transportation, and technical education markets. The Snap-On Tools Group segment includes business operations primarily serving vehicle service and repair technicians through its worldwide mobile tool distribution channel. The Repair System and Information Group segment serves professional vehicle repair customers, primarily owners and managers of independent repair shops and original equipment manufacturer dealerships through direct and distributor channels. The Financial Services segment consists of installment sales and lease contracts arising from franchisees' customers, and business loans and vehicle leases to franchisees. The company was founded by Joseph Johnson and William Seidemann in 1920 and is headquartered in Kenosha, WI.
info.description_zh: Snap-On, Inc. 致力於為執行關鍵任務的專業使用者製造和行銷工具、設備、診斷、維修資訊和系統解決方案。其產品和服務包括手動和電動工具、工具儲存、診斷軟體、手持式和基於PC的診斷產品、資訊和管理系統、車間設備和其他解決方案，面向汽車經銷商和維修中心，以及航空航天、農業、建築、政府和軍事、採礦、自然資源、發電和技術教育等行業的客戶。該公司透過以下部門運作：商業和工業部門、實耐寶工具部門、維修系統和資訊部門以及金融服務部門。商業和工業集團部門包括服務於航空航太、自然資源、政府、發電、運輸和技術教育市場的業務運作。實耐寶工具集團業務部門主要透過其全球行動工具分銷管道為車輛服務和維修技術人員提供服務。維修系統和資訊集團部門透過直接和分銷管道為專業車輛維修客戶提供服務，主要是獨立維修店和原始設備製造商經銷商的所有者和經理。金融服務部門包括特許經營商客戶產生的分期銷售和租賃合同，以及向特許經營商提供的商業貸款和車輛租賃。該公司由 Joseph Johnson 和 William Seidemann 於 1920 年創立，總部位於威斯康辛州基諾沙。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long UNH Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of UNH. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of UNH, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 UNH 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 UNH 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來，為 UNH 的價格提供 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sotera Health Co. provides mission-critical sterilization, lab testing and advisory services to the medical device and pharmaceutical industries. It also provides end-to-end sterilization as well as microbiological and analytical lab testing and advisory services to help ensure that medical, pharmaceutical and food products are safe for healthcare practitioners, patients and consumers. The firm operates through the following businesses: Sterigenics, Nordion, and Nelson Labs. The Sterigenics business provides outsourced terminal sterilization and irradiation services for the medical device, pharmaceutical, food safety and advanced applications markets by using following technologies: gamma irradiation, EO processing and E-beam irradiation. The Nordion business provides Co-60 and gamma irradiators, which are the key components to the gamma sterilization process. The Nelson Labs business provides outsourced microbiological and analytical chemistry testing and advisory services for the medical device and pharmaceutical industries. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Broadview Heights, OH.
info.description_zh: Sotera Health Co. 為醫療器材和製藥業提供關鍵任務滅菌、實驗室測試和諮詢服務。它還提供端到端滅菌以及微生物和分析實驗室測試和諮詢服務，以幫助確保醫療、藥品和食品對醫療保健從業者、患者和消費者來說是安全的。該公司透過以下業務運營：Sterigenics、Nordion 和 Nelson Labs。 Sterigenics 業務透過使用以下技術為醫療器材、製藥、食品安全和先進應用市場提供外包終端滅菌和輻照服務：伽馬輻照、EO 處理和電子束輻照。 Nordion 業務提供 Co-60 和伽馬輻照器，它們是伽馬滅菌過程的關鍵組件。尼爾森實驗室業務為醫療器材和製藥業提供外包微生物和分析化學測試和諮詢服務。該公司成立於 1978 年，總部位於俄亥俄州布羅德維尤高地。

info.description: Merit Medical Systems, Inc. engages in the manufacture and marketing of proprietary disposable medical devices. It operates through the Cardiovascular and Endoscopy segments. The Cardiovascular segment consists of peripheral intervention, cardiac intervention, interventional oncology and spine, and cardiovascular and critical care product groups. The Endoscopy segment integrates non-vascular stent technology with balloon dilators, inflation devices, guide wires, procedure kits, and other devices that are used by gastroenterologists, endoscopists, pulmonologists, and thoracic and general surgeons. The company was founded by Fred P. Lampropoulos, Darla Gill, Kent W. Stanger, and William Padilla in July 1987 and is headquartered in South Jordan, UT.
info.description_zh: Merit Medical Systems, Inc. 從事專有一次性醫療設備的製造和行銷。它透過心血管和內視鏡部分運作。心血管部門包括週邊介入、心臟介入、介入腫瘤和脊椎、心血管和重症監護產品組。內視鏡領域將非血管支架技術與球囊擴張器、充氣裝置、導引線、手術套件以及胃腸病學家、內視鏡醫師、肺病學家、胸腔外科和一般外科醫師使用的其他設備結合。該公司由 Fred P. Lampropoulos、Darla Gill、Kent W. Stanger 和 William Padilla 於 1987 年 7 月創立，總部位於猶他州南喬丹。

info.description: Church & Dwight Co., Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of household, personal care, and specialty products. It operates through the following segments: Consumer Domestic, Consumer International, and Specialty Products Division (SPD). The Consumer Domestic segment offers household products, such as laundry detergents, fabric softener sheets, cat litter, household cleaning products, and personal care products including antiperspirants, oral care products, depilatories, reproductive health products, oral analgesics, nasal saline moisturizers, and dietary supplements. The Consumer International segment is involved in the personal care, household and over-the-counter products in international subsidiary markets, including Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Japan, Mexico, China, and the United Kingdom. The SPD segment consists of sales to businesses and participates in three product areas: animal nutrition, specialty chemicals, commercial, and professional. The company was founded by Dwight John and Austin Church in 1846 and is headquartered in Ewing, NJ.
info.description_zh: Church & Dwight Co., Inc. 从事家居、个人护理和特色产品的开发、制造和营销。它通过以下部门运营：国内消费者部门、国际消费者部门和特种产品部门 (SPD)。國內消費品部門提供家用產品，如洗衣粉、織物柔軟劑片、貓砂、家庭清潔產品和個人護理產品，包括止汗劑、口腔護理產品、除毛劑、生殖健康產品、口腔鎮痛劑、鼻鹽水保濕劑和膳食補充劑。國際消費品部門涉足國際附屬市場的個人護理、家庭和非處方產品，包括澳洲、加拿大、法國、德國、日本、墨西哥、中國和英國。 SPD 部门包括对企业的销售，并参与三个产品领域：动物营养、特种化学品、商业和专业。该公司由 Dwight John 和 Austin Church 于 1846 年创立，总部位于新泽西州尤因。

info.description: Abbott Laboratories engages in the discovery, development, manufacture, and sale of healthcare products. It operates through the following segments: Established Pharmaceutical Products, Diagnostic Products, Nutritional Products, and Medical Devices. The Established Pharmaceutical Products segment focuses on branded generic pharmaceuticals that are manufactured worldwide and marketed and sold outside the United States, primarily in emerging markets. The Diagnostic Products segment markets diagnostic systems and tests for blood banks, hospitals, commercial laboratories, clinics, physicians' offices, retailers, government agencies, and alternative care testing sites. The Nutritional Products segment oversees the worldwide sale of pediatric and adult nutritional products. The Medical Devices segment offers a broad range of rhythm management, electrophysiology, heart failure, vascular and structural heart devices for the treatment of cardiovascular diseases, as well as diabetes care and continuous glucose monitoring products. It also provides neuromodulation devices for the management of chronic pain and movement disorders. The company was founded by Wallace Calvin Abbott in 1888 and is headquartered in Abbott Park, IL.
info.description_zh: 雅培實驗室從事醫療保健產品的發現、開發、製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：成熟的藥品部門、診斷產品部門、營養產品部門和醫療器材部門。老牌藥品部門專注於在全球生產並在美國境外（主要是新興市場）行銷和銷售的品牌仿製藥。診斷產品部門為血庫、醫院、商業實驗室、診所、醫生辦公室、零售商、政府機構和替代護理測試場所銷售診斷系統和測試。營養產品部門負責監督兒科和成人營養產品的全球銷售。醫療器材部門提供廣泛的節律管理、電生理學、心臟衰竭、用於治療心血管疾病的血管和結構性心臟設備，以及糖尿病護理和連續血糖監測產品。它還提供用於治療慢性疼痛和運動障礙的神經調節裝置。該公司由 Wallace Calvin Abbott 於 1888 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州雅培公園。

info.description: Myriad Genetics, Inc. is a molecular diagnostics and precision medicine company committed to advancing health and well-being for all. It develops and commercializes molecular tests that help patients and providers uncover genetic insights. The company was founded by Walter A. Gilbert, Mark H. Skolnick, and Peter D. Meldrum in May 1991 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Myriad Genetics, Inc. 是一家分子診斷和精準醫療公司，致力於促進所有人的健康和福祉。它開發分子測試並將其商業化，幫助患者和提供者揭示遺傳見解。該公司由 Walter A. Gilbert、Mark H. Skolnick 和 Peter D. Meldrum 於 1991 年 5 月創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: West Pharmaceutical Services, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of containment and delivery systems for injectable drugs and healthcare products. It operates through the Proprietary Products and Contract-Manufactured Products segments. The Proprietary Products segment offers proprietary packaging, containment solutions, drug delivery systems, analytical lab services, and other integrated services and solutions, primarily to biologic, generic, and pharmaceutical drug customers. The Contract-Manufactured Products segment serves as a fully integrated business focused on the design, manufacture, and automated assembly of complex devices, primarily for pharmaceutical, diagnostic, and medical device customers. The company was founded by Herman O. West on July 27, 1923 and is headquartered in Exton, PA.
info.description_zh: West Pharmaceutical Services, Inc. 從事注射藥物和醫療保健產品的密封和輸送系統的設計、製造和銷售。它透過專有產品和合約製造產品部門運作。專有產品部門主要向生物藥品、仿製藥和製藥藥品客戶提供專有包裝、密封解決方案、給藥系統、分析實驗室服務以及其他綜合服務和解決方案。合約製造產品部門是一個完全整合的業務，專注於複雜設備的設計、製造和自動化組裝，主要針對製藥、診斷和醫療設備客戶。該公司由 Herman O. West 於 1923 年 7 月 27 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州埃克斯頓。

info.description: Edison International is a renewable energy company, which through its subsidiaries, generates and distributes electric power, and invests in energy services and technologies. The company was founded on July 4, 1886, and is headquartered in Rosemead, CA.
info.industry_zh: Error 500 (Server Error)!!1500.That’s an error.There was an error. Please try again later.That’s all we know.
info.description_zh: 愛迪生國際是一家再生能源公司，透過其子公司生產和分配電力，並投資能源服務和技術。該公司成立於 1886 年 7 月 4 日，總部位於加利福尼亞州羅斯米德。

info.description: C&F Financial Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services to individuals and businesses. It operates through the following segments: Community Banking, Mortgage Banking and Consumer Finance. The Community Banking segment provides checking and savings deposit accounts, business, real estate, development, mortgage, home equity, and installment loans. The Mortgage Banking segment offers ancillary mortgage loan origination services for loan settlement and residential appraisals. The Consumer Finance segment consists of automobile financing through lending programs that are designed to serve customers in the non-prime market who have limited access to traditional automobile financing. The company was founded on March 8, 1994 and is headquartered in Toano, VA.
info.description_zh: C&F Financial Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，致力於向個人和企業提供銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：社區銀行業務、抵押銀行業務和消費金融業務。社區銀行業務部門提供支票和儲蓄存款帳戶、商業、房地產、開發、抵押貸款、房屋淨值和分期貸款。抵押貸款銀行部門為貸款結算和住宅評估提供輔助抵押貸款發放服務。消費金融部門透過貸款計畫提供汽車融資，旨在為傳統汽車融資管道有限的非主要市場客戶提供服務。該公司成立於1994年3月8日，總部位於維吉尼亞州托阿諾。

info.description: Invesco Water Resources ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the NASDAQ OMX US Water IndexSM (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to track the performance of companies that create products designed to conserve and purify water for homes, businesses and industries. The underlying index may include common stocks, ordinary shares, American depositary receipts ("ADRs"), shares of beneficial interest and tracking stocks. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Water Resources ETF 旨在追蹤 NASDAQ OMX US Water IndexSM（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤那些為家庭、企業和工業生產節約和淨化用水的產品的公司的表現。標的指數可能包括普通股、普通股、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）、受益股和追蹤股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily AAPL Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of AAPL. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X inverse (opposite) or short leveraged exposure to AAPL equal to at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily AAPL Bear 1X Shares 尋求與 AAPL 每日表現相反（或相反）的 100% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和選擇權，這些金融工具組合起來為 AAPL 提供 1 倍反向（相反）或空頭槓桿風險敞口，相當於基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）的至少 80%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Sanofi engages in the research, production, and distribution of pharmaceutical products. It operates through the Biopharma segment, which comprises commercial operations and research, development and production activities relating to the specialty care, general medicines and vaccines franchises plus support and corporate functions, for all geographical territories. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
info.description_zh: 賽諾菲從事醫藥產品的研究、生產和分銷。該公司透過生物製藥部門運營，該部門包括與所有地理區域的專業護理、普通藥物和疫苗特許經營權以及支持和公司職能相關的商業運營以及研究、開發和生產活動。該公司成立於1973年，總部位於法國巴黎。

info.description: ClearOne, Inc. engages in the design, development, and marketing of professional audio conferencing, microphone, and video collaboration solutions. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: ClearOne, Inc. 從事專業音訊會議、麥克風和視訊協作解決方案的設計、開發和行銷。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Timberland Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of community banking services. It offers mortgage loans, consumer loans, and commercial business loans. The company was founded on September 8, 1997 and is headquartered in Hoquiam, WA.
info.description_zh: Timberland Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供社區銀行服務。它提供抵押貸款、消費貸款和商業貸款。該公司成立於1997年9月8日，總部位於華盛頓州霍奎姆。

info.description: Incannex Healthcare, Inc. is a biotech company, which engages in developing cannabinoid and psychedelic compound medicines. It focuses on the research and development for medicinal cannabis pharmaceutical products and psychedelic medicine therapies for treatment of a range of indications. The company was founded on April 27, 2001 and is headquartered in Norwest, Australia.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Incannex Healthcare, Inc.是一家生技公司，致力於開發大麻素和迷幻化合物藥物。它專注於藥用大麻藥物和用於治療一系列適應症的迷幻藥物療法的研究和開發。該公司成立於2001年4月27日，總部位於澳洲諾韋斯特。

info.description: Waste Management, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of waste management environmental services. It operates through the following segments: Collection and Disposal-East Tier (East Tier), Collection and Disposal-West Tier (West Tier), Recycling Processing and Sales, Renewable Energy, and Healthcare Solutions. The East Tier segment includes the Eastern United States, the Great Lakes Region, and Canada. The West Tier segment refers to the upper Midwest region and British Columbia, Canada. The Recycling Processing and Sales segment focuses on the processing and sales of materials collected from residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The Renewable Energy segment develops, operates, and promotes projects for landfill gas use. The Healthcare Solutions segment relates to its primarily business to business company providing services that protect people and brands, promote health and well-being and safeguard the environment. The company was founded on September 30, 1987 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Waste Management, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事提供廢棄物管理環境服務。它透過以下部門運作：收集和處置-東層（East Tier）、收集和處置-西層（West Tier）、回收加工和銷售、再生能源和醫療保健解決方案。東線部分包括美國東部、五大湖地區和加拿大。西部線段是指中西部上游地區和加拿大不列顛哥倫比亞省。回收加工和銷售部門專注於從住宅、商業和工業客戶收集的材料的加工和銷售。再生能源部門開發、營運和推廣垃圾掩埋氣利用計畫。醫療保健解決方案部門主要涉及企業對企業公司，提供保護人員和品牌、促進健康和福祉以及保護環境的服務。該公司成立於1987年9月30日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of orthopedic reconstructive products. The firm also offers sports medicine, biologics, extremities, and trauma products, spine, craniomaxillofacial, and thoracic products, office-based technologies, dental implants, and related surgical products. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe Middle East and Africa, and Asia Pacific. The Americas segment consists of the U.S. and includes other North, Central and South American markets. The Europe Middle East and Africa segment includes France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the United Kingdom. The Asia Pacific segment refers to the key markets such as Japan, China, Australia, New Zealand, Korea, Taiwan, India, Thailand, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Malaysia. The company was founded by Justin O. Zimmer in 1927 and is headquartered in Warsaw, IN.
info.description_zh: Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. 從事骨科重建產品的設計、製造和行銷。該公司還提供運動醫學、生物製品、四肢和創傷產品、脊椎、顱顏面和胸部產品、辦公室技術、牙科植體和相關外科產品。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲以及亞太地區。美洲部分包括美國以及其他北美、中美和南美市場。歐洲、中東和非洲部分包括法國、德國、義大利、西班牙和英國。亞太地區是指日本、中國、澳洲、紐西蘭、韓國、台灣、印度、泰國、新加坡、香港和馬來西亞等主要市場。該公司由 Justin O. Zimmer 於 1927 年創立，總部位於印第安納州華沙。

info.description: AXS 1.25X NVDA Bear Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to one and a quarter times the inverse (-125%) of the daily performance of the common shares of NVIDIA Corporation. Under normal market circumstances, the adviser will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide one and a quarter times inverse leveraged exposure to the daily performance of NVDA. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve on a daily basis, before fees and expenses, -125% performance of NVDA for a single day, not for any other period, by entering into one or more swap agreements on NVDA. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AXS 1.25X NVDA Bear Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果，相當於 NVIDIA 公司普通股每日業績倒數的一又四分之一倍 (-125%)。在正常市場情況下，顧問將維持至少 80% 的金融工具敞口，這些金融工具為 NVDA 的日常業績提供一又四分之一倍的反向槓桿敞口。該基金是一種主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過在 NVDA 上簽訂一項或多項掉期協議，在每日基礎上（未計費用和開支）實現 NVDA 單日業績的 -125%，而不是在任何其他時期。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Lisata Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of innovative therapies for the treatment of solid tumors and other major diseases. Its product, Certepetide, is designed to activate a novel uptake pathway that allows co-administered or tethered anti-cancer drugs to target and penetrate tumors. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Basking Ridge, NJ.
info.description_zh: Lisata Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段製藥公司，致力於治療實體瘤和其他重大疾病的創新療法的發現、開發和商業化。其產品 Certepetide 旨在激活一種新型攝取途徑，使聯合給藥或聯合抗癌藥物能夠靶向並滲透腫瘤。該公司成立於 1980 年，總部位於新澤西州巴斯金里奇。

info.description: AXS Short Innovation Daily ETF seeks to provide investment results that are approximately the inverse of, before fees and expenses, to the daily price and yield performance of the ARK Innovation ETF. The fund is an actively managed ETF that the advisor attempts to achieve the inverse (-1x) of the return of the ARK Innovation ETF for a single day by entering into a swap agreement on the ARK Innovation ETF. The ARK Innovation ETF is an actively managed ETF that seeks long-term growth of capital by investing primarily in domestic and foreign equity securities of companies that are relevant to the fund's investment theme of disruptive innovation. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AXS Short Innovation Daily ETF 力求提供與 ARK Innovation ETF 的每日價格和收益率表現大致相反的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金是主動式管理 ETF，顧問試圖透過簽訂 ARK Innovation ETF 掉期協議來實現 ARK Innovation ETF 單日回報的倒數（-1 倍）。 ARK Innovation ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，透過主要投資於與該基金顛覆性創新投資主題相關的公司的國內外股票證券來尋求資本的長期增長。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Achieve Life Sciences, Inc. is a late-stage specialty pharmaceutical company focused on the global development and commercialization of cytisinicline as a treatment of nicotine dependence. Its products include cytisine, a plant-based alkaloid with a binding affinity to the nicotinic acetylcholine receptor. The company was founded in October 1991 and is headquartered in Bothell, WA.
info.description_zh: Achieve Life Sciences, Inc.是一家後期專業製藥公司，專注於治療尼古丁依賴的金雀花鹼的全球開發和商業化。其產品包括金雀花鹼，一種與菸鹼乙醯膽鹼受體具有結合親和力的植物生物鹼。該公司成立於 1991 年 10 月，總部位於華盛頓州博塞爾。

info.description: Yuanbao, Inc. operates as a holding company, which provides online insurance distribution and services. Its products include million medical insurance, comprehensive accident insurance, and major disease insurance. The company was founded by Rui Fang in December 2019 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Yuanbao, Inc. 作為一家控股公司運營，提供線上保險分銷和服務。其產品包括百萬醫療險、綜合意外險、重大疾病險。該公司由方銳於2019年12月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: TradersAI Large Cap Equity & Cash ETF seeks maximum total return. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (ETF) that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in securities and financial instruments linked to the S&P 500 Index. The fund manager takes both long and short positions by investing in e-mini futures contracts. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in large cap equities or investments with similar characteristics, or cash and cash equivalents.
info.description_zh: TradersAI Large Cap Equity & Cash ETF 尋求最大的總回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金 (ETF)，旨在透過投資與標準普爾 500 指數掛鉤的證券和金融工具來實現其投資目標。基金經理人透過投資電子迷你期貨合約來持有多頭和空頭部位。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款投資於大盤股或具有類似特徵的投資，或現金及現金等價物。

info.description: Graniteshares 1.5x Short NVDA Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of -1.5 times (-150%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of NVIDIA Corporation. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 1.5x the inverse (-150%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. The fund advisor aims to generate the inverse daily performance of the underlying stock for a single day.
info.description_zh: Graniteshares 1.5 倍短期 NVDA 每日 ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 NVIDIA Corporation 普通股每日百分比變化的 -1.5 倍 (-150%)。該基金是主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期協議來複製標的股票的 1.5 倍反向（-150%）每日百分比變化。基金顧問的目標是產生標的股票單日的反向日表現。

info.description: Fortive Corp. engages in the design, development, manufacturing, and marketing of professional and engineered products, software, and services for a variety of end markets. It operates through the following segments: Intelligent Operating Solutions, Precision Technologies, and Advanced Healthcare Solutions. The Intelligent Operating Solutions segment provides solutions to accelerate industrial and facility reliability and performance, as well as compliance and safety across a range of vertical end markets, including manufacturing, process industries, healthcare, utilities and power, communications, and electronics. The Precision Technologies segment supplies technologies such as electrical test and measurement instruments and services, energetic material devices, and a broad portfolio of sensor and control system solutions. The Advanced Healthcare Solutions segment serves healthcare customers with products and services for critical activities, including instrument and device reprocessing, instrument tracking, cell therapy equipment design and manufacturing, biomedical test tools, radiation safety monitoring, and asset management. The company was founded by James A. Lico and Stacey A. Walker on November 10, 2015 and is headquartered in Everett, WA.
info.description_zh: Fortive Corp. 致力於為各種終端市場設計、開發、製造和行銷專業工程產品、軟體和服務。它透過以下部門運作：智慧操作解決方案、精密技術和高級醫療解決方案。智慧操作解決方案部門提供解決方案，以提高工業和設施的可靠性和性能，以及一系列垂直終端市場的合規性和安全性，包括製造業、流程工業、醫療保健、公用事業和電力、通訊和電子產品。精密技術部門提供電氣測試和測量儀器及服務、含能材料設備以及廣泛的感測器和控制系統解決方案組合等技術。高級醫療保健解決方案部門為醫療保健客戶提供關鍵活動的產品和服務，包括儀器和設備再處理、儀器追蹤、細胞治療設備設計和製造、生物醫學測試工具、輻射安全監測和資產管理。該公司由 James A. Lico 和 Stacey A. Walker 於 2015 年 11 月 10 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州埃弗里特。

info.description: TE Connectivity Plc is a company that engages in the provision of connectivity and sensor solutions for the purpose of distribution of power, signal, and data. It operates under the following segments: Transportation Solutions, Industrial Solutions, and Communications Solutions. The Transportation Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, sensors, relays, antennas, and application tooling. The Industrial Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, interventional medical components, relays, heat shrink tubing, and wire and cable. The Communications Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, antennas, and heat shrink tubing. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Galway, Ireland.
info.description_zh: TE Con​​nectivity Plc 是一家致力於提供用於電力、訊號和資料分配的連接和感測器解決方案的公司。它的業務分為以下幾個部門：運輸解決方案、工業解決方案和通訊解決方案。運輸解決方案部門包括終端和連接器系統及組件、感測器、繼電器、天線和應用工具。工業解決方案部門包括端子和連接器系統及組件、介入醫療組件、繼電器、熱縮管以及電線和電纜。通訊解決方案部門包括終端和連接器系統及組件、天線和熱縮管。該公司成立於2007年，總部位於愛爾蘭戈爾韋。

info.description: Melco Resorts & Entertainment Ltd. engages in the management and development of casino gaming and entertainment resort facilities. It operates through the following segments: City of Dreams, Studio City, Altira Macau, Mocha and Other, City of Dreams Manila, City of Dreams Mediterranean & Other, Other Operations, and Corporate & Other. The company was founded by Yau Lung Ho in December 2004 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 新濠博亞娛樂有限公司從事賭場博彩及娛樂度假村設施的管理與開發。該公司透過以下部門運作：新濠天地、新濠影匯、澳門新濠鋒、摩卡及其他、馬尼拉新濠天地、地中海新濠天地及其他、其他業務部門以及企業及其他部門。該公司由何遊龍於2004年12月創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Siebert Financial Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of brokerage and financial advisory services. It conducts the following lines of business through wholly owned subsidiaries: Retail Brokerage Business, Investment Advisory Services, Insurance Services, Robo-Advisory Technology Development, and Prime Brokerage Services. The company was founded by Siebert Muriel F. on April 9, 1934 and is headquartered in Miami Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Siebert Financial Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供經紀和財務諮詢服務。它透過全資子公司開展以下業務：零售經紀業務、投資諮詢服務、保險服務、機器人諮詢技術開發和大宗經紀服務。該公司由 Siebert Muriel F. 於 1934 年 4 月 9 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密海灘。

info.description: IDEAYA Biosciences, Inc. engages in the research and development of oncology-focused precision medicine. The firm focuses on the targeted therapeutics for patients selected using molecular diagnostics. Its product candidate, IDE196, is a protein kinase C inhibitor for genetically defined cancers having GNAQ and GNA11 gene mutations. The company was founded by Yujiro S. Hata and Jeffrey Hager in June 2015 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: IDEAYA Biosciences, Inc.從事以腫瘤學為重點的精準醫療的研發。該公司專注於為使用分子診斷選擇的患者提供標靶治療。其候選產品 IDE196 是一種蛋白激酶 C 抑制劑，用於治療具有 GNAQ 和 GNA11 基因突變的基因癌症。該公司由 Yujiro S. Hata 和 Jeffrey Hager 於 2015 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Arrivent Biopharma, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in identifying, licensing, and globalizing biopharma innovations from around the world to deliver important medicines to patients. The company was founded Zheng Bin Yao and Stuart Lutzker on April 14, 2021 and is headquartered in Newtown Square, PA.
info.description_zh: Arrivent Biopharma, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於識別、許可和全球化世界各地的生物製藥創新，為患者提供重要的藥物。該公司由鄭斌姚和斯圖爾特·盧茨克於 2021 年 4 月 14 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州紐敦廣場。

info.description: ProFrac Holding Corp. engages in the provision of hydraulic fracturing, proppant production, and other completion services. It operates through the following segments: Stimulation Services, Proppant Production, Manufacturing, and Other. The Stimulation Services segment owns a fleet of mobile hydraulic fracturing units and other auxiliary equipment that generates revenue by providing stimulation services to customers. The Proppant Production segment focuses on the provision of proppant to oilfield service providers and exploration and production companies. The Manufacturing segment is involved in the sale of products such as horsepower pumps, valves, piping, swivels, large-bore manifold systems, and fluid ends. The Other segment refers to Flotek Industries and Livewire Power, LLC. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Willow Park, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: ProFrac Holding Corp. 從事提供水力壓裂、支撐劑生產和其他完井服務。它透過以下部門運作：增產服務部門、支撐劑生產部門、製造部門和其他部門。增產服務部門擁有一批行動水力壓裂裝置和其他輔助設備，透過向客戶提供增產服務來創造收入。支撐劑生產部門專注於向油田服務提供者以及勘探和生產公司提供支撐劑。製造部門從事馬力幫浦、閥門、管路、旋轉接頭、大口徑歧管系統和流體端等產品的銷售。其他部門是指 Flotek Industries 和 Livewire Power, LLC。該公司成立於 2016 年，總部位於德克薩斯州威洛帕克。

info.description: Pop Culture Group Co., Ltd. engages in developing and hosting hip-hop events. It provides brand promotion services, such as trademark and logo design, visual identity system design, brand positioning, brand personality design, and digital solution and other services as advertisement distribution to corporate clients. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.
info.description_zh: 流行文化集團有限公司從事嘻哈活動的開發與主辦。提供企業客戶商標及標誌設計、視覺辨識系統設計、品牌定位、品牌個性設計、數位解決方案等品牌推廣服務及廣告投放等服務。公司成立於2007年，總部位於中國廈門。

info.description: HWH International, Inc. operates as a lifestyle business through a membership model. It enables home-based people in the new GIG economy to create lasting wealth. Its segments include HWH Marketplace, Hapi Cafe, Hapi Travel Destinations, and Hapi Wealth Builder. HWH Marketplace offers discounted sale of certain products, manufactured by affiliate company, Sharing Services Global Corp., to members. Hapi Cafe offers location-based social experiences where members can build a sense of community with like-minded customers with a potential interest in the same products. Hapi Travel Destinations aims to offer exclusive access to unpublished rates and discounts on air travel, cruises, car rentals, hotels, and resorts for members. Hapi Wealth Builder is exploring options of providing services to members through educational materials and seminars aimed at various types of investing opportunities. The company is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: HWH International, Inc. 透過會員模式經營生活風格企業。它使新零工經濟中的居家人們能夠創造持久的財富。其業務部門包括 HWH Marketplace、Hapi Cafe、Hapi Travel Destinations 和 Hapi Wealth Builder。 HWH Marketplace 向會員提供附屬公司Sharing Services Global Corp. 生產的某些產品的折扣銷售。 Hapi Cafe 提供基於位置的社交體驗，會員可以與對相同產品有潛在興趣的志同道合的客戶建立社區意識。 Hapi Travel Destinations 旨在為會員提供航空旅行、遊輪、汽車租賃、酒店和度假村未公佈的價格和折扣的獨家訪問權。 Hapi Wealth Builder 正在探索透過針對各種投資機會的教育材料和研討會向會員提供服務的選擇。該公司總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Voyager Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on December 19, 2023 and is headquartered in Brooklyn, NY.
info.description_zh: Voyager Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2023年12月19日，總部位於紐約布魯克林。

info.description: Cartesian Growth Corp III is a blank-check company that is sponsored by Cartesian Capital Group LLC. The company aims to acquire or merge with an established, high-growth business seeking access to public markets and capital. The company provides financial and operational expertise post-combination.
info.description_zh: Cartesian Growth Corp III 是一家由 Cartesian Capital Group LLC 贊助的空白支票公司。該公司的目標是收購或合併一家成熟的、高成長的企業，尋求進入公開市場和資本的機會。該公司在合併後提供財務和營運專業知識。

info.description: BitVentures Ltd. engages in the provision of financial services. Its services include wealth management, insurance brokerage, and asset management. The company was founded by Hongwei Han in July 19, 2019 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: BitVentures Ltd. 從事提供金融服務。其服務包括財富管理、保險經紀和資產管理。該公司由韓宏偉於2019年7月19日創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Smart Logistics Global Ltd. operates as a business-to-business contract logistics provider, specializing in industrial raw materials line-haul transportation. The company develops a smart logistics digital ecosystem for road transport by leveraging innovation, digital analytics, and infrastructure development. It enhances supply chain efficiency, shortens transit times, and improves client visibility using its integrated platform. Its services cater to a diverse range of industries including manufacturing, construction, and FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods), enabling seamless and cost-effective movement of goods across regional and national networks. The company was founded by Kwok Chiu Hue on October 8, 2020 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Smart Logistics Global Ltd. 是一家企業對企業合約物流供應商，專門從事工業原料的長程運輸。該公司利用創新、數位分析和基礎設施開發，開發道路運輸智慧物流數位生態系統。它利用其整合平台提高了供應鏈效率、縮短了運輸時間並提高了客戶可視性。其服務滿足製造業、建築業和快速消費品（FMCG）等多種行業的需求，實現跨區域和國家網絡的無縫且經濟高效的貨物運輸。該公司由Kwok Chiu Hue於2020年10月8日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Solidion Technology, Inc. engages in researching, developing and manufacturing battery components and materials, batteries and related energy storage products for the automotive electric vehicle and other markets. The company was founded on June 30, 2023 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Solidion Technology, Inc.從事汽車電動車及其他市場的電池組件和材料、電池及相關儲能產品的研究、開發和製造。該公司成立於2023年6月30日，總部位於德州達拉斯。

info.description: Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc. is multi-platform media company, which engages in the operation of radio stations in the United States. The firm offers marketing solutions across event platforms. It operates through the following business segments: Audio, Digital, and Other. The company was founded by George G. Beasley in 1961 and is headquartered in Naples, FL.
info.description_zh: Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc.是一家多媒體平台公司，在美國從事廣播電台的營運。該公司提供跨活動平台的營銷解決方案。它透過以下業務部門運作：音訊、數位和其他。該公司由 George G. Beasley 於 1961 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州那不勒斯。

info.description: UTStarcom Holdings Corp. is a telecom infrastructure company, which develops technology for cloud-based services, mobile, streaming, and other applications. It operates through the following segments: Equipment, and Services. The Equipment segment focuses on equipment sales including network infrastructure and application products, which include broadband products, wireless infrastructure technologies. The Services segment provides services and support for equipment products and also the new operational support segment. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: UT斯達康控股公司是一家電信基礎設施公司，開發基於雲端的服務、行動、串流媒體和其他應用程式的技術。它透過以下部門運作：設備部門和服務部門。設備部門專注於設備銷售，包括網路基礎設施和應用產品，其中包括寬頻產品、無線基礎設施技術。服務部門為設備產品以及新的營運支援部門提供服務和支援。公司成立於1991年，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: GeneDx Holdings Corp. operates as a health intelligence company. It engages in healthcare with the use of its collected disease data sets. It offers exome and genome testing for diagnosis of genetic disease. The company was founded by Eric Schadt in October 2015 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: GeneDx Holdings Corp. 是一家健康情報公司。它利用收集的疾病數據集從事醫療保健。它提供用於診斷遺傳疾病的外顯子組和基因組測試。該公司由 Eric Sc​​hadt 於 2015 年 10 月創立，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: Krispy Kreme, Inc. produces and distributes doughnuts. It offers yeast-raised doughnuts, pies, coffees and espresso drinks, chillers and iced beverages. It operates through the following segments: U.S. and Canada, International, and Market Development. The U.S. and Canada segment includes all Krispy Kreme's company-owned operations in the U.S. and Canada, Insomnia-branded retail shops and consumer packaged goods operations. The International segment consists of all Krispy Kreme's company-owned operations in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, and Mexico. The Market Development segment handles the franchise operations across the globe, as well as Krispy Kreme company-owned shops in Japan. The firm sells its products through mass merchant, grocery and convenience stores. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Krispy Kreme, Inc. 生產和分銷甜甜圈。它提供酵母甜甜圈、餡餅、咖啡和濃縮咖啡、冰鎮飲料和冰鎮飲料。它透過以下部門運作：美國和加拿大部門、國際部門和市場開發部門。美國和加拿大部門包括 Krispy Kreme 公司在美國和加拿大的所有業務、Insomnia 品牌零售店和消費品業務。國際部門包括 Krispy Kreme 公司在英國、愛爾蘭、澳洲、紐西蘭和墨西哥的所有業務。市場開發部門負責全球範圍內的特許經營業務以及 Krispy Kreme 公司在日本的自營商店。該公司透過大型商家、雜貨店和便利商店銷售其產品。該公司成立於 1937 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Ligand Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company that involves clinical development and commercialization of high-value medicines. Its platforms, Captisol and NITRICI, offer technology with broad applicability in drug development to a large network of biopharmaceutical partners, including the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in the world. The company was founded by Ronald M. Evans in 1987 and is headquartered in Jupiter, FL.
info.description_zh: Ligand Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，涉及高價值藥物的臨床開發和商業化。其 Captisol 和 NITRICI 平台為包括世界上最大的製藥製造商在內的大型生物製藥合作夥伴網路提供在藥物開發方面具有廣泛適用性的技術。該公司由 Ronald M. Evans 於 1987 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州朱庇特。

info.description: Jiuzi Holdings, Inc. engages in franchise and operation of retail stores. The firm sells new energy vehicles (NEVs) under the brand name Jiuzi. It operates through the NEVs Sales and Franchise Services segments. The company was founded on October 10, 2019 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 九子控股有限公司從事零售店的特許經營和經營業務。該公司以「九子」品牌銷售新能源汽車（NEV）。它透過新能源汽車銷售和特許經營服務部門運作。公司成立於2019年10月10日，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of waste management solutions and services.
