It operates through the following segments: U.S. Concrete Pumping, U.S. Concrete Waste Management Services, and the U.K. Operations. The U.S. Concrete Pumping segment includes services under the Brundage-Bone and Capital Pumping trade names. The U.S. Concrete Waste Management Services segment is involved in the pans and containers rented to customers and the disposal services under the Eco-Pan trade name. The U.K. Operations segment relates to the concrete pumping services and leasing of concrete pumping equipment to customers under the Camfaud Concrete Pumps and Premier Concrete Pumping trade names. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Thornton, CO.
info.description_zh: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc. 從事提供廢棄物管理解決方案和服務。它透過以下部門運作：美國混凝土泵送部門、美國混凝土廢棄物管理服務部門和英國營運部門。美國混凝土泵送部門包括以 Brundage-Bone 和 Capital Pumping 商標名稱提供的服務。美國混凝土廢棄物管理服務部門提供向客戶出租的盤子和容器以及以 Eco-Pan 商標名稱提供的處置服務。英國營運部門涉及混凝土泵送服務以及以 Camfaud Concrete Pumps 和 Premier Concrete Pumping 商標名向客戶租賃混凝土泵送設備。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於科羅拉多州桑頓。

info.description: ZK International Group Co., Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the manufacture and sales of stainless steel band, copper strip, welded stainless steel pipes and fittings, valve, light industry machinery equipment, and other stainless steel products. The company was founded by Jian Cong Huang and Guo Lin Wang on May 13, 2015 and is headquartered in Wenzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 中康國際集團有限公司是一家控股公司，主要從事不銹鋼帶、銅帶、不銹鋼焊接管材及管件、閥門、輕工業機械設備等不銹鋼產品的製造和銷售。該公司由黃健聰和王果林於2015年5月13日創立，總部位於中國溫州。

info.description: GBank Financial Holdings, Inc. operates as a bank holding company. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: GBank Financial Holdings, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營。該公司成立於 2007 年，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: Highway Holdings Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of metal, plastic, and electronic parts and components. It operates through the Metal Stamping and Mechanical Original OEM and Electric OEM segments. The Metal Stamping and Mechanical OEM segment focuses on the manufacture and sale of metal parts and components. The Electric OEM segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of plastic and electronic parts, components, and motors. The company was founded by Roland W. Kohl on July 20, 1990 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Highway Holdings Ltd. 從事金屬、塑膠和電子零件的製造和銷售。它透過金屬沖壓和機械原始設備製造商和電氣原始設備製造商部門運作。金屬沖壓和機械OEM部門專注於金屬零件的製造和銷售。電氣 OEM 部門從事塑膠和電子零件、組件和馬達的製造和銷售。該公司由Roland W. Kohl於1990年7月20日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Eagle Financial Services, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of retail and commercial banking services, demand, savings and time deposits, consumer, mortgage and commercial loans. It offers telephone banking, internet banking, and mobile banking to its customers. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Berryville, VA.
info.description_zh: Eagle Financial Services, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營，從事提供零售和商業銀行服務、活期存款、儲蓄和定期存款、消費者貸款、抵押貸款和商業貸款。它為客戶提供電話銀行、網路銀行和手機銀行。該公司成立於 1991 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州貝裡維爾。

info.description: ProShares UltraShort Top QQQ seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times the inverse (-2x) of the daily performance of the Nasdaq-100 Mega Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the Daily Target. The index is designed to measure the performance of the largest companies included in the Nasdaq-100 Index by targeting the performance of approximately the top 45% cumulative weight of the Nasdaq-100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares UltraShort Top QQQ 尋求扣除費用和支出之前的每日投資結果，該結果相當於 Nasdaq-100 Mega Index 每日表現的倒數 (-2x) 的兩倍。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與每日目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數旨在透過納斯達克 100 指數中約前 45% 累積權重的表現來衡量納斯達克 100 指數中最大的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: StoneX Group, Inc. engages in the provision of brokerage and financial services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Hedging, Global Payments, Securities, Physical Commodities, and Clearing and Execution Services. The Commercial Hedging segment offers risk management consulting services. The Global Payments segment includes global payment solutions for banks, commercial businesses, charities, non-governmental, and government organizations. The Securities segment consists of corporate finance advisory services and capital market solutions for middle market clients. The Physical Commodities segment consists of physical precious metals trading and the physical agricultural and energy commodity businesses. The Clearing and Execution Services segment refers to exchange-traded futures and options, foreign exchange prime brokerage, correspondent clearing, independent wealth management, and derivative voice brokerage. The company was founded by Diego J. Veitia in 1924 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: StoneX Group, Inc. 從事提供經紀和金融服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：商業對沖、全球支付、證券、實體商品以及清算和執行服務。商業對沖部門提供風險管理諮詢服務。全球支付部門包括為銀行、商業企業、慈善機構、非政府組織和政府組織提供全球支付解決方案。證券部門包括為中間市場客戶提供企業融資諮詢服務和資本市場解決方案。實體商品業務包括實體貴金屬交易以及實體農產品和能源商品業務。清算和執行服務部門涉及交易所交易的期貨和選擇權、外匯大宗經紀、代理清算、獨立財富管理和衍生性商品語音經紀。該公司由 Diego J. Veitia 於 1924 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Preferred Bank engages in offering financial services. Its services include demand, time, and savings deposits, and real estate, business, and consumer lending. The company was founded by Li Yu on September 9, 1991 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: 優先銀行從事提供金融服務。其服務包括活期存款、定期存款和儲蓄存款，以及房地產、商業和消費貸款。該公司由李宇於1991年9月9日創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Medpace Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of outsourced clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. The firm's services include medical department, clinical trial management, data-driven feasibility, study-start-up, clinical monitoring, regulatory affairs, patient recruitment and retention, medical writing, biometrics and data sciences, pharmacovigilance, core laboratory, laboratories, clinics, and quality assurance. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Europe, Belgium, Asia-Pacific, and Other. The company was founded by August James Troendle in 1992 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Medpace Holdings, Inc. 致力於為生物技術、製藥和醫療器材產業提供外包臨床開發服務。該公司的服務包括醫療部門、臨床試驗管理、數據驅動的可行性、研究啟動、臨床監測、監管事務、患者招募和保留、醫學寫作、生物識別和數據科學、藥物警戒、核心實驗室、實驗室、診所和品質保證。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、歐洲、比利時、亞太地區和其他地區。該公司由 August James Troendle 於 1992 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: Fifth Third Bancorp is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of diversified financial services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Banking, Consumer and Small Business Banking, and Wealth and Asset Management. The Commercial Banking segment offers credit intermediation, cash management, and financial services to large and middle-market businesses and government and professional customers. The Consumer and Small Business Banking segment provides a full range of deposit and loan products to individuals and small businesses through a network of full-service banking centers and relationships with indirect and correspondent loan originators in addition to providing products designed to meet the specific needs of small businesses, including cash management services. The Wealth and Asset Management segment provides wealth management solutions for individuals, companies, and not-for-profit organizations including wealth planning, investment management, banking, insurance, trust, and estate services. The company was founded on October 7, 1974 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Fifth Third Bancorp是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供多元化金融服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業銀行部門、消費者和小型企業銀行部門以及財富和資產管理部門。商業銀行部門為大中型市場企業以及政府和專業客戶提供信貸中介、現金管理和金融服務。消費者和小型企業銀行部門透過全方位服務銀行中心網路以及與間接和代理貸款發起人的關係，向個人和小型企業提供全方位的存款和貸款產品，此外還提供旨在滿足小型企業特定需求的產品，包括現金管理服務。財富與資產管理部門為個人、公司和非營利組織提供財富管理解決方案，包括財富規劃、投資管理、銀行、保險、信託和房地產服務。該公司成立於 1974 年 10 月 7 日，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ ABA Community Bank Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ OMX ABA Community Bank TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to track the performance of small, mid and large capitalization companies that comprise the community banking industry.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ ABA Community Bank Index Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 NASDAQ OMX ABA Community Bank TM Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤社區銀行業中小型、中型和大型資本公司的表現。

info.description: Washington Trust Bancorp, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services, including business banking, personal banking and wealth management, and trust services. It operates through the Commercial Banking and Wealth Management Services segment. The Commercial Banking segment includes commercial, residential and consumer lending activities, mortgage banking activities, deposit generation, cash management activities and direct banking activities, which include the operation of ATMs, telephone and internet banking services and customer support and sales. The Wealth Management Services segment consists of investment management, financial planning, personal trust and estate services, including services as trustee, personal representative, custodian and guardian and institutional trust services, including fiduciary services. The company was founded on January 5, 1984 and is headquartered in Westerly, RI.
info.description_zh: Washington Trust Bancorp, Inc.是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供金融服務，包括商業銀行、個人銀行和財富管理以及信託服務。它透過商業銀行和財富管理服務部門運作。商業銀行部門包括商業、住宅和消費貸款活動、抵押銀行活動、存款產生、現金管理活動和直接銀行活動，其中包括自動櫃員機的營運、電話和網路銀行服務以及客戶支援和銷售。財富管理服務部門包括投資管理、財務規劃、個人信託和遺產服務，包括受託人、個人代表、託管人和監護人的服務以及機構信託服務，包括信託服務。該公司成立於 1984 年 1 月 5 日，總部位於羅德島州韋斯特利。

info.description: Universal Logistics Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of customized transportation and logistics solutions. It operates through the following segments: Contract Logistics, Intermodal, and Trucking. The Contract Logistics segment provides local and regional drayage services coordinated through company-managed terminals. The Intermodal segment provides local and regional drayage services coordinated through company-managed terminals. The Trucking segment includes dry van, flatbed, heavy-haul, and refrigerated operations, transporting a broad range of commodities including automotive parts, machinery, building materials, food products, steel, and other industrial and consumer goods. The company was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Warren, MI.
info.description_zh: Universal Logistics Holdings, Inc. 從事提供客製化運輸和物流解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：合約物流、多式聯運和卡車運輸。合約物流部門透過公司管理的碼頭提供協調的本地和區域拖運服務。多式聯運部門透過公司管理的碼頭提供協調的本地和區域拖運服務。卡車運輸部門包括乾貨車、平板車、重載和冷藏業務，運輸各種商品，包括汽車零件、機械、建築材料、食品、鋼鐵以及其他工業和消費品。該公司成立於 1932 年，總部位於密西根州沃倫。

info.description: Meridian Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and consumer banking services. It operates through the following segments: Banking, Meridian Wealth, and Mortgage Banking. The Banking segment consists of commercial and retail banking. The Meridian Wealth segment offers wealth management services and products. The Mortgage Banking segment consists of the central loan production facility and retail and profit sharing loan production offices. The company was founded by Christopher J. Annas on June 8, 2009 and is headquartered in Malvern, PA.
info.description_zh: Meridian Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供商業和消費者銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：銀行部門、Meridian Wealth 部門和抵押銀行部門。銀行業務部門包括商業銀行業務和零售銀行業務。 Meridian Wealth 部門提供財富管理服務和產品。抵押銀行業務部門由中央貸款生產設施以及零售和利潤分享貸款生產辦公室組成。該公司由 Christopher J. Annas 於 2009 年 6 月 8 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州馬爾文。

info.description: First Business Financial Services, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial banking services. It offers treasury and investment management, commercial lending, equipment finance, retirement plans, trust and estate administration, private banking and asset-based lending. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Madison, WI.
info.description_zh: First Business Financial Services, Inc. 作為銀行控股公司經營，提供商業銀行服務。它提供財務和投資管理、商業貸款、設備融資、退休計劃、信託和遺產管理、私人銀行和資產貸款。該公司成立於 1986 年，總部位於威斯康辛州麥迪遜。

info.description: Zions Bancorporation NA is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of full banking and related services. It operates through the following segments: Zions Bank, Amegy Bank, California Bank & Trust, National Bank of Arizona, Nevada State Bank, Vectra Bank Colorado, and The Commerce Bank of Washington. The company was founded on February 17, 1961, and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Zions Bancorporation NA 是一家銀行控股公司，提供全面的銀行及相關服務。它透過以下部門運作：Zions Bank、Amegy Bank、California Bank & Trust、National Bank of Arizona、Nevada State Bank、Vectra Bank Colorado 和 The Commerce Bank of Washington。該公司成立於 1961 年 2 月 17 日，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Old Second Bancorp, Inc. is a bank holding company. It engages in the provision of traditional retail and commercial banking services through its wholly owned subsidiaries. Its services includes personal banking, loans, business banking, and wealth management. The firm operates through the community banking segment. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Aurora, IL.
info.description_zh: Old Second Bancorp, Inc. 是一家銀行控股公司。它透過其全資子公司提供傳統零售和商業銀行服務。其服務包括個人銀行業務、貸款、商業銀行業務和財富管理。該公司透過社區銀行業務部門運作。該公司成立於 1981 年，總部位於伊利諾州奧羅拉。

info.description: Huntington Bancshares, Inc. engages in the provision of full-service commercial and consumer deposit, lending, and other banking services. It operates through Consumer and Regional Banking, Commercial Banking, and Treasury and Other. The Consumer and Regional Banking segment provides a wide array of financial products and services to consumer and business customers including deposits, lending, payments, mortgage banking, dealer financing, investment management, trust, brokerage, insurance, and other financial products and services. The Commercial Banking segment is involved in expertise through bankers, capabilities, and digital channels, and includes a comprehensive set of product offerings. The Treasury and Other segment relates to technology and operations, as well as other unallocated assets, liabilities, revenues, and expenses. The company was founded in 1866 and is headquartered in Columbus, OH.
info.description_zh: Huntington Bancshares, Inc. 從事提供全方位商業和消費者存款、貸款和其他銀行服務。它透過消費者和區域銀行業務、商業銀行業務以及財政及其他業務開展業務。消費者和區域銀行業務部門為消費者和企業客戶提供廣泛的金融產品和服務，包括存款、貸款、支付、抵押銀行、經銷商融資、投資管理、信託、經紀、保險和其他金融產品和服務。商業銀行部門透過銀行家、能力和數位管道提供專業知識，並提供一整套全面的產品。財務和其他部門涉及技術和運營，以及其他未分配的資產、負債、收入和支出。該公司成立於 1866 年，總部位於俄亥俄州哥倫布。

info.description: Senmiao Technology Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of automobile transaction and related services focusing on the ride-hailing industry. It also provides auto finance solutions through financing leases, car rental services to individual customers. It operates through the Automobile Transaction and Related Services, and the Online Ride-Hailing Platform Services segments. The company was founded in May 2014 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
info.description_zh: 森淼科技有限公司是一家控股公司，專注於叫車產業提供汽車交易及相關服務。它還透過融資租賃、汽車租賃服務為個人客戶提供汽車金融解決方案。它透過汽車交易及相關服務以及線上乘車平台服務部門運作。公司成立於2014年5月，總部位於中國成都。

info.description: Peoples Bancorp of North Carolina, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the business of owning the Bank, Peoples Bank and PEBK Capital Trust II. It operates through the following segments: Banking Operations, Community Bank Real Estate Solutions, LLC (CBRES), and Other. The Banking Operations segment focuses on the consolidated bank. The CBRES segment provides appraisal management services to community banks. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Newton, NC.
info.description_zh: Peoples Bancorp of North Carolina, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事控股銀行、Peoples Bank 和 PEBK Capital Trust II 業務。它透過以下部門運作：銀行業務部門、社區銀行房地產解決方案有限責任公司（CBRES）和其他部門。銀行業務部門專注於合併銀行。 CBRES 部門為社區銀行提供評估管理服務。該公司成立於 1999 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州牛頓。

info.description: First Trust Nasdaq Pharmaceuticals ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq US Smart Pharmaceuticals IndexTM. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depository receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to U.S. companies comprising the pharmaceutical sector that have been selected based upon their liquidity and weighted based upon their cumulative score on three investing factors: volatility, value and growth. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust Nasdaq Pharmaceuticals ETF 尋求與納斯達克美國智能製藥指數TM 的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在提供對包括製藥業在內的美國公司的投資，這些公司是根據其流動性進行選擇的，並根據其在三個投資因素（波動性、價值和增長）的累積得分進行加權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: WesBanco, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It operates through the Community Banking and Trust and Investment Services segments. The Community Banking segment delivers services traditionally offered by service commercial banks, including commercial demand, individual demand, and time deposit accounts, as well as commercial, mortgage, and individual installment loans, and certain non-traditional offerings, such as insurance and securities brokerage services. The Trust and Investment Services segment includes trust services as well as alternative investment products including mutual funds. The company was founded on January 20, 1870 and is headquartered in Wheeling, WV.
info.description_zh: WesBanco, Inc.是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供金融服務。它透過社區銀行以及信託和投資服務部門運作。社區銀行業務部門提供傳統上由服務性商業銀行提供的服務，包括商業活期存款、個人活期存款和定期存款帳戶，以及商業、抵押貸款和個人分期貸款，以及某些非傳統產品，例如保險和證券經紀服務。信託和投資服務部門包括信託服務以及共同基金等另類投資產品。該公司成立於 1870 年 1 月 20 日，總部位於西維吉尼亞州惠靈。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLP ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLP Index (the "Index"). The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the consumer staples sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLP ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLP 指數（「指數」）表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場消費必需品產業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Bio-Techne Corp. is a global life sciences company providing innovative tools and bioactive reagents for research and clinical diagnostic communities. Its products assist scientific investigations into biological processes and the nature and progress of specific diseases. It operates through the Protein Sciences, and Diagnostics and Spatial Biology segments. The Protein Sciences segment develops and manufactures purified proteins, and reagent solutions. The Diagnostics and Spatial Biology segment develops and manufactures diagnostic products. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: Bio-Techne Corp. 是一家全球生命科學公司，為研究和臨床診斷界提供創新工具和生物活性試劑。其產品有助於對生物過程以及特定疾病的性質和進展進行科學研究。它透過蛋白質科學、診斷和空間生物學部門運作。蛋白質科學部門開發和製造純化蛋白質和試劑溶液。診斷和空間生物學部門開發和製造診斷產品。該公司成立於 1976 年，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: ICF International, Inc. engages in the provision of professional services and technology-based solutions to government and commercial clients, including management, marketing, technology, and policy consulting and implementation services. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Reston, VA.
info.description_zh: ICF International, Inc.致力於為政府和商業客戶提供專業服務和基於技術的解決方案，包括管理、行銷、技術以及政策諮詢和實施服務。該公司成立於 1969 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州雷斯頓。

info.description: First National Corp. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of consumer and business banking services through its subsidiary. It offers savings, checking, mortgage lending, home equity, treasury management, construction loan, commercial mortgage, and rental properties. The company was founded on September 7, 1983 and is headquartered in Strasburg, VA.
info.description_zh: First National Corp. 作為一家銀行控股公司經營，透過其子公司提供消費者和商業銀行服務。它提供儲蓄、支票、抵押貸款、房屋淨值、財務管理、建築貸款、商業抵押貸款和租賃房產。該公司成立於 1983 年 9 月 7 日，總部位於維吉尼亞州斯特拉斯堡。

info.description: Business First Bancshares, Inc. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of banking products and services through its subsidiary. It also offers commercial and personal banking, treasury management, and wealth solutions services. The company was founded on July 20, 2006 and is headquartered in Baton Rouge, LA.
info.description_zh: Business First Bancshares, Inc.是一家金融控股公司，透過其子公司提供銀行產品和服務。它還提供商業和個人銀行業務、資金管理和財富解決方案服務。該公司成立於2006年7月20日，總部位於路易斯安那州巴吞魯日。

info.description: Pacer BlueStar Digital Entertainment ETF seeks to track the total return performance of the BlueStar Global Online Gambling, Video Gaming, and eSports Index (the "Index"). The fund employs a "passive management" investment approach designed to track the total return performance of the index. The index is a rules-based index that consists of globally-listed stocks and depositary receipts of digital entertainment companies. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in companies that derive at least 50% of their revenues from Digital Entertainment. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer BlueStar Digital Entertainment ETF 旨在追蹤 BlueStar 全球線上賭博、電玩和電競指數（「指數」）的總回報表現。該基金採用「被動管理」投資方式，旨在追蹤指數的總回報表現。該指數是一個基於規則的指數，由全球上市股票和數位娛樂公司的存託憑證組成。在正常情況下，至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）將投資於至少 50% 收入來自數位娛樂的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Eastern Bankshares, Inc. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial and banking services. It operates through the Banking business segment. The Banking business segment focuses on banking lending, savings, small business offerings, wealth management, and trust operations. The company was founded in 1818 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Eastern Bankshares, Inc. 作為一家控股公司運營，提供金融和銀行服務。它透過銀行業務部門運作。銀行業務部門專注於銀行貸款、儲蓄、小型企業產品、財富管理和信託業務。該公司成立於 1818 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Merchants Bancorp is a bank holding company, which specializes in multiple lines of business in banking and finance. It operates through the following segments: Multi-Family Mortgage Banking, Mortgage Warehousing, Banking, and Other. The Multi-Family Mortgage Banking segment deals with mortgage banking, specializing in originating and servicing loans for multi-family rental housing and healthcare facility financing, particularly for senior living properties. The Mortgage Warehousing segment funds agency eligible loans for non-depository financial institutions from the date of origination or purchase until the date of sale to an investor. The Banking segment refers to financial products and services to consumers and businesses, including commercial, commercial real estate, mortgage, and other consumer loan products, and letters of credit and various types of deposit products, including checking, savings and time deposit accounts. The company was founded by Michael Petrie and Randall D. Rogers in 1990 and is headquartered in Carmel, IN.
info.description_zh: Merchants Bancorp 是一家銀行控股公司，專注於銀行和金融領域的多個業務領域。它透過以下部門運作：多戶抵押銀行業務、抵押倉儲業務、銀行業務和其他業務。多戶型抵押貸款銀行業務部門從事抵押貸款銀行業務，專門為多戶型租賃住房和醫療保健設施融資（特別是老年住宅物業）提供貸款並提供服務。抵押倉儲部門為非存款金融機構提供代理合格貸款的資金，從發放或購買之日起直至出售給投資者之日。銀行業務部門是指為消費者和企業提供金融產品和服務，包括商業、商業房地產、抵押貸款和其他消費貸款產品、信用證和各種類型的存款產品，包括支票、儲蓄和定期存款帳戶。該公司由 Michael Petrie 和 Randall D. Rogers 於 1990 年創立，總部位於印第安納州卡梅爾。

info.description: Utah Medical Products, Inc. engages in the manufacturing, developing, and marketing of disposable and reusable medical devices. It focuses on the healthcare of women and babies. The firm's products are used for blood pressure monitoring and blood collection, electrosurgery, gynecology, neonatal critical care, perinatology, and urology. The company was founded on April 21, 1978 and is headquartered in Midvale, UT.
info.description_zh: Utah Medical Products, Inc. 從事一次性和可重複使用醫療設備的製造、開發和行銷。它專注於婦女和嬰兒的保健。該公司的產品用於血壓監測和血液採集、電外科、婦科、新生兒重症監護、圍產期和泌尿科。該公司成立於 1978 年 4 月 21 日，總部位於猶他州米德維爾。

info.description: Princeton Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company. It is a full-service financial institution that provides business and personal banking. It offers traditional retail banking services, one-to-four-family residential mortgage loans, multi-family and commercial mortgage loans, construction loans, commercial business loans, and consumer loans, including home equity loans and lines of credit. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Princeton, NJ.
info.description_zh: Princeton Bancorp, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營。它是一家提供商業和個人銀行業務的全方位服務金融機構。它提供傳統的零售銀行服務、一到四戶住宅抵押貸款、多戶和商業抵押貸款、建築貸款、商業企業貸款和消費貸款，包括房屋淨值貸款和信貸額度。該公司成立於 2017 年，總部位於新澤西州普林斯頓。

info.description: CF Bankshares, Inc. operates as a financial holding company which is engaged in the provision of business banking products and services. Its products and services include commercial loans and leases, commercial and residential real estate loans and treasury management depository services. It operates through the Real Estate and Consumer segments. The company was founded in September 1998 and is headquartered in Columbus, OH.
info.description_zh: CF Bankshares, Inc. 作為金融控股公司運營，提供商業銀行產品和服務。其產品和服務包括商業貸款和租賃、商業和住宅房地產貸款以及資金管理託管服務。它透過房地產和消費者部門運作。該公司成立於 1998 年 9 月，總部位於俄亥俄州哥倫布。

info.description: KeyCorp is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It operates through the Consumer Bank and Commercial Bank segments. The Consumer Bank segment offers deposit and investment products, personal finance and financial wellness services, lending, mortgage and home equity, student loan refinancing, credit card, treasury services, and business advisory services. The Commercial Bank segment focuses on serving the needs of middle market clients in seven industry sectors, consumer, energy, healthcare, industrial, public sector, real estate, and technology. The company was founded on December 31, 1958 and is headquartered in Cleveland, OH.
info.description_zh: KeyCorp 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供金融服務。它透過消費者銀行和商業銀行部門運作。消費者銀行部門提供存款和投資產品、個人理財和金融健康服務、貸款、抵押貸款和房屋淨值、學生貸款再融資、信用卡、財務服務和商業諮詢服務。商業銀行部門專注於滿足消費、能源、醫療保健、工業、公共部門、房地產和科技等七個行業領域的中間市場客戶的需求。該公司成立於 1958 年 12 月 31 日，總部位於俄亥俄州克利夫蘭。

info.description: Ames National Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services through its subsidiaries. Its activities include personal, business, agricultural and commercial lending, management of the investment securities portfolio, deposit account services, and wealth management services. The company was founded on January 21, 1975 and is headquartered in Ames, IA.
info.description_zh: Ames National Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，透過其子公司提供銀行服務。其業務包括個人、企業、農業和商業貸款、投資證券組合管理、存款帳戶服務和財富管理服務。該公司成立於 1975 年 1 月 21 日，總部位於愛荷華州艾姆斯。

info.description: PulteGroup, Inc. engages in the homebuilding business. The firm is also involved in mortgage banking and title and insurance brokerage operations. It operates through the Homebuilding and Financial services business segments. The Homebuilding segment includes operations from Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Florida, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Ohio, Texas, Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, and Washington. The Financial Services segment is composed of mortgage banking and title operations. The company was founded by William J. Pulte in 1950 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: PulteGroup, Inc. 從事住宅建築業務。該公司還涉足抵押銀行業務以及產權和保險經紀業務。它透過住宅建築和金融服務業務部門運作。住宅建築部門包括康乃狄克州、馬裡蘭州、麻薩諸塞州、紐澤西州、紐約州、賓州、維吉尼亞州、喬治亞州、北卡羅來納州、南卡羅來納州、田納西州、佛羅裡達州、伊利諾州、印第安納州、肯塔基州、密西根州、明尼蘇達州、密蘇裡州、俄亥俄州、德州、亞利桑那州、加利福尼亞州、內華達州、新墨西哥州和內華達州的業務。金融服務部門由抵押銀行業務和產權業務組成。該公司由 William J. Pulte 於 1950 年創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc engages in the distribution and sale of non-alcoholic ready-to-drink beverages. It operates through the following geographical segments: Iberia, Germany, Great Britain, France, Belgium and Luxembourg, Netherlands, Norway, Sweden, and Iceland. The Iberia segment refers to Spain, Portugal, and Andorra. The France segment includes continental France and Monaco. The company was founded on August 4, 2015 and is headquartered in Uxbridge, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: 可口可樂歐洲太平洋合作夥伴有限公司從事非酒精即飲飲料的經銷和銷售。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：伊比利亞半島、德國、英國、法國、比利時和盧森堡、荷蘭、挪威、瑞典和冰島。伊比利亞航段指西班牙、葡萄牙和安道爾。法國部分包括法國本土和摩納哥。該公司成立於2015年8月4日，總部位於英國烏克斯布里奇。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HIMS ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Hims & Hers Health, Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HIMS ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Hims & Hers Health, Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded deliverd deliver 3個） of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於以基礎槓桿 ETF 作為參考資產的衍生品合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Bon Natural Life Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of functional active ingredients extracted from natural herb plants which are widely used by manufacturer customers in the functional food, personal care, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical industries. It offers fragrance compounds, health supplemental powder drinks, and bioactive food ingredients. The company was founded by Yong Wei Hu in 2006 and is headquartered in Xi'an, China.
info.description_zh: Bon Natural Life Ltd.從事從天然草本植物中提取的功能性活性成分的研發、製造和銷售，這些成分被功能性食品、個人護理、化妝品和製藥行業的製造商客戶廣泛使用。它提供香料化合物、保健補充粉末飲料和生物活性食品成分。該公司由胡勇偉於2006年創立，總部位於中國西安。

info.description: BayCom Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services to businesses and business owners, as well as individuals. It focuses on passive investment activities and oversight of its investment to its bank subsidiary. The company was founded by George J. Guarini, Lloyd W. Kendall, Jr., James S. Camp, and Robert G. Laverne in July 2004 and is headquartered in Walnut Creek, CA.
info.description_zh: BayCom Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，致力於為企業和企業主以及個人提供金融服務。它專注於被動投資活動以及對其銀行子公司的投資進行監督。該公司由 George J. Guarini、Lloyd W. Kendall, Jr.、James S. Camp 和 Robert G. Laverne 於 2004 年 7 月創立，總部位於加州核桃溪。

info.description: Burke Herbert Financial Services Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking products and financial services to small to medium-sized businesses, their owners and employees, professional corporations, non-profits, and individuals. It operates through the following loan portfolio segments: Commercial Real Estate, Owner-Occupied Commercial Real Estate, Acquisition, Construction, and Development, Commercial and Industrial, Single Family Residential (1-4 Units), and Consumer Non-Real Estate and Other. The Commercial Real Estate segment includes leasing of the real estate collateral or income generated from the sale of the collateral. The Owner-Occupied Commercial Real Estate segment focuses on the operations of the business that occupies the property and the value of the collateral. The Acquisition, Construction, and Development segment offers creditworthiness of the borrower, project completion within budget, sale after completion, and the value of the collateral. The Commercial and Industrial segment is involved in the operations of the business and the value of the collateral. The Single Family Residential (1-4 Units) segment provides loans for investment purpose carry risk associated with the continued creditworthiness of the borrower, the value of the collateral, and either the net operating income generated from the lease of the real estate collateral or income generated from the sale of the collateral. The Consumer Non-Real Estate and Other segment covers loans carry risk associated with the creditworthiness of the borrower and the value of the collateral. The company was founded on September 14, 2022 and is headquartered in Alexandria, VA.
info.description_zh: Burke Herbert Financial Services Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，致力於向中小型企業及其所有者和員工、專業公司、非營利組織和個人提供銀行產品和金融服務。它透過以下貸款組合部門運作：商業房地產、業主自用商業房地產、收購、建造和開發、商業和工業、單戶住宅（1-4 套）以及消費非房地產和其他。商業房地產部門包括房地產抵押品的租賃或出售抵押品產生的收入。業主自用商業房地產部門專注於佔用該房產的企業的運作以及抵押品的價值。收購、建造和開發部門提供借款人的信譽、預算內的專案完成、完成後的銷售以及抵押品的價值。商業和工業部門涉及業務運營和抵押品價值。單戶住宅（1-4 套）部門提供用於投資目的的貸款，其風險與借款人的持續信譽、抵押品的價值以及租賃房地產抵押品產生的淨營業收入或出售抵押品產生的收入有關。消費者非房地產及其他部門涵蓋具有與借款人信用度和抵押品價值相關的風險的貸款。該公司成立於 2022 年 9 月 14 日，總部位於維吉尼亞州亞歷山大。

info.description: Independent Bank Corp. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It offers commercial banking, mortgage lending, investments, and title services. The company was founded in 1864 and is headquartered in Grand Rapids, MI.
info.description_zh: Independent Bank Corp. 作為一家銀行控股公司經營，提供金融服務。它提供商業銀行、抵押貸款、投資和產權服務。該公司成立於 1864 年，總部位於密西根州大急流城。

info.description: Proem Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 22, 2025 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Proem Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月22日，總部位於德州達拉斯。

info.description: The Cooper Cos, Inc. operates as a medical device company. It operates through the Cooper Vision and Cooper Surgical segments. The Cooper Vision segment develops, manufactures, and markets products for contact lens wearers, which solves vision challenges such as astigmatism, presbyopia, myopia, ocular dryness, and eye fatigues. The Cooper Surgical segment focuses on the provision of advancement for the health of women, babies, and families through women's health and fertility products and services. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Ramon, CA.
info.description_zh: Cooper Cos, Inc. 是一家醫療器材公司。它透過 Cooper Vision 和 Cooper Surgical 部門運作。 Cooper Vision 部門為隱形眼鏡配戴者開發、製造和銷售產品，解決散光、老花眼、近視、眼乾澀和眼睛疲勞等視力挑戰。 Cooper Surgical 部門專注於透過婦女健康和生育產品和服務促進婦女、嬰兒和家庭的健康。該公司成立於 1958 年，總部位於加州聖拉蒙。

info.description: Invesco DWA Consumer Staples Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Consumer Staples Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the consumer staples sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Consumer Staples Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Consumer Staples Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數由至少 30 隻消費必需品產業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: Nuvalent, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on creating precisely targeted therapies for patients with cancer. Its pipeline includes ROS1 NSCLC, ALK NSCLC and HER2 NSCLC. The company was founded by Matthew D. Shair in January 2017 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Nuvalent, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，專注於為癌症患者創造精確的標靶療法。其管道包括ROS1 NSCLC、ALK NSCLC和HER2 NSCLC。該公司由 Matthew D. Shair 於 2017 年 1 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: West Bancorporation, Inc. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial banking services through its subsidiary, West Bank. It offers personal banking, business banking, and investments and trust. The firm operates in the following markets: Central Iowa, which is generally the greater Des Moines metropolitan area, eastern Iowa, which includes the area surrounding Iowa City and Coralville, and Southern Minnesota, which includes the cities of Rochester, Owatonna, Mankato, and St. Cloud. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in West Des Moines, IA.
info.description_zh: West Bancorporation, Inc. 是一家金融控股公司，透過其子公司 West Bank 提供商業銀行服務。它提供個人銀行業務、商業銀行業務以及投資和信託業務。該公司在以下市場開展業務：愛荷華州中部（通常是得梅因大都會區）、愛荷華州東部（包括愛荷華市和科拉爾維爾週邊地區）以及明尼蘇達州南部（包括羅徹斯特市、奧瓦通納市、曼凱托市和聖克勞德市）。該公司成立於 1984 年，總部位於愛荷華州西得梅因。

info.description: Acco Group Holdings Ltd. operates as a holding company which provides management consulting services through its subsidiaries. It services include company secretary service, notarization services, open bank account services, virtual office services, HR and payroll services. The firm specializes in offering corporate secretarial services and accounting services in Hong Kong, as well as intellectual properties (IP) registration services in Singapore. The company was founded on May 31, 2024 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Acco Group Holdings Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，透過其子公司提供管理諮詢服務。它的服務包括公司秘書服務、公證服務、開立銀行帳戶服務、虛擬辦公室服務、人力資源和薪資服務。該公司專門在香港提供公司秘書服務和會計服務，並在新加坡提供智慧財產權（IP）註冊服務。該公司成立於2024年5月31日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Astoria Dynamic Core US Fixed Income ETF seeks current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in other U.S. fixed income ETFs. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of borrowing for investment purposes) directly or indirectly in U.S. fixed income securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Astoria Dynamic Core 美國固定收益 ETF 尋求當前收益。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過主要投資於其他美國固定收益 ETF 來實現其投資目標。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上投資目的借款金額）直接或間接投資於美國固定收益證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Arhaus, Inc. engages in the retail of furniture, outdoor, lighting, textiles, and decor. The company was founded by John Reed in 1986 and is headquartered in Hudson, OH.
info.description_zh: Arhaus, Inc. 從事家具、戶外用品、照明、紡織品和裝飾品的零售。該公司由 John Reed 於 1986 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州哈德遜。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2029 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2029 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2029 (collectively, "2029 Bonds").
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2029 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2029 指數（「基本指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2029 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）（統稱為「2029 年債券」）的表現。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2030 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2030. It does not purchase all of the securities in the index; instead, the fund utilizes a "sampling" methodology to seek to achieve its investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2030 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2030 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。它不會購買指數中的所有證券；相反，該基金採用"抽樣"方法來尋求實現其投資目標。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Bassett Furniture Industries, Inc. engages in manufacturing, marketing, and retailing home furnishings. It operates through the following segments: Wholesale, Retail, and Corporate and Other. The Wholesale segment focuses on the designing, manufacturing, and sourcing of furniture products. The Retail segment consists of company-owned stores and includes revenues, expenses, assets and liabilities, and capital expenditures. The Corporate and Other segment includes the shared costs of corporate functions. The company was founded by John David Bassett, Sr. in 1902 and is headquartered in Bassett, VA.
info.description_zh: Bassett Furniture Industries, Inc. 從事家居用品的製造、行銷和零售。它透過以下部門運作：批發、零售、企業及其他部門。批發部門專注於家具產品的設計、製造和採購。零售部門由公司自有商店組成，包括收入、支出、資產和負債以及資本支出。公司及其他部門包括公司職能的分攤成本。該公司由 John David Bassett, Sr. 於 1902 年創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州巴塞特。

info.description: CCH Holdings Ltd. engages in operating a chicken restaurant. It offers catering services in Malaysia and outside Malaysia under the brand name, Chicken Claypot House for its chicken hotpot restaurants and Zi Wei Yuan for its fish head hotpot restaurants. The company was founded by Goh Kok Foong on December 2, 2024 and is headquartered in Seberang Perai, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: CCH Holdings Ltd.從事經營雞肉餐廳。該公司在馬來西亞和馬來西亞境外提供餐飲服務，品牌為雞煲屋（其雞肉火鍋店）和紫味園（其魚頭火鍋店）。該公司由 Goh Kok Foong 於 2024 年 12 月 2 日創立，總部位於馬來西亞威省。

info.description: Churchill Capital Corp. XI is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded by Michael Stuart Klein on June 4, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Churchill Capital Corp. XI 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司由 Michael Stuart Klein 於 2025 年 6 月 4 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: CLPS, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of information technology, consulting, and solution services to banking, insurance, and financial sectors. It operates through the IT Services and Academic Education Services segments. The company was founded by Ming Hui Ling on August 30, 2005 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: CLPS, Inc.是一家控股公司，致力於為銀行、保險和金融業提供資訊科技、諮詢和解決方案服務。它透過 IT 服務和學術教育服務部門運作。該公司由明慧玲於2005年8月30日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Dave, Inc. is a digital banking service. Its products include a budgeting tool to help members manage their upcoming bills to avoid overspending, cash advances through its flagship ExtraCash product to help members avoid punitive overdraft fees, a Side Hustle product, where Dave helps connect members with supplemental work opportunities, and Dave Banking, a modern checking account experience with valuable tools for building long-term financial health. The company was founded by Jason Wilk, Paras Chitrakar, and John Wolanin in October 2015 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Dave, Inc. 是一家數位銀行服務公司。其產品包括預算工具，幫助會員管理即將到來的帳單，避免超支；透過旗艦產品 ExtraCash 產品預支現金，幫助會員避免懲罰性透支費用；Side Hustle 產品，Dave 幫助會員獲得補充工作機會；Dave Banking，一種現代支票帳戶體驗，提供建立長期財務健康的寶貴工具。該公司由 Jason Wilk、Paras Chitrakar 和 John Wolanin 於 2015 年 10 月創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Dogness (International) Corp. engages in the provision of design and manufacture of pet products, including leashes, and smart products. Its products include leashes, lanyards, ribbon, collars, harnesses ornaments, and specialty products for cats and dogs. The firm produces the products in Classic, Elegance, Luxury, LED, Holiday, Special Function, and Cat series. The company was founded by Shilong Chen in 2003 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
info.description_zh: 多尼斯（國際）有限公司從事寵物產品的設計和製造，包括牽引繩和智慧產品。其產品包括皮帶、掛繩、緞帶、項圈、挽具裝飾品以及貓狗專用產品。本公司生產的產品有經典系列、優雅系列、豪華系列、LED系列、假日系列、特殊功能係列、貓咪系列等。該公司由陳世龍於2003年創立，總部位於中國東莞。

info.description: DXP Enterprises, Inc. engages in the business of distributing maintenance, repair, and operating (MRO) products and services to customers serving a variety of end markets. It operates through the following segments: Service Centers (SC), Supply Chain Services (SCS), Innovative Pumping Solutions (IPS), and Corporate. The SC segment provides MRO products, equipment, and services including technical expertise and logistics capabilities to customers serving varied end markets with the ability to provide same day delivery. The SCS segment focuses on managing customers' supply chains including procurement and inventory management. The IPS segment includes integrated, custom pump skid packages, pump remanufacturing, and manufactures branded private label pumps to meet the capital equipment needs of the global customer base. The company was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: DXP Enterprises, Inc. 從事向服務各種終端市場的客戶分銷維護、維修和營運 (MRO) 產品和服務的業務。它透過以下部門運作：服務中心 (SC)、供應鏈服務 (SCS)、創新泵送解決方案 (IPS) 和企業部門。 SC 部門向服務不同終端市場的客戶提供 MRO 產品、設備和服務，包括技術專業知識和物流能力，並能夠提供當日交付。 SCS部門專注於管理客戶的供應鏈，包括採購和庫存管理。 IPS 部門包括整合、客製化泵橇套件、泵浦再製造以及製造品牌自有品牌泵，以滿足全球客戶群的資本設備需求。該公司成立於 1908 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Emmis Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on March 21, 2025 and is headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL.
info.description_zh: Emmis Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年3月21日，總部位於佛羅裡達州勞德代爾堡。

info.description: FG Imperii Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 16, 2025 and is headquartered in Itasca, IL.
info.description_zh: FG Imperii Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 9 月 16 日，總部位於伊利諾伊州艾塔斯卡。

info.description: Fly-E Group, Inc. is an electric vehicle company, which engages in designing, installing, and selling smart electric motorcycles, electric bikes, electric scooters, and related accessories under the brand Fly E-Bike. Its products include electric-scooter, e-bikes, parts, and accessories. The company was founded by Zhou Ou in 2018 and is headquartered in Flushing, NY.
info.description_zh: Fly-E Group, Inc.是一家電動車公司，以Fly E-Bike品牌從事設計、安裝和銷售智慧電動摩托車、電動自行車、電動滑板車及相關配件。其產品包括電動滑板車、電動自行車、零件和配件。該公司由周歐於2018年創立，總部位於紐約法拉盛。

info.description: First Trust IPOX Europe Equity Opportunities ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the IPOX  -100 Europe Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index seeks to measure the performance of the equity securities of the 100 largest and typically most liquid initial public offerings ("IPOs") (including spin-offs and equity carve-outs) of companies that are economically tied to Europe. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust IPOX Europe Equity Opportunities ETF 尋求與稱為 IPOX -100 Europe Index（「指數」）的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在衡量與歐洲經濟相關的 100 家規模最大且通常流動性最強的首次公開發行（「IPO」）（包括分拆和股權分拆）公司的股票表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Forward Air Corp. engages in the provision of less-than-truckload (LTL), truckload, intermodal and pool distribution services. It operates through the following segments: Expedited LTL and Intermodal. The Expedited LTL segment provides expedited regional, inter-regional and national LTL, final mile and truckload services. The Intermodal segment provides first and last-mile high value intermodal container drayage services both to and from seaports and railheads. The company was founded by Scott M. Niswonger on October 23, 1981 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Forward Air Corp. 從事提供零擔 (LTL)、卡車裝載、聯運和聯營配送服務。它透過以下部門運作：加急零擔和聯運。加急零擔部分提供加急區域、區域間和國家零擔、最後一哩路和整車服務。多式聯運部門提供往返海港和鐵路樞紐的第一英里和最後一英里高價值多式聯運貨櫃拖運服務。該公司由 Scott M. Niswonger 於 1981 年 10 月 23 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: Gelteq Ltd. operates as a biotechnology company. It focuses on the development and commercialization of white label gel-based delivery solutions for prescription drugs, nutraceuticals, pet care, and other products. The firm also offers edible gels. The company was founded by Nathan J. Givoni and Simon H. Szewach on October 15, 2018 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Gelteq Ltd. 是一家生技公司。它專注於處方藥、營養保健品、寵物護理和其他產品的基於白標凝膠的輸送解決方案的開發和商業化。該公司還提供可食用凝膠。該公司由 Nathan J. Givoni 和 Simon H. Szewach 於 2018 年 10 月 15 日創立，總部位於澳洲墨爾本。

info.description: GSR IV Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It engages in the effecting of a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded in May 10, 2023 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: GSR IV Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它從事與一個或多個企業的合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2023年5月10日，總部位於德州奧斯汀。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Value Opportunities ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes (measured at the time of purchase) ("Net Assets") in a portfolio of equity securities. Although it will invest primarily in publicly traded U.S. securities, it may invest up to 20% of its Net Assets in foreign securities, including securities of issuers in countries with emerging markets or economies ("emerging countries") and securities quoted in foreign currencies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 高盛價值機會ETF尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款（在購買時計量）（「淨資產」）投資於股本證券投資組合。儘管將主要投資於公開交易的美國證券，但最多可將其淨資產的20%投資於外國證券，包括新興市場或經濟體國家（「新興國家」）發行人的證券以及以外幣報價的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Helix Acquisition Corp. III operates as blank check company. The company was founded on September 10, 2025 and is headquartered in Boston. MA.
info.description_zh: Helix Acquisition Corp. III 以空白支票公司經營。該公司成立於2025年9月10日，總部位於波士頓。馬。

info.description: Hooker Furnishings Corp. engages in the design, marketing, and import of wooden and metal, leather, fabric-upholstered, and outdoor furniture. It operates its business through the following business segments: Hooker Branded and Domestic Upholstery. The Hooker Branded segment refers to the operations of its imported Hooker Casegoods and Hooker Upholstery businesses. The Domestic Upholstery segment includes the domestic upholstery manufacturing operations of Bradington-Young, HF Custom, Shenandoah Furniture, and Sunset West. The company was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Martinsville, VA.
info.description_zh: Hooker Furnishings Corp. 從事木質和金屬、皮革、織物軟墊和戶外家具的設計、行銷和進口。它透過以下業務部門運營其業務：胡克品牌和國內室內裝飾。 Hooker Branded 部門是指其進口 Hooker Casegoods 和 Hooker Upholstery 業務的營運。國內室內裝潢部門包括 Bradington-Young、HF Custom、Shenandoah Furniture 和 Sunset West 的國內室內裝潢製造業務。該公司成立於 1924 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州馬丁斯維爾。

info.description: Harrow, Inc. engages in the development, production, and sale of innovative medications. It operates through the following segments: Pharmaceutical Compounding and Pharmaceutical Drug Development. The Pharmaceutical Compounding segment focuses on the operations of the ImprimisRx business. The company was founded by Mark L. Baum and Robert J. Kammer on January 11, 2006 and is headquartered in Nashville, TN.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Harrow, Inc. 從事創新藥物的開發、生產和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：藥物配製和藥物開發。藥物複合部門專注於 ImprimisRx 業務的運作。該公司由 Mark L. Baum 和 Robert J. Kammer 於 2006 年 1 月 11 日創立，總部位於田納西州納許維爾。

info.description: Inno Holdings, Inc. engages in the marketing and sale of construction products. It offers services required to transform raw materials into precise steel framing products and prefabricated homes. The company was founded on September 8, 2021 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Inno Holdings, Inc. 從事建築產品的行銷和銷售。它提供將原材料轉化為精密鋼框架產品和預製房屋所需的服務。該公司成立於2021年9月8日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Investar Holding Corp. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of full banking services. It offers a full range of commercial and retail lending products throughout its market areas, including business loans to small to medium-sized businesses as well as loans to individuals. Its lending products consists of owner-occupied commercial real estate loans, construction loans and commercial and industrial loans, such as term loans, equipment financing and lines of credit, while its loans to individuals include first and second mortgage loans, installment loans, and lines of credit. The company was founded on September 24, 2009 and is headquartered in Baton Rouge, LA.
info.description_zh: Investar Holding Corp.是一家金融控股公司，提供全方位銀行服務。它在整個市場領域提供全方位的商業和零售貸款產品，包括向中小型企業提供商業貸款以及向個人提供貸款。其貸款產品包括自住商業房地產貸款、建築貸款以及商業和工業貸款，如定期貸款、設備融資和信用額度，而個人貸款包括第一和第二抵押貸款、分期貸款和信用額度。該公司成立於2009年9月24日，總部位於路易斯安那州巴吞魯日。

info.description: Karat Packaging, Inc. manufactures and distributes disposable products for the restaurants and foodservice industry. The company was founded by Alan Yu and Marvin Cheng in 2000 and is headquartered in Chino, CA.
info.description_zh: Karat Packaging, Inc. 為餐廳和食品服務業生產和分銷一次性產品。該公司由 Alan Yu 和 Marvin Cheng 於 2000 年創立，總部位於加州奇諾。

info.description: Direxion Daily LMT Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of LMT. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of LMT and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to LMT, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily LMT Bull 2X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 LMT 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 LMT 證券和掉期協議和選擇權等金融工具，這些組合為 LMT 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Launch Two Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on May 13, 2024 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Launch Two Acquisition Corp.是一家空白支票公司，從事與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年5月13日，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: M3-Brigade Acquisition V Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on March 12, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: M3-Brigade Acquisition V Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年3月12日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: JPMorgan Fundamental Data Science Mid Core ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of mid cap companies. Many of the equity securities in the fund's portfolio are securities of companies in the financials, industrials and consumer discretionary sectors. In managing the fund, the adviser employs a fundamental data science enabled investment approach that combines research, data insights, and risk management.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通基本資料科學中核心 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。一般情況下，該基金至少80%的資產投資於中型公司的股本證券。該基金投資組合中的許多股本證券是金融、工業和非必需消費品行業公司的證券。在管理基金時，顧問採用了基礎數據科學支持的投資方法，結合了研究、數據洞察和風險管理。

info.description: Meshflow Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 22, 2025 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Meshflow Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月22日，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Martin Midstream Partners LP engages in collecting, transporting, storing, and distributing petroleum products and by-products. It operates through the following segments: Terminalling and Storage, Transportation, Sulfur Services, and Specialty Products. The Terminalling and Storage segment offers storage, refining, blending, packaging, and handling services for producers and suppliers of petroleum products and by-products, including the refining of naphthenic crude oil and the blending and packaging of various grades and quantities of industrial, commercial, and automotive lubricants and greases. The Transportation segment manages a fleet of inland marine tank barges, inland push boats and offshore tugs, and barge units that transport petroleum products and by-products. The Sulfur Services segment develops an integrated system of transportation assets and facilities relating to sulfur services. The Specialty Products segment is involved in the sale and distribution of Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs). The company was founded on June 21, 2002 and is headquartered in Kilgore, TX.
info.description_zh: Martin Midstream Partners LP 從事收集、運輸、儲存和分銷石油產品和副產品。該公司透過以下部門運作：碼頭和儲存部門、運輸部門、硫磺服務部門和特殊產品部門。終端和儲存部門為石油產品和副產品的生產商和供應商提供儲存、精煉、混合、包裝和裝卸服務，包括環烷原油的精煉以及各種等級和數量的工業、商業和汽車潤滑油和潤滑脂的混合和包裝。運輸部門管理一支由內陸海運油罐駁船、內陸推船和近海拖船以及運輸石油產品和副產品的駁船組成的船隊。硫磺服務部門開發與硫磺服務相關的運輸資產和設施的綜合系統。特種產品部門從事液化天然氣（NGL）的銷售和分銷。該公司成立於2002年6月21日，總部位於德克薩斯州基爾戈。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2033 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2033, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2033 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2033年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Harrison Street Infrastructure Active ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified fund that invests in a global portfolio of listed infrastructure companies providing essential services across regulated and high-barrier-to-entry markets. The fund utilizes fundamental, bottom-up analysis to identify resilient businesses in sectors such as utilities, midstream energy, digital infrastructure, and transportation, aiming for long-term capital appreciation and income.
info.description_zh: Harrison Street 基礎設施主動 ETF 是一檔主動管理的非多元化基金，投資於全球上市基礎設施公司投資組合，這些公司在受監管和高准入市場提供基本服務。該基金利用基本面、自下而上的分析來識別公用事業、中游能源、數位基礎設施和交通等行業的彈性業務，旨在實現長期資本增值和收入。

info.description: Norwood Financial Corp. is a bank holding company, which offers financial services and traditional banking to individual, business and government customers. It offers debit cards, savings accounts, personal loans, credit card, business lending, and wealth management. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Honesdale, PA.
info.description_zh: Norwood Financial Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，為個人、企業和政府客戶提供金融服務和傳統銀行業務。它提供借記卡、儲蓄帳戶、個人貸款、信用卡、商業貸款和財富管理。該公司成立於 1995 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州洪斯代爾。

info.description: OneIM Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 05, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: OneIM Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月5日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Direxion Daily ORCL Bear 1X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of ORCL. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X daily inverse (opposite) or short exposure to ORCL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily ORCL Bear 1X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）與 ORCL 每日表現的 100% 反向（或相反）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和期權，這些金融工具結合起來提供 1 倍每日反向（相反）或空頭 ORCL 敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco DWA Financial Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Financials Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the financials sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Financial Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Financials Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由至少 30 家金融業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: Propanc Biopharma, Inc. is a development-stage healthcare company, which engages in the research and development of cancer treatments. The firm focuses on the treatment of pancreatic, ovarian, and colorectal cancer. It offers its product pipeline, including PRP and POP1. The company was founded by James Nathanielsz and Julian Kenyon on October 15, 2007 and is headquartered in Camberwell, Australia.
info.description_zh: Propanc Biopharma, Inc.是一家處於發展階段的醫療保健公司，從事癌症治療的研究和開發。該公司專注於胰腺癌、卵巢癌和大腸癌的治療。它提供其產品線，包括 PRP 和 POP1。該公司由 James Nathanielsz 和 Julian Kenyon 於 2007 年 10 月 15 日創立，總部位於澳洲坎伯韋爾。

info.description: Quhuo Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the development of a workforce operational solution platform. Its services include on-demand food delivery solutions, ride-hailing solutions, housekeeping solutions, and shared-bike maintenance solutions. It operates through the On-Demand Delivery Solutions and Others segments. The On-Demand Delivery Solutions focuses on the last-mile delivery of prepared food. The Others segment refers to mobility service solutions, housekeeping and accommodation solutions, and other services. The company was founded by Zhen Ba, Shu Yi Yang, and Leslie Yu in March 2012 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Quhuo Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事勞動力營運解決方案平台的開發。其服務包括按需送餐解決方案、叫車解決方案、家政解決方案和共享單車維護解決方案。它透過按需交付解決方案和其他部門運作。按需配送解決方案專注於預製食品的最後一哩配送。其他部門指行動服務解決方案、家事和住宿解決方案以及其他服務。該公司由Zhen Ba、Shu Yi Yang和Leslie Yu於2012年3月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Reitar Logtech Holdings Ltd. engages in asset management services to logistics property investors including funds, family offices, property owners, and high-net-worth individuals. It operates through Construction Management and Engineering Design Services and Asset Management and Professional Consultancy Services segments. The company was founded by Hau Lim Chung and Chun Yip Yiu in 2015 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Reitar Logtech Holdings Ltd. 為物流房地產投資者（包括基金、家族辦公室、業主和高淨值人士）提供資產管理服務。它透過施工管理和工程設計服務以及資產管理和專業諮詢服務部門運作。該公司由 Hau Lim Chung 和 Chun Yip Yao 於 2015 年創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: iShares 1-3 Year Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 1-3 Year Bond Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and it will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of public obligations of the U.S. Treasury that have a remaining maturity of greater than or equal to one year and less than three years.
info.description_zh: iShares 1-3 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 美國 1-3 年期公債指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的成分證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於基金追蹤基礎指數的美國國債。該指數衡量美國財政部剩餘期限大於或等於一年且小於三年的公共債務的履行。

info.description: Themes US Small Cap Cash Flow Champions ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive US Small Cap Cash Flow Champions Index. The index is a free-float adjusted, market capitalization weighted index that is designed to provide exposure to small capitalization U.S. companies that have a high cash flow yield. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the securities that comprise the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 主題 US Small Cap Cash Flow Champions ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive US Small Cap Cash Flow Champions Index 扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在為現金流收益率較高的美國小市值公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Smith Micro Software, Inc. engages in the provision of software solutions. It offers wireless internet solutions which enable access to information and entertainment. Its products include SafePath Family, SafePath IoT, SafePath Home, CommSuite VVM, CommSuite VTT, and ViewSpot. The company was founded by William W. Smith Jr. on November 30, 1982 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.
info.description_zh: Smith Micro Software, Inc. 從事提供軟體解決方案。它提供無線互聯網解決方案，可以存取資訊和娛樂。其產品包括SafePath系列、SafePath IoT、SafePath Home、CommSuite VVM、CommSuite VTT和ViewSpot。該公司由 William W. Smith Jr. 於 1982 年 11 月 30 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州匹茲堡。

info.description: Xtrackers S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight Index. The underlying index is designed to track the performance of the constituent securities of the S&P 500 Index reweighted to mitigate concentration risk and address sector imbalances. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in component securities of the underlying index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight ETF 尋求整體上與 S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight Index 的表現（未計費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。基礎指數旨在追蹤重新加權的標準普爾 500 指數成分證券的表現，以減輕集中風險並解決產業失衡問題。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於相關指數的組成證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: China Sxt Pharmaceuticals, Inc. operates as a holding company, which engages in the research, development, manufacture, marketing, and sales of traditional Chinese medicine pieces (TCMP). Its product categories include directly-oral, after-soaking-oral, fine, and regular TCMP. The firm distributes its product under the Suxuantang brand. The company was founded by Feng Zhou in 2005 and is headquartered in Taizhou, China.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: 中國Sxt Pharmaceuticals, Inc.作為一家控股公司，從事中藥飲片（TCMP）的研究、開發、製造、行銷和銷售。其產品類別包括直接口服、浸泡後口服、精品、一般中藥。該公司以蘇玄堂品牌分銷其產品。該公司由周鋒於2005年創立，總部位於中國台州。

info.description: Thornburg International Growth ETF seeks long-term capital growth. The fund adviser expects to invest primarily in equity securities or depositary receipts of non-U.S. developed market issuers selected for their growth potential. Thornburg, the fund's investment adviser, intends to invest in companies that it believes have growth characteristics, such as growing revenues and earnings or the prospect for such growth in revenues or earnings. The fund can invest in companies of any size, from larger, well-established companies to smaller, emerging growth companies. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Thornburg International Growth ETF 尋求長期資本成長。該基金顧問預計將主要投資於根據成長潛力而選擇的非美國已開發市場發行人的股本證券或存託憑證。該基金的投資顧問桑伯格打算投資於它認為具有成長特徵的公司，例如收入和收益不斷增長或收入或收益有成長前景的公司。該基金可以投資任何規模的公司，從大型、成熟的公司到小型、新興的成長型公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: VictoryShares Corporate Bond ETF seeks maximum current income without undue risk to principal. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in corporate bonds, and in related derivatives and other instruments that have economic characteristics similar to corporate bonds. The fund will invest primarily in investment-grade securities, but may invest up to 10% of its net assets in below-investment-grade corporate credit securities, which are sometimes referred to as high-yield or "junk" bonds.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares 公司債 ETF 尋求最大當前收入，而不會對本金帶來不當風險。一般情況下，基金至少80%的淨資產投資於公司債，以及相關衍生性商品和其他具有與公司債類似經濟特徵的工具。該基金將主要投資於投資等級證券，但最多可將其淨資產的 10% 投資於低於投資等級的企業信貸證券，這些證券有時被稱為高收益或「垃圾」債券。

info.description: WisdomTree Voya Yield Enchanced USD Universal Bond Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bloomberg US Universal Enhanced Yield Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in the component securities of the index. The index is comprised of USD-denominated bonds. The index deconstructs the USD-denominated bond market, as represented by USD-denominated, taxable bonds that are rated either investment grade or high yield, into one of the five categories of debt. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree Voya 收益率增強型美元通用債券基金旨在追蹤彭博美國通用增強型收益率指數（未計費用和開支）的價格和收益率表現。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，將投資於指數的組成證券。該指數由以美元計價的債券組成。該指數將以美元計價的債券市場（以投資等級或高收益評級的美元計價應稅債券為代表）分解為五類債務之一。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: USCB Financial Holdings, Inc. engages in banking activities. It offers lending services, credit practices, deposit products, title services, and other banking related services. The company was founded on December 17, 2021 and is headquartered in Doral, FL.
info.description_zh: USCB Financial Holdings, Inc. 從事銀行活動。它提供貸款服務、信貸業務、存款產品、產權服務和其他銀行相關服務。該公司成立於2021年12月17日，總部位於佛羅裡達州多拉。

info.description: Velo3D, Inc. operates as a technology company, which engages in developing and manufacturing metal laser sintering printing machines for 3D printing. Its products include assure system, flow software, sapphire printer & sapphire XC. The company was founded by Benyamin Buller in June 2014 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Velo3D, Inc.是一家科技公司，致力於開發和製造用於3D列印的金屬雷射燒結印表機。其產品包括保固系統、流程軟體、藍寶石印表機和藍寶石XC。該公司由 Benyamin Buller 於 2014 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: XChange TEC., Inc is engaged in the insurance agency business. It provides insurance products for state-owned properties and casualty insurance companies, regional properties, and casualty insurance companies. The company was founded in 2012 by Guang Jie Jin and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: XChange TEC., Inc.從事保險代理業務。為國有財產保險公司、地區財產保險公司提供保險產品。該公司由金光傑於2012年創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Galata Acquisition Corp. II is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 20, 2025 and is headquartered in Nashville, TN.
info.description_zh: Galata Acquisition Corp. II 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月20日，總部位於田納西州納許維爾。

info.description: WillScot Holdings Corp. engages in modular and portable storage services. The firm offers furniture rental, transportation and logistics, storage and facilities services, and commercial real estate services. The company was founded in 1944 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.description_zh: WillScot Holdings Corp. 從事模組化和可攜式儲存服務。該公司提供家具租賃、運輸和物流、倉儲和設施服務以及商業房地產服務。該公司成立於 1944 年，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: Phillips Edison & Co., Inc. is a real estate investment trust, which engages in the ownership and operation of shopping centers. It also offers an investment management business providing property management and advisory services. Its portfolio consists of well-occupied, grocery-anchored neighborhood and community shopping centers having a mix of national, regional, and local retailers offering necessity-based goods and services. The company was founded by Jeffrey S. Edison and Michael C. Phillips in 1991 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 零售
info.description_zh: Phillips Edison & Co., Inc. 是一家房地產投資信託公司，從事購物中心的所有權和營運業務。它還提供投資管理業務，提供物業管理和諮詢服務。其投資組合包括繁忙的雜貨店為主的鄰里和社區購物中心，其中包括提供必需品和服務的國家、地區和當地零售商。該公司由 Jeffrey S. Edison 和 Michael C. Phillips 於 1991 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: First Bank is a state-chartered commercial bank, which offers a traditional range of deposit and loan products to individuals and businesses in its Central and Southern New Jersey markets. Its primary focus includes providing a wide range of commercial and retail and related banking services. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Hamilton, NJ.
info.description_zh: 第一銀行是一家州特許商業銀行，向新澤西州中部和南部市場的個人和企業提供一系列傳統的存款和貸款產品。其主要重點包括提供廣泛的商業和零售及相關銀行服務。該公司成立於 2007 年，總部位於新澤西州漢密爾頓。

info.description: Fortress Value Acquisition Corp. V is a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 24, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Fortress Value Acquisition Corp. V 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年11月24日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Align Technology, Inc. is a medical device company, which engages in the design, manufacture, and market of orthodontics, restorative, and aesthetic dentistry products. It operates through the Clear Aligner and Systems and Services segments. The Clear Aligner segment consists of invisalign full, teen, and assist products, and Vivera retainers for treating malocclusion. The Systems and Services segment includes sales related to iTero intraoral scanning systems, which includes a single hardware platform and restorative or orthodontic software options, upgrades and leases of scanner systems, sales of pre-owned scanner systems, subscription software, disposables, pay per scan services, as well as exocad's CAD/CAM software solutions that integrate workflows to dental labs and dental practices. The company was founded by Zia Chishti, Brian Freyburger, and Kelsey Wirth in March 1997 and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: Align Technology, Inc.是一家醫療器材公司，從事矯正、修復和美容牙科產品的設計、製造和銷售。它透過 Clear Aligner 以及系統和服務部門運作。 Clear Aligner 部分包括 Invisalign 完整版、青少年版和輔助產品，以及用於治療咬合不正的 Vivera 固定器。系統和服務部門包括與 iTero 口內掃描系統相關的銷售，其中包括單一硬體平台和修復或矯正軟體選項、掃描器系統的升級和租賃、二手掃描器系統的銷售、訂閱軟體、一次性用品、按掃描付費服務，以及將工作流程整合到牙科實驗室和牙科診所的 exocad CAD/CAM 軟體解決方案。該公司由 Zia Chishti、Brian Freyburger 和 Kelsey Wirth 於 1997 年 3 月創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: First US Bancshares, Inc. operates as a holding company for First U.S. Bank. It provides services including receipt of demand, savings, individual retirement account and time deposits, personal and commercial loans, safe deposit box services and remote deposit capture through its subsidiary. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Birmingham, AL.
info.description_zh: First US Bancshares, Inc. 以第一美國銀行的控股公司運作。它透過其子公司提供的服務包括接受活期存款、儲蓄、個人退休帳戶和定期存款、個人和商業貸款、保險箱服務以及遠端存款提取。該公司成立於 1981 年，總部位於阿拉巴馬州伯明罕。

info.description: Voyager Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on December 19, 2023 and is headquartered in Brooklyn, NY.
info.description_zh: Voyager Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2023年12月19日，總部位於紐約布魯克林。

info.description: FirstService Corp. engages in the provision of property services. It operates through the FirstService Residential and FirstService Brands segments. The FirstService Residential segment offers residential property management services in North America. The FirstService Brands segment covers residential and commercial customers through both franchise systems, and company-owned operations. The company was founded by Jay S. Hennick in 1989 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: FirstService Corp. 從事提供物業服務。它透過 FirstService Residential 和 FirstService Brands 部門運作。 FirstService Residential 部門在北美提供住宅物業管理服務。 FirstService Brands 部門透過特許經營系統和公司自營業務覆蓋住宅和商業客戶。該公司由 Jay S. Hennick 於 1989 年創立，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Sentage Holdings, Inc. engages in the financial services, which offers a comprehensive range of financial services across consumer loan repayment and collection management, loan recommendation, and prepaid payment network services in China. The company was founded on September 16, 2019 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Sentage Holdings, Inc.從事金融服務業務，在中國提供涵蓋消費貸款還款和催收管理、貸款推薦以及預付支付網路服務等全方位的金融服務。公司成立於2019年9月16日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Packaging Corporation of America engages in the production of containerboard products and a producer of uncoated freesheet paper in North America. It operates through the following segments: Packaging, Paper, and Corporate and Other. The Packaging segment offers a variety of corrugated packaging products, such as conventional shipping containers. The Paper segment manufactures and sells a range of papers, including communication-based papers, and pressure sensitive papers. The Corporate and Other segment focuses on transportation assets, such as rail cars, and trucks. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Lake Forest, IL.
info.description_zh: 美國包裝公司在北美從事箱板紙產品的生產和無塗層自由張紙的生產商。它透過以下部門運作：包裝部門、造紙部門、企業及其他部門。包裝部門提供各種瓦楞包裝產品，例如傳統的貨櫃。紙張部門生產和銷售一系列紙張，包括通訊紙和壓敏紙。企業及其他部門專注於運輸資產，例如軌道車和卡車。該公司成立於 1959 年，總部位於伊利諾伊州森林湖。

info.description: Artesian Resources Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of water resource management. Its activities include residential, commercial water and wastewater, government and contract services, and developers. The company was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Newark, DE.
