info.description_zh: Artesian Resources Corp. 是一家控股公司，從事水資源管理業務。其業務包括住宅、商業供水和廢水處理、政府和合約服務以及開發商。該公司成立於 1905 年，總部位於特拉華州紐瓦克。

info.description: BTC Digital Ltd. is a blockchain technology company, with a long-term strategy to create value across the metaverse, blockchain and cryptocurrency mining industry. The company was founded by Yu Peng Guo in April 2006 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: BTC Digital Ltd.是一家區塊鏈技術公司，其長期戰略是在元宇宙、區塊鏈和加密貨幣挖礦行業創造價值。該公司由郭於鵬於2006年4月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Guru Favorite Stocks ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund's investment strategy is to seek to grow the capital by investing in high quality companies that are favored by prominent long-term investors ("Gurus") and at reasonable prices. The fund's investment sub-adviser, GuruFocus Investments, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser") tracks the equity portfolio holdings of approximately twenty Gurus. To be considered a Guru, the investor must have a long-term, publicly available, track record of at least ten years. In addition, the Guru must follow an investment strategy of investing in companies that the Guru considers to be high-quality.
info.description_zh: Guru 最愛股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金的投資策略是透過投資於受著名長期投資者（「大師」）青睞且價格合理的優質公司來尋求資本增長。該基金的投資副顧問 GuruFocus Investments, LLC（「副顧問」）追蹤約 20 位 Guru 的股票投資組合持有情況。要被視為大師，投資者必須擁有至少十年的長期、公開的追蹤記錄。此外，Guru 必須遵循投資 Guru 認為高品質的公司的投資策略。

info.description: Tianci International, Inc. engages in the provision of global logistics services, specializing in ocean freight forwarding, including container and bulk goods shipping. It offers its services across the Asia-Pacific region, including Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, and Vietnam. The company was founded on June 13, 2012 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 天賜國際有限公司從事提供全球物流服務，專門從事海運貨運代理，包括貨櫃和散裝運輸。它在亞太地區提供服務，包括香港、日本、韓國和越南。公司成立於2012年6月13日，總部位於香港。

info.description: The Middleby Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, marketing, and distribution of foodservice equipment. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Foodservice Equipment Group, Food Processing Equipment Group, Residential Kitchen Equipment Group, and Corporate and Other. The Commercial Foodservice Equipment Group segment manufactures, sells, and distributes foodservice equipment for the restaurant and institutional kitchen industry. The Food Processing Equipment Group segment manufactures preparation, cooking, packaging, food handling, and food safety equipment for the food processing industry. The Residential Kitchen Equipment Group segment manufactures, sells, and distributes kitchen equipment such as cookers, stoves, ovens, refrigerators, dishwashers, microwaves, cooktops, wine coolers, ice machines, ventilation, and outdoor equipment for the residential market. The Corporate and Other segment refers to the corporate and other general company assets and operations. The company was founded in 1888 and is headquartered in Elgin, IL.
info.description_zh: Middleby Corp. 從事餐飲服務設備的設計、製造、行銷和分銷。該公司透過以下部門運作：商業餐飲服務設備部門、食品加工設備部門、住宅廚房設備部門以及企業及其他部門。商業餐飲服務設備集團部門為餐廳和機構廚房產業製造、銷售和分銷餐飲服務設備。食品加工設備集團部門為食品加工產業製造準備、烹飪、包裝、食品處理和食品安全設備。住宅廚房設備集團部門為住宅市場製造、銷售和分銷炊具、爐灶、烤箱、冰箱、洗碗機、微波爐、爐灶、酒櫃、製冰機、通風設備和戶外設備等廚房設備。公司和其他部門是指公司和其他一般公司資產和業務。該公司成立於 1888 年，總部位於伊利諾伊州埃爾金。

info.description: Labcorp Holdings, Inc. provides laboratory services to help doctors, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, researchers, and patients make clear and confident decisions. It operates through the Diagnostics Laboratories (Dx) and Biopharma Laboratory Services (BLS) segments. The Dx segment includes routine and specialty esoteric testing. The BLS segment consists of central laboratory and ED businesses. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Burlington, NC.
info.description_zh: Labcorp Holdings, Inc. 提供實驗室服務，幫助醫生、醫院、製藥公司、研究人員和病患做出清晰、自信的決定。它透過診斷實驗室 (Dx) 和生物製藥實驗室服務 (BLS) 部門運作。 Dx 部分包括常規和專業深奧測試。 BLS 部門由中心實驗室和 ED 業務組成。該公司成立於 1995 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州伯靈頓。

info.description: Infobird Co. Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of standard and customized customer relationship management cloud-based services. It offers software-as-a-service (SaaS) and business process outsourcing (BPO) services to clients. The company was founded on October 26, 2001 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Infobird Co. Ltd.是一家控股公司，致力於提供標準和客製化的客戶關係管理雲端服務。它為客戶提供軟體即服務（SaaS）和業務流程外包（BPO）服務。公司成立於2001年10月26日，總部位於香港。

info.description: TWFG, Inc. engages in the provision of personal and commercial insurance products. Its products primarily consist of personal and commercial lines, including auto, home, renters, life, health, motorcycle, umbrella, boat, recreational vehicles, flood, wind, event, luxury items, general liability, property, business auto, worker's compensation, business owner policy, professional liability, commercial bonds, and group benefits. The company was founded by Richard F. Bunch III in 2001 and is headquartered in The Woodlands, TX.
info.description_zh: TWFG, Inc. 從事提供個人和商業保險產品。其產品主要包括個人和商業產品線，包括汽車、家居、租賃、人壽、健康、摩托車、雨傘、船、休閒車、洪水、風、活動、奢侈品、一般責任、財產、商用汽車、工人賠償、企業主保單、職業責任、商業債券和團體福利。該公司由 Richard F. Bunch III 於 2001 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州伍德蘭茲。

info.description: Tango Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in discovering and delivering precision cancer medicines. It also identifies novel targets and develops new drugs directed at tumor suppressor gene loss in defined patient populations with high unmet medical need. The company was founded by Alan Ashworth, William G. Kaelin Jr., Jose Baselga, and Antoni Ribas in 2017 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Tango Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於發現和提供精準癌症藥物。它還確定了新的標靶並開發了針對醫療需求未滿足的特定患者群體中腫瘤抑制基因缺失的新藥。該公司由 Alan Ashworth、William G. Kaelin Jr.、Jose Baselga 和 Antoni Ribas 於 2017 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: ZW Data Action Technologies, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the operation of a one-stop services on omni-channel advertising, precision marketing, and data analysis management system. It also engages in the development of blockchain enabled web/mobile applications and provision of software solutions. It operates through the following segments: Internet Advertising and Data Services, Ecommerce O2O Advertising and Marketing Services, Blockchain Technology, and Corporate. The company was founded by Han Dong Cheng and Zhi Ge Zhang in 2003 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: ZW Data Action Technologies, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事全通路廣告、精準行銷、資料分析管理系統一站式服務營運。它還從事區塊鏈支援的網路/行動應用程式的開發和軟體解決方案的提供。它透過以下部門運作：網路廣告和數據服務部門、電子商務O2O廣告和行銷服務部門、區塊鏈技術部門和企業部門。該公司由成漢東和張志革於2003年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Wah Fu Education Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of online exam preparation services and related technology solutions, and production of online training course materials. It operates through the Online Education Cloud Service (B2B2C) and Online Training Service (B2C). The B2B2C segment comprises online education platforms to institutions, such as universities, training institutions, and online course development service companies. The B2C segment provides online training and examination preparation services directly to students for a fee. The company was founded on July 23, 2012 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 華富教育集團有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供線上考試準備服務和相關技術解決方案以及製作線上培訓課程材料。它透過線上教育雲端服務（B2B2C）和線上培訓服務（B2C）運作。 B2B2C 領域包括大學、培訓機構和線上課程開發服務公司等機構的線上教育平台。 B2C 部門直接向學生提供收費的線上培訓和考試準備服務。公司成立於2012年7月23日，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Brand Engagement Network, Inc. engages in the provision of conversational artificial intelligence assistants with the purpose of transforming engagement and analytics for businesses through security-focused, multimodal communication and human-like artificial intelligence assistants. The firm is also involved in delivering highly personalized, multi-modal artificial intelligence engagement with a focus on industries where there is a massive workforce gap and an opportunity to transform how consumers engage with networks, providers, and brands. The company is founded by Tyler J. Luck, Michael Lucas, Patrick Nunally & Hanseok Ko on March 14, 2024 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Brand Engagement Network, Inc. 致力於提供對話式人工智慧助手，旨在透過以安全為中心的多模式通訊和類人人工智慧助理來改變企業的參與和分析。該公司也致力於提供高度個人化、多模式的人工智慧參與，重點關注勞動力缺口巨大的產業，並有機會改變消費者與網路、供應商和品牌的互動方式。該公司由 Tyler J. Luck、Michael Lucas、Patrick Nunally 和 Hanseok Ko 於 2024 年 3 月 14 日創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Forum Markets, Inc. is a technology company in the decentralized finance (DeFi) industry, which intends to connect financial institutions, businesses, and organizations worldwide by enabling secure, accessible blockchain transactions through Ethereum Network protocol implementations. It continues to maintain the deployment and development of its biotech and gaming operations. The company was founded by Marc Feldmann, Lawrence J. Steinman, and Jonathan B. Rothbard on September 7, 2016 and is headquartered in Palm Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Forum Markets, Inc. 是一家去中心化金融 (DeFi) 行業的科技公司，旨在透過以太坊網路協議實現實現安全、可存取的區塊鏈交易，從而連接全球的金融機構、企業和組織。它繼續保持其生物技術和遊戲業務的部署和發展。該公司由 Marc Feldmann、Lawrence J. Steinman 和 Jonathan B. Rothbard 於 2016 年 9 月 7 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州棕櫚灘。

info.description: Big Sky Industrial, Inc. engages in the acquisition and development of oil and natural gas properties. It operates in the Rockies, Mid-Continent, South Texas, and West Texas. The company was founded on January 26, 1966 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Big Sky Industrial, Inc. 從事石油和天然氣資產的收購和開發。該公司在落基山脈、中大陸、德克薩斯州南部和德克薩斯州西部開展業務。該公司成立於1966年1月26日，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Ambitions Enterprise Management Co. LLC operates as a travel agency. It provides event planning and management services. The firm also offers transportation, accommodations, meals, and guided tours or activities under convenient packages. The company was founded on October 26, 2023 and is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
info.description_zh: Ambitions Enterprise Management Co. LLC 是一家旅行社。它提供活動策劃和管理服務。該公司還提供交通、住宿、膳食以及導遊或活動的便利套餐。該公司成立於2023年10月26日，總部位於阿拉伯聯合大公國杜拜。

info.description: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Meta ETF seeks current income; exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated securities exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage of the common stock of Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A (NASDAQ: META) subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying META ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Meta ETF 尋求當前收入；暴露於一隻或多只交易所交易基金的表現，這些基金的股票在美國監管的證券交易所進行交易，並且尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 Meta Platforms, Inc. A 類（納斯達克股票代碼：META）普通每日百分比的 2 倍（200%），但受到潛在投資收益股票的限制。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於利用基礎 META ETF 作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Taoping, Inc. operates as block chain technology and smart cloud services provider. It operates through the following segments: Cloud-based Technology, Blockchain Technology, Traditional Information Technology. The CBT segment includes the company's cloud based products and data storage related services sold to private sectors. The BT segment is the company's Crypto currency mining initiative. The TIT segment is involved in the company's project-based technology products and services sold to the public sector such as Geographic Information System, Digital Public Security Technology, and Digital Hospital Information Systems. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 淘屏公司是一家區塊鏈技術和智慧雲端服務提供商。它透過以下部門運作：基於雲端的技術、區塊鏈技術、傳統資訊技術。 CBT 部門包括該公司向私營部門出售的基於雲端的產品和資料儲存相關服務。 BT 部門是該公司的加密貨幣挖礦計劃。 TIT部門涉及該公司向公共部門銷售的基於專案的技術產品和服務，例如地理資訊系統、數位公共安全技術和數位醫院資訊系統。該公司成立於1993年，總部位於香港。

info.description: GIBO Holdings Ltd. operates as a streaming platform for storytellers and content creators. The company was founded on June 19, 2024 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: GIBO Holdings Ltd. 是一家為故事講述者和內容創作者提供串流平台的公司。該公司成立於2024年6月19日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Tantech Holdings Ltd. engages in the development and manufacture of bamboo-based charcoal products. It operates through the Consumer Product and Electric Vehicle segments. The Consumer Product segment manufactures, sell and trade Charcoal Doctor branded products and BBQ charcoal in China well as biodegradable packaging business. The Electric Vehicle segment offers solar cells, lithium-ion batteries, auto parts, and electric control systems. The company was founded by Zheng Yu Wang on November 19, 2010 and is headquartered in Lishui, China.
info.description_zh: Tantech Holdings Ltd.從事竹炭產品的開發和製造。它透過消費品和電動車部門運作。消費品部門在中國生產、銷售和貿易木炭醫生品牌產品和燒烤木炭以及可生物降解包裝業務。電動車部門提供太陽能電池、鋰離子電池、汽車零件和電氣控制系統。該公司由王正宇於2010年11月19日創立，總部位於中國麗水。

info.description: QuidelOrtho Corp. operates as a vitro diagnostics company. It is focused on developing and manufacturing diagnostic products. The company was founded on May 27, 2022 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: QuidelOrtho Corp. 是一家體外診斷公司。它專注於開發和製造診斷產品。該公司成立於2022年5月27日，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Digital Brands Group, Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of apparel. Its portfolio brands include Bailey 44, DSTLD, Harper and Jones, Stateside, and Sundry. The company was founded by Corey Epstein, Mark T. Lynn, and Kevin Morris on September 17, 2012 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Digital Brands Group, Inc. 從事服裝的製造和銷售。其投資組合品牌包括 Bailey 44、DSTLD、Harper and Jones、Stateside 和 Sundry。該公司由 Corey Epstein、Mark T. Lynn 和 Kevin Morris 於 2012 年 9 月 17 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Smart Sand, Inc. engages in supplying frac sand and related services. The firm offers complete mine to wellsite proppant supply and logistics solutions. It operates through the Sand and SmartSystems segments. The Sand segment includes both frac sand sales and IPS sales. The SmartSystems segment focuses on the rental of patented SmartSystems equipment and related services provided to customers. The company was founded by Charles E. Young on July 19, 2011 and is headquartered in Yardley, PA.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: Smart Sand, Inc. 從事供應壓裂砂及相關服務。該公司提供完整的礦山到井場支撐劑供應和物流解決方案。它透過 Sand 和 SmartSystems 部門運作。砂子部門包括壓裂砂銷售和 IPS 銷售。 SmartSystems 部門專注於向客戶提供專利的 SmartSystems 設備的租賃和相關服務。該公司由 Charles E. Young 於 2011 年 7 月 19 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州亞德利。

info.description: Millennium Group International Holdings Ltd. is a paper-based packaging solutions supplier, which engages in the business of production and sale of packaging products and corrugated products. Its integrated business processes include market research, research and development, packaging design and development, raw materials procurement, color management, product testing, quality control and delivery services. The company was founded by Yee Cheong Lai in 1978 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Millennium Group International Holdings Ltd.是一家紙包裝解決方案供應商，從事包裝產品及瓦楞產品的生產和銷售業務。其綜合業務流程包括市場研究、研發、包裝設計與開發、原料採購、色彩管理、產品測試、品質控制和交付服務。該公司由Yee Cheong Lai於1978年創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: E-Home Household Service Holdings Ltd. engages in the operation of household services. It operates through the following segments: Installation and Maintenance Services, Housekeeping Services, Senior Care Services, and Educational Consulting Services. The company was founded by Wen Shan Xie in 2014 and is headquartered in Fuzhou City, China.
info.description_zh: 易家家居服務控股有限公司從事家居服務經營。它透過以下部門運作：安裝和維護服務、家事服務、高級護理服務和教育諮詢服務。該公司由謝文山於2014年創立，總部位於中國福州市。

info.description: Fenbo Holdings Ltd. is an electrical appliances company, which engages in the manufacturing of household electric appliances and toys products. The firm also offers personal care electronic appliances such as electrical hair styling products including hair dryers, straighteners, curlers and trimmers. The company was founded on September 30, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 芬博控股有限公司是一家電器公司，從事家用電器及玩具產品的製造。該公司還提供個人護理電子產品，例如電動美髮產品，包括吹風機、直髮器、捲髮器和修剪器。該公司成立於2022年9月30日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Euro Tech Holdings Co. Ltd. is engaged in the manufacture and distribution of water treatment equipment. It operates through the Trading and Manufacturing, and Engineering segments. The Trading and Manufacturing segment offers laboratory instruments, analyzers, test kits, and power generation equipment. The Engineering segment involves water and waste-water treatment engineering and air pollution control business through Pact-Yixing, the firm's wholly owned subsidiary. The company was founded on September 30, 1996 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Euro Tech Holdings Co. Ltd. 從事水處理設備的製造和分銷。它透過貿易和製造以及工程部門運作。貿易和製造部門提供實驗室儀器、分析儀、測試套件和發電設備。工程部門透過該公司的全資子公司Pact-宜興從事水和廢水處理工程以及空氣污染控制業務。公司成立於1996年9月30日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Xenetic Biosciences, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company engaged in the advancement of cell-based therapeutics to target the B-cell receptor on the surface of an individual patient's malignant tumor cells. Its product pipeline includes XCart Platform and Polyxen. The company was founded on August 9, 2011 and is headquartered in Framingham, MA.
info.description_zh: Xenetic Biosciences, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發基於細胞的療法，以靶向個別患者惡性腫瘤細胞表面的 B 細胞受體。其產品線包括 XCart Platform 和 Polyxen。該公司成立於2011年8月9日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州弗雷明漢。

info.description: Sera Prognostics, Inc. engages in the provision of personalized diagnostics to predict and manage pregnancy complications. It focuses on developing blood tests to predict the risks of preterm birth, preeclampsia and other pregnancy complications. The company was founded by Steven W. Graves, Dennis Farrar and M. Sean Esplin in 2008 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Sera Prognostics, Inc. 致力於提供個人化診斷來預測和管理妊娠併發症。它的重點是開發血液檢查來預測早產、子癇前症和其他妊娠併發症的風險。該公司由 Steven W. Graves、Dennis Farrar 和 M. Sean Esplin 於 2008 年創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Delixy Holdings Ltd. is developing stage company. It operates through its indirect wholly owned subsidiary, which engages in the trading of crude oil and oil-based products. The company was founded on May 16, 2024 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.industry_zh: 石油與天然氣精煉與行銷
info.description_zh: Delixy Holdings Ltd. 是一家發展階段的公司。它透過其間接全資子公司運營，該子公司從事原油和石油產品的貿易。該公司成立於2024年5月16日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Health Catalyst, Inc. engages in the provision of data and analytics technology and services to healthcare organizations. It operates through the Technology and Professional Services segments. The Technology segment includes its data platform, analytics applications, and support services. The Professional Services segment combines analytics, implementation, strategic advisory, outsource, and improvement services to deliver expertise to its customers. The company was founded by Steven C. Barlow and Thomas D. Burton in 2008 and is headquartered in South Jordan, UT.
info.description_zh: Health Catalyst, Inc. 致力於為醫療保健組織提供資料和分析技術及服務。它透過技術和專業服務部門運作。技術部門包括數據平台、分析應用程式和支援服務。專業服務部門結合了分析、實施、策略諮詢、外包和改進服務，為客戶提供專業知識。該公司由 Steven C. Barlow 和 Thomas D. Burton 於 2008 年創立，總部位於猶他州南喬丹。

info.description: Uni-Fuels Holdings Ltd. engages in the provision of marine fuels solutions. The firm markets, resells, and brokers marine fuels products such as very low sulfur fuel oil, high sulfur fuel oil, and marine gas oil. It offers these products to shipping companies and marine fuels suppliers worldwide in-port and offshore. The company was founded by Wee Huan Goh on October 12, 2021 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Uni-Fuels Holdings Ltd. 從事提供船用燃料解決方案。該公司行銷、轉售和代理船用燃料產品，例如極低硫燃料油、高硫燃料油和船用輕柴油。它為全球港口和海上的航運公司和船用燃料供應商提供這些產品。該公司由 Wee Huan Goh 於 2021 年 10 月 12 日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of lifecycle automotive services. It operates through the following segments: New Car Sales, Auto Parts and Auto Accessories Sales, and Automotive Insurance Related Services. The New Car Sales segment offers parallel import car and new energy vehicle (NEV). The Auto Parts and Auto Accessories Sales segment conducts business primarily to auto part dealers and gradually upgrade to directly connect to local multiple-brand-service (MBS) stores. The Automotive Insurance Related Services segment refers to the value-added maintenance, claim and repair, and insurance intermediation services. The company was founded by Hou Qi Zhang in 2010 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Autozi互聯網科技（全球）有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供汽車全生命週期服務。它透過以下部門運作：新車銷售部門、汽車零件及汽車配件銷售部門以及汽車保險相關服務部門。新車銷售部門提供平行進口汽車和新能源汽車（NEV）。汽車零配件銷售板塊主要針對汽車零配件經銷商開展業務，並逐步升級為直連當地多品牌服務（MBS）店。汽車保險相關服務部門是指加值保養、索賠和維修以及保險中介服務。該公司由張侯奇於2010年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Webuy Global Ltd. engages in an e-commerce retailer with a focus on groceries and travel. Its social e-commerce community platform focuses on achieving a global reach and currently operates in Singapore and Indonesia. The company was founded by Bin Xue and Ting Ting Tan in August 2019 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Webuy Global Ltd. 是一家專注於雜貨和旅遊的電子商務零售商。其社交電商社群平台專注於實現全球影響力，目前在新加坡和印尼運營。該公司由薛斌和譚婷婷於2019年8月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Global Engine Group Holding Ltd. engages in the provision of information and communication technology services. Its solutions include ICT solution services, technical services, and project management services. The company was founded by Yat Lung Lee on May 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Global Engine Group Holding Ltd. 從事提供資訊和通訊技術服務。其解決方案包括ICT解決方案服務、技術服務和專案管理服務。該公司由李逸龍於2018年5月3日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Core AI Holdings, Inc. engages in mobile game development and publishing. It creates games for players worldwide while empowering other developers to deliver player-focused apps and games to enthusiasts. It focuses on harnessing the power of artificial intelligence to build transformative and scalable offerings across multiple verticals. The company was founded by Marc Seelenfreund on October 15, 1986 and is headquartered in Surrey, Canada.
info.description_zh: Core AI Holdings, Inc.從事手機遊戲開發和發行。它為世界各地的玩家創造遊戲，同時幫助其他開發者向愛好者提供以玩家為中心的應用程式和遊戲。它專注於利用人工智慧的力量在多個垂直領域中建立變革性和可擴展的產品。該公司由Marc Seelenfreund於1986年10月15日創立，總部位於加拿大薩裡。

info.description: BGM Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the technology fields of AI application, intelligent robots, algorithmic computing power, cloud computing, and biopharmaceuticals. It operates through the following segments: Oxytetracycline and Licorice Products, and Traditional Chinese Medicine Derivatives (TCMD); Heparin Products and Sausage Casing; and Fertilizer. The Oxytetracycline and Licorice Products, and TCMD segment focuses on the development, manufacture, marketing, and sale of oxytetracycline products, licorice products, and TCMD. The Heparin Products and Sausage Casing segment treats cardiovascular diseases, cerebrovascular diseases, and hemodialysis. The Fertilizer segment includes Xiongguan, Organic Fertilizer and Xiongguan, and Organic-Inorganic Compound Fertilizer. The company was founded on February 7, 2019 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: BGM Group Ltd.是一家控股公司，涉足人工智慧應用、智慧機器人、演算法算力、雲端運算、生物製藥等技術領域。它透過以下部門運作：土黴素和甘草產品部門，以及中藥衍生品部門（TCMD）；肝素產品和腸衣；和肥料。土黴素和甘草產品以及TCMD部門專注於土黴素產品、甘草產品和TCMD的開發、製造、行銷和銷售。肝素產品和腸衣部門治療心血管疾病、腦血管疾病和血液透析。肥料業務包括雄冠、有機肥料和雄冠、有機無機復混肥。公司成立於2019年2月7日，總部位於中國成都。

info.description: iTonic Holdings Ltd. operates as a holding company with interests in providing healthcare solutions. The firm through its subsidiaries engages in the development and commercialization of brachytherapy TPS specifically used for radioactive particle implantation, a type of radiotherapy used in treating cancer patients by placing radioactive sources inside the patient that kill cancer cells and shrink tumors. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: iTonic Holdings Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，致力於提供醫療保健解決方案。該公司透過其子公司從事專門用於放射性粒子植入的近距離放射治療 TPS 的開發和商業化，這是一種透過將放射源放置在患者體內殺死癌細胞並縮小腫瘤來治療癌症患者的放射療法。公司成立於1998年，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Epsium Enterprise Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in import trading and distribution of wines and spirits. It offers a range of products, including Chinese liquor, French cognac, Scottish whisky, fine wines, champagne, and other miscellaneous alcoholic beverages. Its brands include Moutai, Xijiu, Wuliangye, Remy Martin Cognac, Macallan, Cointreau, Piper Heidsieck Champagne, French Fine Wines, Red and White Wines. The company was founded by Son I Tam on March 24, 2020 and is headquartered in Macau.
info.industry_zh: 飲料 - 釀酒廠和釀酒廠
info.description_zh: Epsium Enterprise Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，從事葡萄酒和烈酒的進口貿易和分銷。它提供一系列產品，包括中國白酒、法國干邑白蘭地、蘇格蘭威士忌、精品葡萄酒、香檳和其他各種酒精飲料。旗下品牌包括茅台、習酒、五糧液、人頭馬干邑、麥卡倫、君度、海德雪香檳、法國精品葡萄酒、紅白葡萄酒等。該公司由Son I Tam於2020年3月24日創立，總部位於澳門。

info.description: Veru, Inc. is a late clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel medicines and treatment of cardiometabolic and inflammatory diseases. Its drug development program consists of two late-stage new chemical entities, enobosarm and sabizabulin. The company was founded by William R. Gargiulo, Jr. and O. B. Parrish in 1971 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Veru, Inc. 是一家處於後期臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發新藥以及治療心臟代謝和發炎疾病。其藥物開發計劃包括兩種後期新化學實體：enobosarm 和 sabizabulin。該公司由 William R. Gargiulo, Jr. 和 O. B. Parrish 於 1971 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Blue Moon Metals Inc. engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral resource properties. It focuses on Blue Moon zinc and Yava properties. The company was founded on January 15, 2007 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Blue Moon Metals Inc. 從事礦產資源的收購和勘探。它專注於 Blue Moon 鋅礦和 Yava 礦產。該公司成立於2007年1月15日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Foxx Development Holdings, Inc. engages in consumer electronics and integrated Internet-of-Things (IoT) solutions, catering to both retail and institutional clients. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Foxx Development Holdings, Inc. 從事消費性電子產品和整合物聯網 (IoT) 解決方案，為零售和機構客戶提供服務。該公司成立於 2017 年，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Vivos Therapeutics, Inc. is a medical technology company which engages in the development and commercialization of treatment alternatives for patients with sleep disordered breathing (SDB). Its solutions are also offered for patients with mild-to-moderate obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). The company was founded by Gurdev Dave Singh, Susan McCullough, RaeAnn Byrnes, Todd Huntsman, and R. Kirk Huntsman on July 7, 2016 and is headquartered in Littleton, CO.
info.description_zh: Vivos Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家醫療技術公司，致力於睡眠呼吸障礙 (SDB) 患者治療替代方案的開發和商業化。其解決方案也為輕度至中度阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症 (OSA) 患者提供。該公司由 Gurdev Dave Singh、Susan McCullough、RaeAnn Byrnes、Todd Huntsman 和 R. Kirk Huntsman 於 2016 年 7 月 7 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州利特爾頓。

info.description: Springview Holdings Ltd. engages in the design and construction of residential and commercial buildings. It involves new construction, reconstruction, alterations, and other general contracting services. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Springview Holdings Ltd. 從事住宅和商業建築的設計和建造。涉及新建、改建、改建及其他總承包服務。該公司成立於2002年，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Haoxin Holdings Ltd. engages in the provision of temperature-controlled truckload services and urban delivery services. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Ningbo, China.
info.description_zh: 浩信控股有限公司從事提供溫控整車服務和城市配送服務。公司成立於2009年，總部位於中國寧波。

info.description: ICZOOM Group, Inc. is an offshore holding company, which engages in the sale of electronic component products through its B2B e-commerce platform. It also provides services such as temporary warehousing, logistics and shipping, and customs clearance. The company was founded by Lei Xia and Duan Rong Liu on June 18, 2015 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: ICZOOM Group, Inc.是一家離岸控股公司，透過其B2B電子商務平台從事電子元件產品的銷售。並提供臨時倉儲、物流運輸、報關等服務。該公司由夏雷和劉段榮於2015年6月18日創立，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Bio Green Med Solution, Inc. which engages in the supply and trading of protective and fire safety equipment to commercial, industrial, healthcare, and residential sectors. Its products include fire extinguishers, foam system, fire-resistant doors, and personal protective equipment. The company was founded by Ronald J. Berenson, David Philip Lane, and David Glover on January 5, 1996 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: Bio Green Med Solution, Inc. 從事商業、工業、醫療保健和住宅領域的防護和消防安全設備的供應和貿易。其產品包括滅火器、泡沫系統、防火門和個人防護設備。該公司由 Ronald J. Berenson、David Philip Lane 和 David Glover 於 1996 年 1 月 5 日創立，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: VS MEDIA Holdings Ltd. engages in the management of a global network of digital creators who create and publish content to social media platforms. It operates through the following segments: Marketing Services, Social Commerce, and Other. The Marketing Services segment is involved in providing affiliate marketing, product placement, and brand sponsorship deals for creators to promote brand's messages; and creating and publishing content on social media platforms. The Social Commerce segment resells brand's products to creators. The company was founded by Nga Fan Wong in 2013 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: VS MEDIA Holdings Ltd. 從事全球數位創作者網路的管理，這些創作者在社群媒體平台上創建和發佈內容。它透過以下部門運作：行銷服務、社交商務和其他。行銷服務部門為創作者提供聯盟行銷、產品置入和品牌贊助交易，以宣傳品牌訊息；在社群媒體平台上創建和發佈內容。社群商務部門將品牌產品轉售給創作者。該公司由黃雅帆於2013年創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Big Tree Cloud Holdings Ltd. engages in providing personal care products through its subsidiaries. Its products include sanitary napkins, sanitary pants, and panty liners. The company was founded by Wen Quan Zhu in 2020 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: 大樹雲控股有限公司透過其子公司提供個人護理產品。其產品包括衛生棉、衛生褲和護墊。該公司由朱文泉於2020年創立，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: CCSC Technology International Holdings Ltd. is a holding company with interests in the design, manufacture, and sale of interconnect products. Its products include cable and wire harness, and connectors. It operates through the following geographical segments: Europe, Asia, Americas, and Others. The company was founded by Chi Sing Chiu on October 19, 2021 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: CCSC Technology International Holdings Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事互連產品的設計、製造和銷售。其產品包括電纜和線束以及連接器。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：歐洲、亞洲、美洲和其他地區。該公司由Chi Sing Chiu於2021年10月19日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Texxon Holding Ltd. provides supply chain management services in East China. Its services include the sale of plastic, chemical raw materials, and other plastic raw materials. Its products are used in fabrics, coastings, resins, beverage packing, other downstream products, pipelines and pipes used in infrastructure, daily or food grade packing and agriculture membranes. The company was founded on January 20, 2022 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 德盛控股有限公司在華東地區提供供應鏈管理服務。其服務包括銷售塑膠、化學原料及其他塑膠原料。其產品用於織物、海岸線、樹脂、飲料包裝、其他下游產品、基礎設施、日用或食品級包裝和農業膜中使用的管道和管道。公司成立於2022年1月20日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Youlife Group Inc. engages in the development and provision of blue-collar services through its subsidiary. It assists blue-collar talent with skill improvement and lifetime career development, through vocational education services, HR recruitment services, employee management services, and market services segments. The company was founded on February 26, 2019 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Youlife Group Inc. 透過其子公司從事藍領服務的開發和提供。透過職業教育服務、人力資源招募服務、員工管理服務、市場服務等細分領域，幫助藍領人才進行技能提升與終身職涯發展。公司成立於2019年2月26日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: SUNation Energy, Inc. is focused on local and regional solar, storage, and energy services companies nationwide. The firm's vision is to power the energy transition through the grass-roots growth of solar electricity paired with battery storage. Its portfolio of brands, including SUNation, Hawaii Energy Connection, E-Gear, Sungevity, and Horizon Solar Power, provides homeowners and small businesses with an end-to-end product offering spanning solar, battery storage, and grid services. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Ronkonkoma, NY.
info.description_zh: SUNation Energy, Inc. 專注於全國各地的本地和區域太陽能、儲存和能源服務公司。該公司的願景是透過太陽能發電與電池儲存相結合的基層成長來推動能源轉型。其品牌組合包括 SUNation、Hawaii Energy Connection、E-Gear、Sungevity 和 Horizo​​n Solar Power，為房主和小型企業提供涵蓋太陽能、電池儲存和電網服務的端到端產品。該公司成立於 1969 年，總部位於紐約州朗康科馬。

info.description: Scage Future is a new energy smart solutions provider for heavy commercial vehicles. It develops and commercializes heavy-duty new energy trucks and components, and also provides related vehicle modification and leasing services. The company was founded by Chao Gao, Yuan Chi Guo, and Zi Qian Guan in June 2019 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
info.description_zh: Scage Future是重型商用車新能源智慧解決方案供應商。它開發和商業化重型新能源卡車及零件，並提供相關的車輛改裝和租賃服務。該公司由高超、郭元馳和關子謙於2019年6月創立，總部位於中國南京。

info.description: Park Ha Biological Technology Co. Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the manufacture of skincare and cosmetic products. It operates through the Product Sales and Franchise Fees segments. The company was founded by Xiao Qiu Zhang on October 11, 2022 and is headquartered in Wuxi, China.
info.description_zh: 樸河生物科技有限公司是一家控股公司，從事護膚品和化妝品的生產。它透過產品銷售和特許經營費部門運作。該公司由張曉秋於2022年10月11日創立，總部位於中國無錫。

info.description: Real Messenger Corp. is a communication company, which engages in real estate communication. The company connects shareholders through its app that enables real time messaging, documentation, and integration with other real estate software. The company was founded by Kwai Hoi Ma on June 27, 2023 and is headquartered in Costa Mesa, CA.
info.description_zh: Real Messenger Corp. 是一家從事房地產通訊的通訊公司。該公司透過其應用程式將股東聯繫起來，該應用程式支援即時訊息傳遞、文件記錄以及與其他房地產軟體的整合。該公司由 Kwai Hoi Ma 於 2023 年 6 月 27 日創立，總部位於加州科斯塔梅薩。

info.description: Alvotech is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development and manufacture of biosimilar medicines. The firm is focusing on the development of its product candidates. It operates through the following geographical segments: Europe, North America, Asia, and Other. The company was founded by Robert Vilhelm Wessman in 2013 and is headquartered in Luxembourg.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Alvotech是一家生技公司，從事生物相似藥的開發和製造。該公司正專注於候選產品的開發。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：歐洲、北美、亞洲和其他地區。該公司由 Robert Vilhelm Wessman 於 2013 年創立，總部位於盧森堡。

info.description: Magic Empire Global Ltd. engages in the provision of corporate finance advisory and underwriting services. It offers sponsorship, financial advisory, compliance advisory, and underwriting and corporate services. The company was founded by Wai Ho Chan and Sze Hon Chen on May 10, 2016 and is headquartered Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Magic Empire Global Ltd. 從事提供企業融資諮詢及承銷服務。它提供贊助、財務諮詢、合規諮詢以及承銷和企業服務。該公司由Wai Ho Chan和Sze Hon Chen於2016年5月10日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Central Garden & Pet Co. engages in the production and distribution of branded and private label products for the lawn, garden, and pet supplies markets. It operates through the Pet and Garden segments. The Pet segment focuses on dog and cat supplies such as dog treats and chews, toys, pet beds and containment, grooming products, waste management and training pads, supplies for aquatics, small animals, reptiles and pet birds including toys, cages and habitats, bedding, food and supplements, products for equine and livestock, animal and household health and insect control products, live fish, and small animals, as well as outdoor cushions. The Garden segment includes lawn and garden consumables such as grass, vegetable, flower and herb seed, wild bird feed, bird houses and other birding accessories, weed, grass, and other herbicides, insecticide and pesticide products, fertilizers, and live plants. The company was founded by William E. Brown in 1980 and is headquartered in Walnut Creek, CA.
info.description_zh: Central Garden & Pet Co. 從事草坪、花園和寵物用品市場的品牌和自有品牌產品的生產和分銷。它透過寵物和花園部門運作。寵物部門專注於狗和貓用品，如狗零食和咀嚼物、玩具、寵物床和圍護用品、美容產品、廢物管理和訓練墊、水生動物、小動物、爬行動物和寵物鳥類用品，包括玩具、籠子和棲息地、床上用品、食品和補充劑、馬和牲畜產品、動物和家庭健康和昆蟲控制產品、活魚和小動物以及戶外墊子。花園部門包括草坪和花園消耗品，如草、蔬菜、花卉和藥草種子、野鳥飼料、鳥舍和其他觀鳥配件、雜草、草和其他除草劑、殺蟲劑和殺蟲劑產品、肥料和活體植物。該公司由 William E. Brown 於 1980 年創立，總部位於加州核桃溪。

info.description: Direxion Daily MSFT Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of Microsoft Corporation. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned on an investment by the fund in MSFT that is equal, on a daily basis, to -100% of the value of the fund's net assets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily MSFT Bear 1X Shares 尋求與 Microsoft Corporation 每日表現相反（或相反）100% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。該基金將與全球主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，根據該協議，該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換該基金在 MSFT 的投資所賺取的每日回報，該回報等於該基金淨資產價值的-100%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Alignment Healthcare, Inc. is a holding company, which offers a consumer-centric platform that delivers customized health care solutions to seniors and those who need it most, the chronically ill and frail, through its Medicare Advantage plans. It offers health plan options through Alignment Health Plan, and partners with select health plans to help deliver better benefits at lower costs. The company was founded by John E. Kao in 2013 and is headquartered in Orange, CA.
info.description_zh: Alignment Healthcare, Inc. 是一家控股公司，提供以消費者為中心的平台，透過其 Medicare Advantage 計劃為老年人和最需要的人、慢性病患者和體弱者提供客製化的醫療保健解決方案。它透過 Alignment Health Plan 提供健康計劃選項，並與精選的健康計劃合作，幫助以更低的成本提供更好的福利。該公司由 John E. Kao 於 2013 年創立，總部位於加州奧蘭治。

info.description: Pathfinder Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the investment in Pathfinder Bank. It offers checking and savings accounts, loans, and digital banking services for retail and business customers through its subsidiary. The firm also provides overdraft protection and mobile payments for individual clients and cash management sweep accounts, remote deposit capture, and merchant card services for business clients. The company was founded on December 31, 1997 and is headquartered in Oswego, NY.
info.description_zh: Pathfinder Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事對 Pathfinder Bank 的投資。該公司透過其子公司為零售和企業客戶提供支票和儲蓄帳戶、貸款和數位銀行服務。該公司還為個人客戶提供透支保護和行動支付，並為企業客戶提供現金管理掃款帳戶、遠端存款取得和商業卡服務。該公司成立於1997年12月31日，總部位於紐約州奧斯威戈。

info.description: Skyward Specialty Insurance Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial property and casualty products and solutions on a non-admitted and admitted basis. It specializes in the healthcare professional liability, industry solutions, management and professional liability, medical stop-loss, programs and captive solutions, specialty property and liability, and surety. It operates through the following divisions: Accident & Health, Captives, Global Property & Agriculture, Industry Solutions, Professional Lines, Programs, Surety and Transactional E&S. Skyward Specialty Insurance Group was founded by Stephen Lyndon Way on January 3, 2006 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: Skyward Specialty Insurance Group, Inc. 是一家控股公司，以非認可和認可的方式提供商業財產和傷亡產品及解決方案。它專門從事醫療保健專業責任、行業解決方案、管理和專業責任、醫療止損、計劃和自保解決方案、專業財產和責任以及擔保。它透過以下部門運作：事故與健康、自保、全球財產與農業、產業解決方案、專業產品線、專案、擔保以及交易 E&S。 Skyward Specialty Insurance Group 由 Stephen Lyndon Way 於 2006 年 1 月 3 日創立，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Viemed Healthcare, Inc. engages in the provision of home healthcare solutions. Through its subsidiaries, it supplies home medical equipment which provides post-acute respiratory services. It also offers respiratory disease management and in-home sleep testing and sleep apnea treatment. The company was founded by Casey Hoyt, Max Hoyt, and Michael Moore in 2016 and is headquartered in Lafayette, LA.
info.description_zh: Viemed Healthcare, Inc. 從事提供居家醫療保健解決方案。該公司透過其子公司提供家庭醫療設備，以提供急性後呼吸服務。它還提供呼吸系統疾病管理、家庭睡眠測試和睡眠呼吸中止症治療。該公司由 Casey Hoyt、Max Hoyt 和 Michael Moore 於 2016 年創立，總部位於路易斯安那州拉斐特。

info.description: Privia Health Group, Inc. engages in the provision of healthcare services. It collaborates with medical groups, health plans, and health systems to optimize physician practices, improve patient experience, and reward doctors for delivering care both in-person and via its Privia Platform, virtual care settings. The company was founded by Jeffrey Butler on November 7, 2007 and is headquartered in Arlington, VA.
info.description_zh: Privia Health Group, Inc. 從事提供醫療保健服務。它與醫療團體、健康計劃和衛生系統合作，優化醫生實踐，改善患者體驗，並獎勵醫生親自提供護理以及透過其 Privia 平台、虛擬護理設置提供護理。該公司由 Jeffrey Butler 於 2007 年 11 月 7 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿靈頓。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short PLTR ETF seeks daily inverse investment results, before fees and expenses, of -2 times (-200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Palantir Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ: PLTR). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to achieve 2 times the inverse (-200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short PLTR ETF 尋求每日反向投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 Palantir Technologies Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：PLTR）每日股價變化百分比的 -2 倍（-200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券價格每日百分比變化的兩倍倒數（-200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLV ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLV Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the health care sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLV ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLV 指數表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場醫療保健行業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLF ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLF Index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the financial sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLF ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLF 指數表現相對應的投資結果。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大型股票市場金融領域公司的證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VanEck Healthcare TruSector ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund designed to provide uncapped, pure-play exposure to the U.S. healthcare sector by overcoming traditional diversification limits that often cap the weight of the largest industry leaders. The fund employs a "TruSector" hybrid structural approach, combining direct equity investments with targeted sector ETFs to ensure the portfolio's weights accurately reflect the true market-capitalization hierarchy of the healthcare industry, including its most dominant mega-cap constituents.
info.description_zh: VanEck Healthcare TruSector ETF 是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過克服傳統的多元化限制（通常會限制最大產業領導者的權重），為美國醫療保健產業提供無上限的純投資曝險。該基金採用「TruSector」混合結構方法，將直接股權投資與目標產業 ETF 結合，以確保投資組合的權重準確反映醫療保健產業的真實市值等級，包括其最具主導地位的大股成分股。

info.description: Kimberly-Clark Corp. engages in the manufacture and marketing of products made from natural or synthetic fibers. It operates through North America and International Personal Care segments. The North America segment consists of products encompassing each of daily-need categories across consumer and professional channels including disposable diapers, training and youth pants, swimpants, baby wipes, feminine and incontinence care products, reusable underwear, facial and bathroom tissue, paper towels, napkins, wipers, tissue, towels, soaps and sanitizers and other related products. The International Personal Care segment consists of three core categories: Baby & Child Care, Adult Care, and Feminine Care, including disposable diapers, training and youth pants, swimpants, baby wipes, feminine and incontinence care products, reusable underwear and other related products. The company was founded by John A. Kimberly, Havilah Babcock, Charles B. Clark, and Frank C. Shattuck in 1872 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Kimberly-Clark Corp. 從事天然或合成纖維產品的製造和行銷。它透過北美和國際個人護理部門運作。北美部門的產品涵蓋消費者和專業管道的各個日常需求類別，包括一次性尿布、訓練褲和青少年褲、游泳褲、嬰兒濕紙巾、女性和失禁護理產品、可重複使用的內衣、面巾紙和衛生紙、紙巾、餐巾紙、擦拭布、紙巾、毛巾、肥皂和消毒劑以及其他相關產品。國際個人護理業務包括嬰幼兒護理、成人護理和女性護理三大核心品類，包括一次性尿布、訓練褲和青少年褲、泳褲、嬰兒濕巾、女性和失禁護理產品、可重複使用內衣及其他相關產品。該公司由 John A. Kimberly、Havilah Babcock、Charles B. Clark 和 Frank C. Shattuck 於 1872 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Financials ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of financial companies. The manager defines financial companies as companies in banking, insurance, consumer finance, capital markets, government-sponsored financial enterprises, securities exchanges, REITS, transaction and payment processing, mortgage finance, investment management, and/or financial services. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price Financials ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於金融公司的證券。管理者將金融公司定義為銀行、保險、消費金融、資本市場、政府資助的金融企業、證券交易所、房地產投資信託基金、交易和支付處理、抵押貸款融資、投資管理和/或金融服務領域的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Kenvue, Inc. is a consumer health company, which engages in manufacturing and selling healthcare products which includes cosmetics, drugs, and medical devices. Its brands include Aveeno, BAND-AID Brand, Johnson's, Listerine, Neutrogena, and Tylenol. It operates through the following segments: Self Care, Skin Health and Beauty, and Essential Health. The Self Care segment includes cough, cold and allergy, pain care, digestive health, and smoking cessation. The Skin Health and Beauty segment offers face and body care, and others. The Essential Health segment focuses on oral care, baby care, women's health, and wound care. The company was founded on February 23, 2022 and is headquartered in Summit, NJ.
info.description_zh: Kenvue, Inc. 是一家消費者健康公司，從事製造和銷售醫療保健產品，包括化妝品、藥品和醫療器材。其品牌包括 Aveeno、BAND-AID Brand、Johnson's、Listerine、Neutrogena 和 Tylenol。它透過以下部門運作：自我護理、皮膚健康和美容以及基本健康。自我照顧部分包括咳嗽、感冒和過敏、疼痛護理、消化健康和戒菸。皮膚健康和美容部門提供臉部和身體護理等。基本健康部門專注於口腔護理、嬰兒護理、女性健康和傷口護理。該公司成立於2022年2月23日，總部位於新澤西州薩米特。

info.description: VanEck Financials TruSector ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund designed to provide comprehensive, uncapped exposure to the financials sector by utilizing a hybrid investment approach. The fund addresses the limitations of traditional market-cap-weighted sector indexes-which often underweight the largest constituents to maintain regulatory compliance-by combining direct equity investments with targeted sector ETFs to more accurately reflect the sector's true market-capitalization composition.
info.description_zh: VanEck Financials TruSector ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過利用混合投資方式提供全面、無上限的金融業投資。該基金透過將直接股權投資與目標產業 ETF 結合，解決了傳統市值加權產業指數的局限性（該指數通常會低估最大的成分股以維持監管合規性），以更準確地反映該行業的真實市值組成。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright Momentum & Low Volatility ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Dorsey Wright Momentum Plus Low Volatility TM Index (the "index"). Under normal conditions, the fund will invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the equity securities that comprise the index. The index is a rules-based equity index designed to track the overall performance of the 50 stocks comprising the NASDAQ US Large Mid Cap Index TM that exhibit the lowest levels of volatility while still maintaining high levels of "relative strength."
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright Momentum & Low Volatility ETF 尋求與稱為 Dorsey Wright Momentum Plus Low Volatility TM 指數（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金將至少90%的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的股本證券。該指數是一個基於規則的股票指數，旨在追蹤構成納斯達克美國大中型股指數 TM 的 50 隻股票的整體表現，這些股票的波動性最低，同時仍保持高水平的「相對強度」。

info.description: JE Cleantech Holdings Ltd. engages in the sale of cleaning systems and other equipment and the provision of centralized dishwashing and ancillary services. The firm designs, develops, manufactures and sells cleaning systems for various industrial end-use applications to customers mainly in Singapore and Malaysia. It is also a centralized dishwashing services provider in Singapore. The company was founded by Hong Bee Yin in November 1999 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: JE Cleantech Holdings Ltd.從事清潔系統和其他設備的銷售以及提供集中洗碗和輔助服務。該公司為各種工業最終用途應用設計、開發、製造和銷售清潔系統，客戶主要位於新加坡和馬來西亞。它也是新加坡一家集中式洗碗服務供應商。該公司由 Hong Bee Yin 於 1999 年 11 月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: IB Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 7, 2020 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: IB Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2020年7月7日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Casey's General Stores, Inc. engages in the provision of management and operation of convenience stores and gasoline stations. It provides self-service gasoline, a wide selection of grocery items, and an array of freshly prepared food items. The firm offers food, beverages, tobacco products, health and beauty aids, automotive products, and other non-food items. The company was founded by Donald F. Lamberti in 1968 and is headquartered in Ankeny, IA.
info.description_zh: Casey's General Stores, Inc. 從事便利商店和加油站的管理和營運。它提供自助汽油、多種食品雜貨以及一系列新鮮烹製的食品。該公司提供食品、飲料、菸草產品、健康和美容輔助品、汽車產品和其他非食品產品。該公司由 Donald F. Lamberti 於 1968 年創立，總部位於愛荷華州安克尼。

info.description: Ball Corp. engages in the supplies of aluminum packaging for the beverage, personal care, and household products industries. It operates through the following segments: Beverage Packaging North and Central America, Beverage Packaging South America, and Beverage Packaging Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA). The Beverage Packaging North and Central America segment includes multi-year supply contracts to fillers of carbonated soft drinks, beer, energy drinks, and other beverages. The Beverage Packaging South America segment includes beverage containers in South America, and the manufacture of substantially all the metal beverage containers in Brazil. The Beverage Packaging EMEA segment consists of metal beverage containers in Europe, and other packaging materials used by the European beer and carbonated soft drink industries. The company was founded by Edmund Burke Ball, Frank Clayton Ball, George A. Ball, Lucius Lorenzo Ball, and William Charles Ball in 1880 and is headquartered in Westminster, CO.
info.description_zh: Ball Corp. 為飲料、個人護理和家居用品行業供應鋁包裝。該公司透過以下部門營運：北美和中美洲飲料包裝部門、南美飲料包裝部門以及歐洲、中東和非洲 (EMEA) 飲料包裝部門。北美和中美洲飲料包裝部門包括碳酸軟性飲料、啤酒、能量飲料和其他飲料填充機的多年供應合約。南美飲料包裝部門包括南美的飲料容器以及巴西幾乎所有金屬飲料容器的製造。歐洲、中東和非洲飲料包裝部門包括歐洲的金屬飲料容器以及歐洲啤酒和碳酸軟性飲料產業使用的其他包裝材料。該公司由 Edmund Burke Ball、Frank Clayton Ball、George A. Ball、Lucius Lorenzo Ball 和 William Charles Ball 於 1880 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州威斯敏斯特。

info.description: Atlanticus Holdings Corp. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of financial technology and related services. It operates through the Credit as a Service (CaaS) and Auto Finance segments. The CaaS segment includes private label credit and general purpose credit cards originated by lenders through multiple channels, including retail and healthcare, direct mail solicitation, digital marketing and partnerships with third parties. The Auto Finance segment services loans secured by independent automotive dealers and automotive finance companies in the buy-here, pay-here used car business. The company was founded by David G. Hanna in August 1996 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Atlanticus Holdings Corp.是一家金融控股公司，從事提供金融科技及相關服務。它透過信貸即服務（CaaS）和汽車金融部門運作。 CaaS 部分包括貸款人透過多種管道發起的自有品牌信用卡和通用信用卡，包括零售和醫療保健、直郵招攬、數位行銷以及與第三方的合作。汽車金融部門為獨立汽車經銷商和汽車金融公司在「在這裡購買、在這裡付款」的二手車業務中提供擔保的貸款服務。該公司由 David G. Hanna 於 1996 年 8 月創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: iShares Enhanced International Active ETF is an actively managed fund that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing in a diversified portfolio of equity securities from developed markets outside the U.S. and Canada. The strategy utilizes a systematic investment process based on proprietary quantitative models to identify stocks with attractive fundamental characteristics while seeking to outperform the MSCI EAFE Index through controlled exposure to rewarded factors.
info.description_zh: iShares 增強型國際主動型 ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過投資美國和加拿大以外已開發市場的多元化股票證券投資組合來實現長期資本增值。此策略利用基於專有量化模型的系統投資流程來識別具有有吸引力的基本特徵的股票，同時透過控制獎勵因素的曝險尋求跑贏 MSCI EAFE 指數。

info.description: MarketDesk Focused U.S. Dividend ETF seeks capital appreciation with a higher dividend yield compared to a broad-based index of U.S. large-cap dividend paying securities. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that is sub-advised by MarketDesk Indices LLC ("Sub-Adviser"). The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowing for investment purposes, in a portfolio of U.S. companies that pay dividends and expect to grow the dividend over time.
info.description_zh: 與美國大盤股股息支付證券的廣泛指數相比，MarketDesk 專注於美國股息 ETF 尋求以更高的股息殖利率實現資本增值。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），由 MarketDesk Indices LLC（「次級顧問」）提供次級顧問服務。該基金尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款金額投資於支付股息並預計隨著時間的推移增加股息的美國公司投資組合來實現其投資目標。

info.description: Super Hi International Holding Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in the restaurant's operation, delivery business, sales of condiment products, and food ingredients located in overseas market outside Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. It operates through the following geographical segments: Singapore, United States of America, Malaysia, Vietnam, and Others. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: 超喜國際控股有限公司是一家投資控股公司，主要從事餐廳經營、外帶業務、調味品及食材銷售，業務分佈於中國大陸、香港、澳門、台灣以外的海外市場。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：新加坡、美國、馬來西亞、越南等。該公司成立於2012年，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: F/m Emerald Life Sciences Innovation ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") and invests primarily in equity securities of life science companies selected by Emerald Mutual Fund Advisers Trust, the fund's investment sub-adviser, under the supervision of the adviser. Under normal market conditions, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities issued by life science companies demonstrating innovation.
info.description_zh: F/m Emerald Life Sciences Innovation ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金為一檔主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要投資於該基金的投資副顧問 Emerald Mutual Fund Advisers Trust 選擇的生命科學公司的股本證券，並接受顧問的監督。在正常市場條件下，該基金至少80%的淨資產投資於具有創新能力的生命科學公司發行的股本證券。

info.description: Lake Shore Bancorp, Inc. operates as a savings and loan holding company for Lake Shore Bank. It offers personal services, such as checking, savings, lending, banking, debit card, e-services, and online banking, and business services including deposit products, commercial loans, and business e-statements. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Dunkirk, NY.
info.description_zh: Lake Shore Bancorp, Inc. 是 Lake Shore Bank 的儲蓄和貸款控股公司。它提供個人服務，如支票、儲蓄、貸款、銀行業務、金融卡、電子服務和網路銀行，以及商業服務，包括存款產品、商業貸款和商業電子報表。該公司成立於 2006 年，總部位於紐約州敦克爾克。

info.description: Paloma Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded by Anna Nahajski-Staples on August 19, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Paloma Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Anna Nahajski-Staples 於 2025 年 8 月 19 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Precigen, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the research and development of synthetic biology technologies. It operates through the Biopharmaceuticals and Exemplar segments. The company was founded by Thomas David Reed in 1998 and is headquartered in Germantown, MD.
info.description_zh: Precigen, Inc.是一家生物技術公司，從事合成生物學技術的研究和開發。它透過生物製藥和 Exemplar 部門運作。該公司由 Thomas David Reed 於 1998 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州日耳曼敦。

info.description: Protagonist Therapeutics, Inc. a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovering and developing peptide-based therapeutic drugs to address unmet medical needs. Its product pipeline includes PTG-300, PTG-200, and PN-943. The company was founded by Mark L. Smythe on August 22, 2006 and is headquartered in Newark, CA.
info.description_zh: Protagonist Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發基於勝肽的治療藥物，以滿足未滿足的醫療需求。其產品線包括PTG-300、PTG-200和PN-943。該公司由 Mark L. Smythe 於 2006 年 8 月 22 日創立，總部位於加州紐瓦克。

info.description: Quetta Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, and reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on May 1, 2023 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Quetta Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，從事合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2023年5月1日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in equity securities of companies in developed markets, excluding the United States. It may invest in securities of companies with any market capitalization but the adviser intends to focus on large-capitalization securities.
info.description_zh: 在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款投資於已開發市場（不包括美國）公司的股本證券。它可以投資任何市值公司的證券，但顧問打算專注於大市值證券。

info.description: Strive, Inc. engages in the provision of an asset management Bitcoin treasury. It is focused on maximizing value for shareholders, accumulating bitcoin and outperforming bitcoin over the long run. The company was founded by Arshia Sarkhani, Jackson Fairbanks, Arman Sarkhani, and Kyle Fairbanks on March 9, 2022 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Strive, Inc. 從事提供資產管理比特幣金庫業務。它專注於為股東實現價值最大化、累積比特幣並從長遠來看超越比特幣。該公司由 Arshia Sarkhani、Jackson Fairbanks、Arman Sarkhani 和 Kyle Fairbanks 於 2022 年 3 月 9 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long SBUX Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of SBUX. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of SBUX, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 SBUX 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 SBUX 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來提供 SBUX 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Thornburg Multi Sector Bond ETF seeks total return, consisting of income and capital appreciation. The fund pursues its investment objective by investing in a broad range of income-producing investments, primarily including debt obligations. The fund manager may invest in debt obligations of any kind, of any quality, and of any maturity. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Thornburg 多部門債券 ETF 尋求總回報，包括收入和資本增值。該基金透過投資於廣泛的創收投資（主要包括債務）來實現其投資目標。基金管理人可以投資於任何種類、任何品質和任何期限的債務憑證。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Wisdomtree 1-3 Year Laddered Treasury Fund ETF seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bloomberg US Treasury 1-3 Year Laddered Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in U.S. Treasuries that have a remaining maturity of one to three years and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially similar to the economic characteristics of such Treasuries. The index is composed of fixed-rate coupon U.S. Treasury securities maturing in 1 to 3 years or with remaining maturities between 1 and 3 years. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree 1-3 年階梯式國債基金 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國國債 1-3 年階梯式指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。一般情況下，基金至少80%的淨資產投資於剩餘期限為1至3年的美國國債以及與此類國債經濟特徵基本相似的投資。该指数由 1 至 3 年到期或剩余期限在 1 至 3 年之间的固定利率美国国债组成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VanEck MSCI EAFE Analyst Sentiment ETF seeks to track the price and yield performance of the MSCI EAFE Analyst Sentiment Select Index, providing targeted exposure to developed market equities outside of the U.S. and Canada. The fund utilizes a proprietary rules-based selection process that identifies companies exhibiting positive "analyst sentiment" signals-specifically looking at revisions in earnings estimates, price targets, and analyst recommendations-to capture potential alpha from professional market insights.
info.description_zh: VanEck MSCI EAFE 分析師情緒 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI EAFE 分析師情緒精選指數的價格和收益率表現，提供對美國和加拿大以外已開發市場股票的有針對性的投資。該基金利用專有的基於規則的選擇流程，識別表現出積極「分析師情緒」信號的公司——特別關注盈利預測、價格目標和分析師建議的修訂——從專業市場洞察中捕捉潛在的阿爾法。

info.description: ALPS Active REIT ETF seeks total return through dividends and capital appreciation. The fund will, under normal circumstances, seek to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets in publicly traded equity securities of REITs. It will primarily invest in publicly traded common equity securities of U.S. REITs. The fund may also invest a portion of its assets in publicly traded common equity of U.S. real estate operating companies (not structured as REITs), publicly traded preferred equity of U.S. REITs and real estate operating companies, and cash and cash equivalents. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ALPS Active REIT ETF 透過股息和資本增值尋求總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將透過將至少80%的淨資產投資於公開交易的REITs股本證券來尋求實現其投資目標。它將主要投資於美國房地產投資信託基金的公開交易普通股證券。該基金還可以將其部分資產投資於美國房地產營運公司公開交易的普通股（非房地產投資信託基金）、美國房地產投資信託基金和房地產營運公司公開交易的優先股以及現金和現金等價物。它是非多元化的。

info.description: FIGX Capital Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, and reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on February 20, 2025 and is headquartered in Tiburon, CA.
info.description_zh: FigX Capital Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立是為了實現合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 2 月 20 日，總部位於加州蒂伯龍。

info.description: Aon Plc engages in the provision of risk, health, and wealth solutions. It operates through the following segments: Risk Capital, Human Capital, and Corporate. The Risk Capital segment supports clients through its Commercial Risk and Reinsurance solution lines. The Human Capital segment helps clients through its Health and Wealth solution lines. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: Aon Plc 致力於提供風險、健康和財富解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：風險資本部門、人力資本部門和企業部門。風險資本部門透過其商業風險和再保險解決方案系列為客戶提供支援。人力資本部門透過其健康和財富解決方案系列幫助客戶。該公司成立於1982年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a specialty pharmaceutical company singularly focused on delivering evidence-based treatment and advancing understanding of opioid use disorder (OUD) as a chronic but treatable brain disease. The company was founded on December 23, 2014 and is headquartered in North Chesterfield, VA.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家專業製藥公司，專注於提供循證治療並增進對阿片類藥物使用障礙 (OUD) 作為一種慢性但可治療的腦部疾病的理解。該公司成立於2014年12月23日，總部位於維吉尼亞州北切斯特菲爾德。

info.description: CO2 Energy Transition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, and similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. It focuses on the carbon capture, utilization, and storage industries. The company was founded on September 30, 2021 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: CO2 Energy Transition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，從事與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組和類似業務合併。它專注於碳捕獲、利用和儲存產業。該公司成立於2021年9月30日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Chubb Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and accident and health (A&H), reinsurance, and life insurance. It operates through the following segments: North America Commercial Property and Casualty (P&C) Insurance, North America Personal P&C Insurance, North America Agricultural Insurance, Overseas General Insurance, Global Reinsurance, and Corporate. The North America Commercial P&C Insurance segment that includes the business written by Chubb divisions that provide P&C insurance and services to large, middle market and small commercial businesses in the U.S., Canada, and Bermuda. The North America Personal P&C Insurance segment offers affluent and high net worth individuals and families with homeowners, high value automobile and collector cars, valuable articles, personal and excess liability, travel insurance, and recreational marine insurance and services. The North America Agricultural Insurance segment is involved in comprehensive multiple peril crop insurance (MPCI) and crop-hail insurance, and Chubb agribusiness. The Overseas General Insurance segment caters for both commercial and consumer P&C insurance and services in countries and territories outside of North America where the company operates. The Global Reinsurance segment covers the reinsurance business. The Corporate segment focuses on the results of non-insurance companies, income, and expenses not attributable to reportable segments. The company was founded in 1882 and is headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: Chubb Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，從事提供商業和個人財產及傷亡保險、個人事故和事故與健康 (A&H)、再保險和人壽保險。它透過以下部門運作：北美商業財產和意外傷害（P＆C）保險部門、北美個人財產和意外保險部門、北美農業保險部門、海外普通保險部門、全球再保險部門和企業部門。北美商業財產和意外傷害保險部門包括 Chubb 部門的業務，為美國、加拿大和百慕達的大中型市場和小型商業企業提供財產和意外保險和服務。北美個人財產和意外傷害保險部門為富裕和高淨值個人和家庭提供房主、高價值汽車和收藏車、貴重物品、個人責任和超額責任、旅遊保險以及休閒海上保險和服務。北美農業保險部門涉足綜合多重危險作物保險 (MPCI) 和作物冰雹保險以及 Chubb 農業綜合企業。海外普通保險部門在公司經營所在的北美以外的國家和地區提供商業和消費者財產與意外傷害保險和服務。全球再保險部門涵蓋再保險業務。公司部門專注於非保險公司的績效、不屬於可報告部門的收入和支出。該公司成立於1882年，總部位於瑞士蘇黎世。

info.description: Northern Trust Corp. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of asset servicing, fund administration, asset management, fiduciary, and banking solutions for corporations, institutions, families, and individuals. It operates through the Asset Servicing and Wealth Management segments. The Asset Servicing segment offers asset servicing, brokerage, banking and related services to corporate and public retirement funds, foundations, endowments, fund managers, insurance companies and sovereign wealth funds. The Wealth Management Segment includes trust, investment management, custody, and philanthropic services, financial consulting, guardianship and estate administration, family business consulting, family financial education, brokerage services and private and business banking. The company was founded on August 12, 1889 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Northern Trust Corp.是一家金融控股公司，為企業、機構、家庭和個人提供資產服務、基金管理、資產管理、信託和銀行解決方案。它透過資產服務和財富管理部門運作。資產服務部門為企業和公共退休基金、基金會、捐贈基金、基金經理人、保險公司和主權財富基金提供資產服務、經紀、銀行及相關服務。財富管理部門包括信託、投資管理、託管和慈善服務、財務諮詢、監護和遺產管理、家族企業諮詢、家庭金融教育、經紀服務以及私人和商業銀行業務。該公司成立於 1889 年 8 月 12 日，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Gaming & Leisure Properties, Inc. engages in the provision of acquiring, financing, and owning real estate property to be leased to gaming operators in triple-net lease arrangements. The company was founded on February 13, 2013 and is headquartered in Wyomissing, PA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Gaming & Leisure Properties, Inc. 從事提供收購、融資和擁有房地產的業務，這些房地產將透過三網租賃安排出租給博彩業者。該公司成立於2013年2月13日，總部位於賓州懷俄明州。

info.description: The Coca-Cola Co. engages in the manufacturing and marketing of non-alcoholic beverages. It operates through the following segments: Europe, Middle East and Africa, Latin America, North America, Asia Pacific, Global Ventures, and Bottling Investments. The company was founded by Asa Griggs Candler on May 8, 1886 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: 可口可樂公司從事非酒精飲料的製造和行銷。該公司透過以下部門營運：歐洲、中東和非洲、拉丁美洲、北美、亞太地區、全球創投和裝瓶投資。該公司由 Asa Griggs Candler 於 1886 年 5 月 8 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: W.R. Berkley Corp. is an insurance holding company, which engages in the property casualty insurance business. It operates through the following segments: Insurance and Reinsurance & Monoline Excess. The Insurance segment includes excess and surplus lines, admitted lines, and specialty personal lines throughout the United States, as well as insurance businesses in the United Kingdom, Continental Europe, South America, Canada, Mexico, Scandinavia, Asia, and Australia. The Reinsurance & Monoline Excess segment is involved in the reinsurance business on a facultative and treaty basis, primarily in the United States, United Kingdom, Continental Europe, Australia, the Asia-Pacific region, and South Africa. The company was founded by William R. Berkley in 1967 and is headquartered in Greenwich, CT.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: W.R. Berkley Corp.是一家從事財產傷亡保險業務的保險控股公司。它透過以下部門運作：保險、再保險和單險超額業務。保險部門包括美國各地的超額和盈餘保險、准入保險和特殊個人保險，以及英國、歐洲大陸、南美洲、加拿大、墨西哥、斯堪的納維亞半島、亞洲和澳洲的保險業務。再保險和單險超額部分主要在美國、英國、歐洲大陸、澳洲、亞太地區和南非以臨時和條約形式參與再保險業務。該公司由 William R. Berkley 於 1967 年創立，總部位於康乃狄克州格林威治。

info.description: Apogee Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company. It offers treatment of atopic dermatitis (AD), ashma, eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE), chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and related inflammatory and immunology (I&I) indications. The company was founded by Andrew Gottesdiener and Nimish P. Shah in 2022 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Apogee Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司。它可治疗特应性皮炎（AD）、哮喘、嗜酸性粒细胞性食管炎（EoE）、慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）以及相关的炎症和免疫学（I＆I）适应症。該公司由 Andrew Gottesdiener 和 Nimish P. Shah 於 2022 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: YieldMax Short N100 Option Income Strategy ETF seeks current income; with secondary investment objective being inverse exposure to the performance of the Nasdaq 100 Index, subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks current income while providing indirect inverse exposure tothe performance of the index. Its potential for gains from decreases in the index level is limited. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: YieldMax 空頭 N100 選擇權收益策略 ETF 尋求當前收益； with secondary investment objective being inverse exposure to the performance of the Nasdaq 100 Index, subject to a limit on potential investment gains. 基金是一種主動管理的 ETF，尋求當前曝險的反向指數，尋求當前對表現的對表現指數。其從指數水準下跌中獲得收益的潛力有限。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Medtronic Plc is a medical technology company, which engages in the development, manufacture, distribution, and sale of device-based medical therapies and services. It operates through the following segments: Cardiovascular Porrtfolio, Neuroscience Portfolio, Medical Surgical Portfolio, and Diabetes Operating Unit. The Cardiovascular Portfolio segment includes products for the diagnosis, treatment, and management of cardiac rhythm disorders and cardiovascular disease. The Neuroscience Portfolio is made up of cranial and spinal technologies, specialty therapies, and neuromodulation divisions. The Medical Surgical Portfolio is comprised of surgical innovations and respiratory, gastrointestinal, and renal divisions. The Diabetes Group segment offers insulin pumps, continuous glucose monitoring systems, and insulin pump consumables. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: 美敦力公司是一家醫療技術公司，從事基於設備的醫療療法和服務的開發、製造、分銷和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：心血管業務部門、神經科學業務部門、醫療外科業務部門和糖尿病業務部門。心血管產品組合包括用於診斷、治療和管理心律不整和心血管疾病的產品。神經科學產品組合由顱骨和脊椎技術、專業療法和神經調節部門組成。醫療外科產品組合由外科創新以及呼吸、胃腸和腎臟部門組成。糖尿病集團部門提供胰島素幫浦、連續血糖監測系統和胰島素幫浦耗材。該公司成立於1949年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Republic Services, Inc. engages in the provision of environmental services. It provides collection, transfer, recycling, and disposal services for non-hazardous solid waste, as well as environmental solutions services. It operates through the following segments: Group 1, Group 2, and Group 3. The Group 1 segment focuses on the business of recycling and solid waste in geographic areas located in western United States. The Group 2 segment includes the recycling and solid waste business in geographic areas located in the southeastern and mid-western and the eastern seaboard of the United States and Canada. The Group 3 segment includes environmental solutions business in geographic areas located across the United States and Canada. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Republic Services, Inc. 從事提供環境服務。提供無害固體廢棄物的收集、轉運、回收、處置服務以及環境解決方案服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：第 1 組、第 2 組和第 3 組。第 1 組部門專注於美國西部地理區域的回收和固體廢棄物業務。第二組部門包括位於美國和加拿大東南部、中西部和東海岸地理區域的回收和固體廢物業務。第三組部門包括位於美國和加拿大地理區域的環境解決方案業務。該公司成立於 1996 年，總部位於亞利桑那州鳳凰城。

info.description: Invesco DWA Industrials Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Industrials Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the industrials sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Industrials Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Industrials Technical Leaders Index（「基本指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數由至少 30 隻具有強大相對實力或「動量」特徵的工業部門公司證券組成。

info.description: Yueda Digital Holding engages in the provision of business of air travel advertisements. It provides in-flight solutions to connectivity, entertainment, and digital multimedia in China. The company offers Internet connections through a network of satellites and land-based beacons. It also serves airline travelers with interactive entertainment and coverage of breaking news. The company was founded by Herman Man Guo in August 2005 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 悅達數碼控股從事提供航空旅遊廣告業務。它在中國提供機上連接、娛樂和數位多媒體解決方案。該公司透過衛星和陸基信標網路提供網路連線。它還為航空旅客提供互動娛樂和突發新聞報道。該公司由赫爾曼·郭於2005年8月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Direxion Daily TSLA Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of TSLA. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X inverse (opposite) or short leveraged exposure to TSLA equal to at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion 每日 TSLA Bear 1X 股票尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）與 TSLA 每日業績相反（或相反）100%。在正常情況下，該基金投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和期權，這些金融工具相結合，為 TSLA 提供 1 倍反向（相反）或空頭槓桿敞口，相當於基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）的至少 80%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: ProShares UltraPro Short QQQ seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to three times the inverse (-3x) of the daily performance of the NASDAQ-100 Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective. The index includes 100 of the largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market based on market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares UltraPro Short QQQ 尋求扣除費用和開支之前的每日投資結果，該結果相當於 NASDAQ-100 指數每日表現的倒數 (-3 倍) 的三倍。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與基金投資目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數包括按市值計算在納斯達克股票市場上市的 100 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Graniteshares 1.5x Short TSLA Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of -1.50 time (-150%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Tesla Inc, (NASDAQ: TSLA). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate the inverse (-150%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. The fund advisor aims to generate the inverse daily performance of the underlying stock for a single day.
info.description_zh: Graniteshares 1.5 倍短期 TSLA 每日 ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為特斯拉公司（納斯達克股票代碼：TSLA）普通股每日百分比變化的 -1.50 倍（-150%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期協議來複製標的股票的反向（-150%）每日百分比變化。基金顧問的目標是產生標的股票單日的反向日表現。

info.description: AXS TSLA Bear Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to the inverse (-100%) of the daily performance of the common shares of Tesla, Inc. Under normal market circumstances, the adviser will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide inverse exposure to the daily performance of TSLA. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve on a daily basis, before fees and expenses, -100% performance of TSLA for a single day, not for any other period, by entering into one or more swap agreements on TSLA. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AXS TSLA Bear Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果，該結果與 Tesla, Inc. 普通股每日表現的反向 (-100%) 相對應。在正常市場情況下，顧問將維持至少 80% 的金融工具敞口，這些工具提供與 TSLA 每日表現反向的敞口。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過簽訂一項或多項 TSLA 掉期協議，在未計費用和支出之前，實現 TSLA 單日（而不是任何其他時期）的 ​​-100% 業績。該基金是非多元化的。
